paper.title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
paper.abstract: Recent research empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) as multi-turn search agents to iteratively retrieve and generate outputs until complex tasks are solved. However, the contexts of multi-turn search agents are lengthy and complex. For example, the retrieved set of documents in each turn would inevitably introduce irrelevant information that distracts LLMs, referring to \textit{context interference}, potentially hindering the reliability and efficiency of search agents. Therefore, we conduct a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮搜索 Agent 中的 context interference：检索系统通常能召回含有答案的文档，但上下文里混入的无关文档、历史查询和中间推理会干扰模型选取正确证据，导致“召回到了但答不对”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏向 Agent/RAG 训练范式。但它对长上下文使用方式有启发：上下文长度增加不等于有效信息增加，噪声文档会改变模型对内部知识和外部证据的利用方式。对做 post-train、RL search agent、长上下文数据构造的人更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把搜索 Agent 的上下文拆成问题、历史搜索 query、历史检索文档、最新检索文档、历史 reasoning 等部分，通过 masking 不同上下文片段来定位干扰源。实验结论是最新一轮检索文档是主要干扰来源，历史 query 和历史文档也有轻微影响。基于这个观察，作者构造了一个 context refinement 数据集，用蒸馏方式把“检索文档”压缩为“对当前搜索 query 最关键的信息”。随后训练一个 context refiner，在 Agent 生成前动态重写检索上下文。最后把 refiner 放入 RL 训练流程，让策略模型在训练时看到的是动态精炼后的上下文，而不是原始检索结果。
summary.experiments: 论文在一组 closed-book QA benchmark 上评估多轮搜索 Agent 的可靠性和效率。关键实验包括：不同上下文片段 masking 的归因实验；多种上下文精炼策略比较；蒸馏式 context refiner 的效果；以及把 context refinement 接入 RL search-agent training pipeline 后与其他训练基线比较。提供内容中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、数据规模和提升数字，因此不宜补充数值。可确认的实验结论是：refiner 同时提升答题可靠性和搜索效率；在 RL 训练中使用动态精炼上下文，比仅在推理时做上下文处理更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，RQ1 的 context masking 设计，它决定了“干扰来自哪里”的可信度；第二，context refinement 数据集如何蒸馏，特别是 teacher 信号来自哪里、是否会引入答案泄漏；第三，RL pipeline 中 refiner 的接入方式，关注训练时和推理时上下文分布是否一致。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读具体 QA 结果，值得关注的是长上下文噪声如何影响 search-agent 训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies context interference in multi-turn search agents. A retriever may return documents that contain the needed evidence, but irrelevant documents, past queries, and intermediate reasoning can distract the model, creating a gap between retrieval recall and answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly at the pretrain–posttrain interface: it shows that longer retrieved context can degrade the learning and inference signal for search agents. This matters for RL-trained retrieval agents, long-context training data design, and systems that mix parametric knowledge with external evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose the agent context into the user question, previous search queries, previous retrieved documents, the latest retrieved documents, and reasoning history. They then mask specific context components to identify where interference comes from. Their main finding is that the latest retrieved documents are the dominant source of interference, while earlier queries and documents contribute mildly. Based on this, they build a distilled context-refinement dataset that maps retrieved documents into concise query-relevant evidence. A context refiner is trained on this dataset and inserted before generation. The refiner is also integrated into the reinforcement-learning pipeline, so the search agent is trained with dynamically refined contexts rather than raw retrieval outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates reliability and efficiency on several closed-book QA benchmarks. The main experiments include context-component masking, comparison among refinement strategies, evaluation of the distilled refiner, and RL training with dynamic context refinement. The supplied full text does not include exact model sizes, dataset sizes, benchmark names, or numerical gains, so those numbers should not be inferred. The reported qualitative result is consistent: context refinement improves both answer reliability and search efficiency, and using refinement during RL training is stronger than treating it only as an inference-time wrapper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on three parts: the masking-based attribution setup for RQ1, the construction of the distilled context-refinement data, and the way the refiner is inserted into the RL training loop. The most useful question to ask while reading is whether the refiner changes the training distribution in a controlled way or simply filters away hard negatives. The detailed QA leaderboard numbers are less important for pretraining researchers than the analysis of noisy long-context supervision.

recommendation.zh: 只看干扰源定位和 refinement ablation；若最新检索文档真是主因，RAG 训练里盲目塞更多证据会更可疑。
recommendation.en: Skim the interference-source ablations and refinement results; if newest retrieved docs dominate the noise, stuffing more evidence into RAG training looks less defensible.

paper.title: Tevatron-Elastic: A Unified Abstraction for Training Elastic Retrievers and Rerankers
paper.abstract: A single model scale challenges the flexibility of a production retrieval system: some settings need it faster, others need a smaller index, and the right trade-off changes with the workload. In the context of information retrieval (IR), a transformer-based model can be made smaller in three ways---using fewer layers, passing fewer tokens through the upper layers, or producing a shorter embedding---and each way saves a different compute resource. These options have been studied one at a time, ea

summary.core_problem: 生产检索系统需要在速度、索引大小和精度之间动态取舍，但现有 retriever/reranker 通常只能按单一模型尺寸部署。
summary.importance: 贡献是检索模型的弹性训练抽象和工程统一，覆盖层数、token 经过上层的数量、embedding 维度三种压缩轴；它对 LLM serving 和 RAG 系统有参考价值，但不是基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic 用一个统一的 size object 表示模型可运行的任意配置，并用短 schedule 指定训练时采样的配置集合。训练后得到一个 checkpoint，部署时可选择不同层深、token 路由深度或向量维度；同一抽象覆盖 retriever 与 reranker，也覆盖 encoder 与 decoder 模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数值或提升幅度。实验重点应是比较单轴弹性方法与统一多轴弹性训练在检索质量、延迟、索引大小和算力占用上的折中。
summary.authors_note: Jimmy Lin 是信息检索和 Tevatron 系列工作的代表作者；Vivek Srikumar 长期从事 NLP 与结构化学习研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Production retrieval systems need runtime trade-offs among latency, index size, and accuracy, while most retrievers and rerankers are trained and deployed at a single fixed scale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a unified abstraction for elastic training of retrieval models, spanning layer depth, token depth through upper layers, and embedding dimensionality. It is relevant to LLM serving and RAG infrastructure, but it is not a foundation-model pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tevatron-Elastic represents any executable model size with a single size object and uses a compact schedule to specify which sizes are trained. One checkpoint can then serve multiple configurations at deployment, varying depth, token processing, or embedding dimension. The abstraction is designed to cover both retrievers and rerankers, and both encoder and decoder models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, datasets, baseline numbers, or gains. The expected experimental focus is the quality-latency-index-size trade-off compared with separately trained single-axis elastic approaches.
summary_en.authors_note: Jimmy Lin is a well-known information retrieval researcher and a key figure behind the Tevatron line of work; Vivek Srikumar is known for NLP and structured prediction research.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法抽象和资源分解即可；它不会改变预训练 recipe，但对 RAG 检索侧的弹性 serving 有实用参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the abstraction and resource decomposition; it will not change a pretraining recipe, but it is useful for elastic retrieval-side serving in RAG systems.

paper.title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
paper.abstract: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate Doc

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是长文档理解中的交互式证据获取问题：相关信息分散在很多页、表格、图像和图表中，静态 RAG 一次性取回证据不够灵活，而纯 prompt 驱动的 agent 又难以被系统训练。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法，但对基座和 post-train 接口有参考意义。它把长文档问答从“把更多内容塞进上下文”改成“在可变环境中学习搜索、阅读、记笔记和复查”。这个形式更接近可训练的 agent environment：同一套交互协议既用于推理，也用于 RL 训练小模型。对长上下文模型研究来说，它提醒一个现实问题：扩大 context window 不能替代信息选择、状态管理和证据压缩。
summary.technical_approach: DocAtlas 被定义为 mutable document harness。给定文档和问题，环境维护四类状态：原始文档、层级文档树、结构化 note store、已探索页面集合。agent 每一步选择工具动作，环境根据当前状态返回 observation。核心工具包括 Search、Read、Note、Review 和最终 Finish。Search 不是在固定索引上检索，而是读取已被 Note 和探索记录更新过的状态；Read 将页面以 markdown、crop、page image 等形式暴露给 VLM；Note 把带来源的发现写回树和笔记库；Review 在后续推理中重新调出已有证据。这样，后续检索会受到早期发现的影响，避免每一步都从静态文档表示重新开始。与传统 RAG 相比，它强调状态可变；与只靠 prompt 的 agent 相比，它提供了可以在训练和推理阶段复用的环境接口；与 DocDancer 相比，它不只训练文本控制器调用外部 VLM，而是允许 VLM agent 在同一环境中端到端 RL。
summary.experiments: 论文在 MMLongBench-Doc 上报告了两个关键结果。使用 GPT-5.4 作为 backbone 的 DocAtlas 达到 71.4%，高于文中给出的 human-expert reference 65.8%。使用 Qwen3.5-4B VLM 在同一环境中做端到端 RL 后达到 63.7%，相比 direct-input baseline 的 54.4% 提升 9.3 个百分点。这个结果说明，收益不只来自更强闭源模型，也来自交互协议和可训练环境本身。提供内容未包含完整消融表，无法确认 Search、Read、Note、Review 各组件的单独贡献和 RL 训练细节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟左右。重点看 Method 中对 trajectory、tool action、environment state 的形式化定义，以及 Search/Read/Note/Review 如何更新状态。实验部分建议优先找 MMLongBench-Doc 的主结果表、RL tuning 设置、以及是否有去掉 Note、Review、mutable tree 的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得深挖的是它的环境接口是否能扩展为通用 long-context / multimodal agent 的 SFT 和 RL 数据生成器。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-document understanding as an interactive evidence-seeking problem. Relevant information may be scattered across pages, tables, figures, and charts. Static RAG retrieves a fixed evidence set before generation, while many agentic systems rely on prompt-defined behavior over frozen proprietary models.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the interface between foundation models, long-context inference, and RL training. The main lesson is that long-document capability is not only a context-length problem. A model also needs mechanisms for selective reading, stateful memory, evidence attribution, and revisiting previous findings. DocAtlas provides an environment that can be used both at inference time and during RL, which makes it more useful for training compact open VLM agents than a prompt-only tool-use recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: DocAtlas instantiates a mutable document harness. For each document-question pair, the environment maintains the document, a hierarchical tree, a structured note store, and the set of explored pages. The agent produces a trajectory of tool calls and ends with a Finish action. Search operates over the current mutable state rather than a fixed index. Read exposes selected pages through markdown, crops, and full page images. Note records source-attributed findings and writes them back into the tree and note store. Review retrieves earlier notes when later reasoning needs them. This design lets later retrieval depend on earlier evidence, which is the main difference from static RAG. It also differs from prompt-only document agents because the same action interface can be used for RL. Compared with DocDancer, the agent is not just a text controller that delegates visual understanding to an external VLM; the VLM policy can be trained inside the same environment.
summary_en.experiments: On MMLongBench-Doc, DocAtlas with GPT-5.4 reaches 71.4%, compared with a reported human-expert reference of 65.8%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM fine-tuned with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7%, while the direct-input baseline is 54.4%, a 9.3-point gain. These numbers suggest that the mutable interaction protocol contributes beyond simply using a stronger backbone. The supplied content does not include the full ablation tables, so the separate effects of Search, Read, Note, Review, and the RL recipe cannot be checked here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes. Focus on the method section defining trajectories, tool actions, observations, and mutable environment state. Then inspect the main MMLongBench-Doc result table and any ablations removing note-taking, review, or the mutable tree. For foundation-model researchers, the most useful question is whether this environment can serve as a scalable generator of SFT/RL trajectories for long-context multimodal agents.

recommendation.zh: 读系统状态设计和 note store 更新规则；这是外部记忆工程，不是长上下文预训练替代品。
recommendation.en: Read the state design and note-store update rules; this is external-memory engineering, not a replacement for long-context pretraining.

paper.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
paper.abstract: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant information redundancy and noise still remain in the coarse-grained chunks. This paper optimizes the Pareto frontier under low prefill latency constraints while maximizing accuracy by proposing CoinRAG (Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG). The name metaphorically reflec

summary.core_problem: 降低 long-context RAG 的 prefill latency，同时避免粗粒度 chunk 级 KV cache 复用带来的冗余和噪声。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统与 RAG efficiency 工作，贡献点在 KV cache 复用粒度。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于理解长上下文系统瓶颈，以及 retrieval context 表示是否需要在训练阶段适配更细粒度的复用结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoinRAG，把离线计算的 fine-grained information nugget KV cache 作为可组合单元。系统先用两阶段检索从 retrieved chunks 中定位 query-relevant semantic units，再拼接或组装这些 sliced KV representations，形成更紧凑、语义相关性更高的上下文表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、数据集和数值。实验目标是优化低 prefill latency 约束下的 accuracy-latency Pareto frontier，并与 chunk-level KV cache reuse 方案比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce prefill latency in long-context RAG while avoiding the redundancy and noise of coarse chunk-level KV-cache reuse.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and RAG-efficiency contribution focused on cache granularity. For pretraining researchers, its indirect value is in exposing long-context serving bottlenecks and raising the question of whether retrieval-context representations should be trained for finer-grained reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoinRAG reuses offline-computed fine-grained information-nugget KV caches as composable units. It uses two-stage retrieval to identify query-relevant semantic units inside retrieved chunks, then assembles sliced KV representations into a compact, semantically relevant contextual representation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not include concrete model names, datasets, or numerical results. The evaluation targets the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier under low prefill-latency constraints and compares against chunk-level KV-cache reuse approaches.

recommendation.zh: 只看 cache 粒度和 Pareto 图；若结果干净，它提示 RAG context 可以按 semantic unit 预编码，而不是按 chunk 硬切。
recommendation.en: Read the cache granularity and Pareto plots; if clean, it argues for semantic-unit pre-encoding rather than hard chunking in RAG.

paper.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
paper.abstract: Post-training adaptation has become central to modern machine learning practice and includes techniques such as retraining, fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, alignment, retrieval augmentation, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and Multimodal Instruction Tuning. However, the literature remains fragmented across technique families, model classes, and deployment contexts, making it difficult to compare methods or describe how a trained model has been modified. This survey synthesiz

summary.core_problem: 后训练适配技术覆盖 fine-tuning、PEFT、alignment、RAG、model editing、unlearning、calibration、多模态指令微调等，术语和比较维度分散。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述与分类法。论文提出六维 taxonomy，用机制、目标、数据需求、持久性、结构范围、模型类型来描述适配方法；对研究员的价值主要是术语整理，不是新的训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文综合后训练适配文献，构造六个维度来区分常被混用的概念，例如 fine-tuning、retrieval augmentation、prompting、model editing 和 unlearning，并将传统 ML、深度学习、foundation model、LLM、MLLM 的适配方式放到同一描述框架中。
summary.experiments: 作为 taxonomy/survey，摘要未描述实验、模型规模或定量 baseline。主要产出应是分类表、概念边界和治理场景映射。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses fragmentation in post-training adaptation terminology across fine-tuning, PEFT, alignment, RAG, model editing, unlearning, calibration, and multimodal instruction tuning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a survey and taxonomy. It proposes six dimensions—mechanism, goal, data requirement, persistence, structural scope, and model type—to describe adaptation methods. Its value is conceptual organization rather than a new training technique.
summary_en.technical_approach: The survey synthesizes adaptation literature and uses the six-dimensional framework to separate commonly conflated methods such as fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, prompting, model editing, and unlearning. It also maps how adaptation changes from classical ML to foundation models, LLMs, and multimodal LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: No experiments, model sizes, or quantitative baselines are described in the abstract. The main outputs are likely taxonomy tables, definitions, and governance-oriented mappings.

recommendation.zh: 适合作术语索引，不适合找训练 insight；扫 taxonomy 表即可，治理部分对 pretrain 决策帮助有限。
recommendation.en: Useful as a terminology index, not a source of training insight; skim the taxonomy table and skip most governance framing.

paper.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over long documents is dominated by one design: chunk the text, embed the chunks, and surface the top-k nearest neighbours of the query. We argue that for an important class of documents -- financial statements, audit reports, regulatory returns -- this design is structurally unsound, and we make the argument measurable. On a 780-page government financial report, 86.8% of content lines are table rows, thousands of near-identical figures compete in one embedding spa

summary.core_problem: 传统top-k嵌入检索在含大量表格的长文档（财务/审计/监管报告）中存在结构性缺陷，导致数值与单位/财年信息分离，检索精度严重下降
summary.importance: 通过量化实验证明传统RAG设计在表格密集文档中的系统性失效，提出无嵌入的agentic检索范式，属于原理分析与方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出READ（Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search）方法，agent通过三个确定性操作直接读取原始文档结构，完全绕过嵌入检索的chunking错误
summary.experiments: 在780页政府财务报告上测试：86.8%内容为表格行，传统chunking常导致数字与单位（lakh/crore，差两个数量级）分离；表格感知chunker在所有测试chunk尺寸下仍有27-30%数值chunk缺失财年上下文头

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional top-k embedding retrieval has structural flaws in table-heavy long documents (financial/audit/regulatory reports), causing numeric values to be separated from units/fiscal year context and severely degrading retrieval accuracy
summary_en.importance: Quantitatively demonstrates systematic failure of mainstream RAG designs in table-heavy documents, proposes an embedding-free agentic retrieval paradigm, as a principle analysis and methodological innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes READ (Reliable Embedding-free Agentic Document-search), where an agent reads raw document structure through three deterministic operations, completely bypassing chunking errors in embedding-based retrieval
summary_en.experiments: Tested on a 780-page government financial report: 86.8% of content is table rows, traditional chunking often separates numbers from units (lakh/crore, a 100x difference); table-aware chunkers still leave 27-30% of numeric chunks without fiscal year headers at all tested chunk sizes

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文RAG或文档agent的仅看§3的失效分析即可，方法本身仅适配表格密集文档，泛化性未验证
recommendation.en: For long-context RAG or document agent researchers, only read §3 failure analysis; method is limited to table-heavy documents with unproven generalization

paper.title: RAG-Stack: Co-Optimizing RAG Serving Performance and Quality
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), which augments large language model (LLM) generation with information retrieved from databases, has become a widely used approach for knowledge-intensive applications. Modern RAG systems, however, expose many configuration choices, such as retrieval indexes, model selections, and how models invoke retrieval. Each configuration yields a different trade-off between answer quality and serving performance, making it challenging to choose the optimal setting for

summary.core_problem: 现代RAG系统配置选项多（检索索引、模型选择、检索调用方式等），不同配置在回答质量和服务性能之间存在不同权衡，难以找到最优部署配置
summary.importance: RAG系统工程创新，提出了质量-性能联合优化框架，可高效发现RAG系统的帕累托最优配置
summary.technical_approach: 提出RAG-Stack框架，包含三个组件：RAG-PE（迭代式设计空间探索算法，选择下一个待评估的RAG配置）、RAG-IR（面向多样RAG算法的工作负载抽象）、RAG-CM（性能模型，预测给定硬件上的最优部署和服务性能），三者结合高效生成质量-性能帕累托前沿
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露具体实验结果和帕累托前沿的优化效果

summary_en.core_problem: Modern RAG systems have many configuration options (retrieval indexes, model selection, retrieval invocation methods, etc.), with different trade-offs between answer quality and serving performance, making it hard to find optimal deployment configurations
summary_en.importance: RAG systems engineering innovation, proposing a joint quality-performance optimization framework that efficiently discovers Pareto-optimal configurations for RAG systems
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the RAG-Stack framework with three components: RAG-PE (an iterative design-space exploration algorithm that selects the next RAG configuration to evaluate), RAG-IR (a workload abstraction for diverse RAG algorithms), and RAG-CM (a performance model that predicts optimal deployment and serving performance on given hardware), which together efficiently generate quality-performance Pareto frontiers
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; specific experimental results and Pareto frontier optimization effects not disclosed

recommendation.zh: RAG服务性能与质量联合优化框架，属于应用系统工程，与预训练研究关联弱，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: A co-optimization framework for RAG serving performance and quality, it is applied systems engineering with weak relevance to pretraining; only read the abstract

paper.title: When Absence Is Evidence: Evaluating Completeness-Sensitive Negative Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often asked whether something is absent from a record, list, or retrieved context. Yet non-observation licenses a negative answer only when evidence completely covers the query scope; otherwise, the answer should remain unknown. We call this completeness-sensitive negative reasoning. We introduce CROWN-QA, comprising CROWN-Synth, a controlled paired core that fixes the question and observed facts while varying only query-relative coverage, and CROWN-Real, a real-

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM 在“缺失是否能作为否定证据”这类 completeness-sensitive negative reasoning 场景中的判断能力：只有证据覆盖查询范围时，未观察到某项才应推出否定，否则应回答未知。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测协议与失效模式分析工作，不是在做新模型。它把常见 QA/RAG 场景里一个经常被混淆的推理类型单独拆出来，并区分了 justified negative 与 insufficient evidence，对检索增强、长上下文问答和 verifier 设计都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CROWN-QA，包括受控合成集 CROWN-Synth 和真实文档对比集 CROWN-Real。核心设计是固定问题和已观察事实，只改变与查询相关的 coverage，从而隔离“证据是否完整”这一变量，测模型是否会把隐式不完整证据误判为可闭包的否定结论。作者还分析了 prompting 如何在 over-closure 与 under-closure 之间重新分配错误。
summary.experiments: 在三个 LLM family 上测试，结论是 closure judgment 不稳定，且存在明显 over-closure：模型常不能稳定区分 Certified-Negative 与 Unknown。CROWN-Synth 中最主要的失败模式是不对称的：模型往往能识别隐式完整证据，却把隐式部分证据也当成 query-covering。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升数字，这更像 failure analysis 而非 leaderboard 论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自韩国与美国高校合作团队，包括 Sangmyung University、CUNY、Hansung University、Sookmyung Women’s University、Yonsei University；未见一线大模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs can reason correctly in completeness-sensitive negative reasoning: absence supports a negative answer only when the available evidence fully covers the query scope; otherwise the answer should be unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and failure-analysis paper rather than a new modeling method. It isolates a subtle but common reasoning pattern in QA and RAG, separating justified negatives from insufficient-evidence cases, which matters for retrieval-based systems, long-context QA, and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces CROWN-QA, with CROWN-Synth as a controlled paired benchmark and CROWN-Real as a real-document contrast set. The key design keeps the question and observed facts fixed while varying only query-relative coverage, so the benchmark can specifically test whether models mistake partial evidence for complete evidence. The paper also studies how prompting shifts errors between over-closure and under-closure.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark is tested across three LLM families. The main finding is unstable closure judgment with substantial over-closure: models often fail to distinguish Certified-Negative from Unknown. On CROWN-Synth, the dominant failure is asymmetric: models can often recognize implicitly complete evidence, but still treat implicitly partial evidence as query-covering. The abstract does not provide model sizes or detailed numeric tables, consistent with a diagnostic benchmark paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from a collaboration across Korean and US universities, including Sangmyung University, CUNY, Hansung University, Sookmyung Women’s University, and Yonsei University; no major frontier-lab affiliation is evident.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的 failure mode benchmark，不改 pretrain prior，但做 RAG、long-context 或 verifier 的人应记下“partial evidence 被误当 complete”这个坑；看任务构造和错误分解就够了。
recommendation.en: A clean failure-mode benchmark: it does not change pretraining priors, but anyone building RAG, long-context QA, or verifiers should note the systematic confusion between partial and complete evidence; the task design and error breakdown are the parts worth reading.

institutions: The City University of New York
Sookmyung Women’s University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
Graduate School of Information, Yonsei University, Seoul, Republic of Korea

paper.title: Eliciting Intrinsic Hallucinations in LLMs via Semantically Equivalent Adversarial Attacks
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often used in conjunction with external knowledge sources to improve their factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations, through methods such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, these systems remain susceptible to intrinsic hallucinations, where the model generates unfaithful or fabricated information that is not supported by the retrieved evidence. We propose a novel framework to assess model robustness against this phenomenon by stress-testing usi

summary.core_problem: 评估 RAG 场景下 LLM 对“语义等价改写”是否仍会产生不被检索证据支持的内生幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是鲁棒性评测框架：用保持语义等价的对抗改写去诱发 intrinsic hallucination。对预训练的直接启发有限，但对理解“检索并不能消除模型内部错误先验”有一定价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个带语义等价约束的对抗优化框架，在白盒、灰盒、黑盒设置下搜索 query 变体，同时以 intrinsic hallucination 为目标函数，系统压力测试生成模型在 RAG 条件下的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 评测 5 个开源和 5 个闭源生成模型，覆盖 3 个数据集。摘要结论是即便强模型在语义等价扰动下也容易出现内生幻觉，但未提供与训练数据、模型架构或预训练 recipe 相关的因果分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Imperial College London。Alessio Lomuscio 在多智能体系统与形式化验证方向较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether LLMs in RAG settings still produce intrinsic hallucinations under semantically equivalent query reformulations.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly an evaluation and robustness framework: using semantics-preserving adversarial rewrites to elicit intrinsic hallucinations. The direct pretraining takeaway is limited, but it is useful as evidence that retrieval does not erase internal model priors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method performs adversarial optimization over natural query variants while enforcing semantic equivalence and optimizing for intrinsic hallucination, across white-box, gray-box, and black-box attack settings.
summary_en.experiments: Five open-source and five proprietary generator models are tested on three datasets. The headline result is that even strong models remain vulnerable under semantically equivalent perturbations, but the paper does not connect this to pretraining data, architecture, or optimization choices.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Imperial College London. Alessio Lomuscio is well known in multi-agent systems and formal methods.

recommendation.zh: 这是个干净的鲁棒性 stress test，不是基座方法论文；若你做 RAG 或 hallucination eval，只看攻击构造和失败案例即可。
recommendation.en: This is a clean robustness stress test, not a foundation-model method paper; if you care about RAG or hallucination eval, just read the attack construction and failure cases.

paper.title: Distractor-Aware Truncation: Disentangling Context-Length Effects from Signal Loss in Long-Context LLM Benchmarks
paper.abstract: A standard claim in the literature on retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented language models is that shorter context is better when the relevant information is preserved. We test this claim by running every sample of two long-context benchmarks -- BABILong and GraphWalks (BFS) -- at four context-retention fractions (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) under two truncation protocols. The first is the naive protocol implicitly used in much prior work: drop content from the middle of the prompt. The second is d

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 benchmark 中“上下文越短越好”的结论，究竟来自上下文长度本身，还是来自朴素截断把任务相关信号也删掉了？
summary.importance: 评测协议/原理分析贡献：通过 distractor-aware 截断把上下文长度效应与信号丢失解耦，直接质疑 RAG/记忆增强 LM 中常见短上下文偏好的实验解释。
summary.technical_approach: 在 BABILong 和 GraphWalks (BFS) 上对每个样本按 100%/75%/50%/25% 四种保留比例运行；对比朴素中段截断与只删除任务无关干扰项的 distractor-aware 截断；并用 MRCR v2、Oolong 做扩展验证。
summary.experiments: 评估 Claude Haiku 4.5、Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.7 以及 GPT-5.5；朴素截断下分数随保留比例单调显著下降（8 个 BABILong/GraphWalks cell 的配对 Wilcoxon、Holm 校正 p_adj<0.05），而 distractor-aware 截断下表现不同，摘要未完整给出后半句结果。
summary.authors_note: 论文仅列出单一作者 Mohsen Arjmandi，未披露机构信息；使用 Claude 与 GPT 系列商用模型做评估。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context benchmarks, does the claimed “shorter context is better” effect come from context length itself, or from naive truncation accidentally removing task-relevant signal?
summary_en.importance: Evaluation-protocol/analytical contribution: it disentangles context-length effects from signal loss using distractor-aware truncation, directly challenging the common interpretation that shorter contexts are preferable in RAG- and memory-augmented LMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It runs every sample of BABILong and GraphWalks (BFS) at four retention fractions (100%, 75%, 50%, 25%) under two truncation protocols: naive middle dropping, as implicitly used in prior work, and distractor-aware truncation that identifies task-relevant content and drops only the rest; MRCR v2 and Oolong are used for additional validation.
summary_en.experiments: It evaluates Claude Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7, and GPT-5.5. Under naive truncation, scores collapse monotonically (paired Wilcoxon, Holm-corrected p_adj<0.05 in all eight BABILong and GraphWalks cells); under distractor-aware truncation the behavior differs, though the abstract is truncated before reporting the full result.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper lists a single author, Mohsen Arjmandi, with no institutional affiliation disclosed; it evaluates commercial Claude and GPT models.

recommendation.zh: 这是长上下文评测里少有的把“长度效应”和“信号丢失”拆开的干净干预，结论会影响 RAG 截断策略；重点看两种截断协议的对照。
recommendation.en: A rare clean intervention separating length effects from signal loss in long-context eval; the two-protocol comparison matters for RAG truncation choices.

paper.title: MemArena: An Ego-Centric Benchmark for On-Device Agentic Personal Memory Assistants at Scale
paper.abstract: Edge-deployed personal memory assistants must handle private interpersonal conversations on-device with open-weight models. Yet, existing memory benchmarks often under-test the combination of activity-dense interaction, ego-centric perspective, and coherent multi-session worlds. MemArena fills these gaps with a single-world conversational benchmark built with its MASim agent simulator, for 50 agents over 15 days (10.3M dialog-text tokens, 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens/agent/day). With the

summary.core_problem: 评估端侧个人记忆 agent 在长时间、多会话、多人互动世界中进行回忆、推理和权限敏感访问的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory benchmark。它把记忆评测从短上下文问答扩展到 ego-centric、activity-dense、多 session 的个人世界，对长程记忆系统和 RAG 后端选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemArena，并使用 MASim agent simulator 构造一个单一连贯世界：50 个 agent 互动 15 天，为每个 ego agent 生成可观察对话历史，同时自动生成六类 recall、reasoning、trustworthiness ground truth。评测不同 reader LLM 与不同 memory backend 的组合。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 10.3M dialog-text tokens，每个 agent 每天约 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens。评估五个开源 reader，搭配 Vanilla context、BM25-RAG、Oracle retrieval、Memobase、MemSearch。摘要报告 Qwen3-0.6B 上 Memobase 到 MemSearch 带来 +32.5/+19.2 pp，超过仅扩大 reader 带来的 +10.6/+6.8 pp；权限感知访问在所有设置中失败。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注为 Cohere 相关工作；摘要中未给出更完整的作者团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates on-device personal memory agents that must recall, reason, and handle permission-sensitive access across dense multi-session interpersonal histories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory benchmark contribution. It moves memory evaluation beyond short-context QA into ego-centric, activity-dense, coherent multi-session worlds, which is relevant for long-term memory systems and RAG backend design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemArena uses the MASim agent simulator to create a single coherent world with 50 agents over 15 days. It produces ego-observed conversation histories and co-generates ground truth over six recall, reasoning, and trustworthiness dimensions. It evaluates reader LLMs under different memory backends.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 10.3M dialog-text tokens and about 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens per agent per day. Five open-weight readers are tested with Vanilla context, BM25-RAG, Oracle retrieval, Memobase, and MemSearch. On Qwen3-0.6B, moving from Memobase to MemSearch gives +32.5/+19.2 pp, larger than reader scaling with MemSearch at +10.6/+6.8 pp; permission-aware access fails universally.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is marked as Cohere-related; the abstract does not provide more detailed author background.

recommendation.zh: 只看 memory backend 对比和权限失败结果；它提醒别把长记忆问题简化成 reader scaling。
recommendation.en: Read the memory-backend comparison and permission-failure result; it is a useful warning against reducing long-term memory to reader scaling.

paper.title: DenialRAG: Single-Document RAG Poisoning via Embedded Parametric Denial
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to corpus poisoning: an attacker who inserts a crafted document into the retrieval corpus can steer the underlying large language model (LLM) toward an attacker-chosen wrong answer. Prior single-document attacks typically avoid explicitly naming and refuting the correct answer inside the poisoned passage. In this paper, we examine a complementary design and propose \emph{DenialRAG}, a single-document poisoning attack that explicitly nam

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：单篇投毒文档能否在 RAG 中通过“显式提到正确答案并否定它”的方式，诱导生成模型输出攻击者指定的错误答案。以往单文档投毒通常回避正确答案，担心触发模型参数知识；这篇工作反过来把正确答案和错误答案放进同一段检索上下文，并在局部语境里完成冲突解释。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 LLM 安全、RAG 可靠性和数据层攻击面有明确参考价值。它说明 RAG 的脆弱性不只是“检索到了假信息”，还包括上下文内部的论证结构会改变模型对参数知识和检索证据的权重。对基座和 post-training 研究的启发是，模型需要更强的冲突证据处理能力：当上下文先承认一个正确事实，再给出看似合理的否定理由时，模型是否会把局部叙事当作更高优先级证据。这个问题和事实性训练、拒答训练、上下文忠实性、引用校验都有关系。
summary.technical_approach: DenialRAG 的攻击设定是单文档 corpus poisoning。攻击者只能向知识库插入一段短文本，不控制模型、retriever、system prompt 或用户会话。标准 RAG 流程中，retriever 根据用户问题取 top-k 文档，generator 在 system prompt、query 和 retrieved passages 条件下生成答案。DenialRAG 构造的投毒段落包含三个要素：先显式命名正确答案 X；随后否定 X，解释为什么它不应被采信；最后给出攻击者目标答案 Y，并提供支持 Y 的局部解释。它与 PoisonedRAG 直接断言 Y、AuthChain 伪造权威引用、CorruptRAG 用“新旧信息更新”叙事替换 X 的区别在于，DenialRAG 不回避冲突，而是把冲突嵌入模型可见上下文并当场解决。这种设计利用了 instruction-tuned LLM 对上下文解释和局部一致性的偏好。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个开放域 QA 数据集、八个目标 LLM、四个已发表单文档投毒基线，以及五种 inference-time 防御。防御范围包括修改 query、prompt、retrieved context 或 final answer。结果不是某一个攻击或防御在所有设置下占优，而是强烈依赖模型、数据集和防御组合。DenialRAG 在多个目标 LLM 上有效，并且在若干防御下仍有非零攻击效果；但其他攻击在不同模型 regime 中也可能更强。组件消融显示，embedded denial 是测试组件中影响最大的部分。跨 regime 稳定性分析显示，不同投毒机制随着模型组变化会以不同速度失效，说明 RAG poisoning 不能只用单一攻击模板评估。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 threat model，确认攻击者能力是否现实：单文档、黑盒、只控制 corpus。方法部分关注投毒文本模板中 X、否定理由、Y 的组织方式，以及它和 PoisonedRAG、AuthChain、CorruptRAG 的机制差异。实验部分优先看各模型上的 attack success rate、五类防御后的变化，以及 component ablation。对预训练研究者，最有用的是 ablation 和跨模型稳定性：它们能帮助判断模型是在依赖参数知识、检索证据，还是被上下文内的冲突叙事牵引。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a single poisoned RAG document can be more effective by explicitly naming the correct answer and then denying it, instead of avoiding the correct answer as prior single-document attacks often do. The attack places the correct answer and the attacker-chosen wrong answer in the same retrieved passage, then resolves the local conflict in favor of the wrong answer.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to LLM reliability and the data-layer attack surface of RAG systems. The main lesson is that RAG failures are not only caused by retrieving false content; the rhetorical structure inside the retrieved context also matters. A model may overweight a local explanation that acknowledges and dismisses its parametric knowledge. This connects to factuality training, context-faithfulness training, refusal behavior, citation checking, and model behavior under conflicting evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DenialRAG is framed as single-document corpus poisoning. The attacker can insert one short passage into the knowledge base but does not control the model, retriever, system prompt, or user session. In a standard RAG pipeline, the retriever returns top-k passages for a query, and the generator answers conditioned on the system prompt, query, and retrieved passages. The poisoned passage has three parts: it names the correct answer X, explains why X should be rejected, and presents the attacker-controlled answer Y with a supporting explanation. This differs from PoisonedRAG, which directly asserts Y; AuthChain, which fabricates authority or citations; and CorruptRAG, which frames Y as a newer correction to older sources. DenialRAG makes the conflict visible to the generator and resolves it inside the same context, exploiting the model’s tendency to follow locally coherent retrieved evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans three open-domain QA datasets, eight target LLMs, four published single-document poisoning baselines, and five inference-time defenses that alter the query, prompt, retrieved context, or final answer. The results show strong mechanism dependence: no attack or defense is uniformly strongest across all models, datasets, and settings. DenialRAG is highly effective on several target LLMs and remains nontrivial under multiple defenses, while other attacks dominate in some model regimes. Component ablations identify the embedded denial as the most influential tested component. Cross-regime stability analysis shows that different poisoning mechanisms degrade at different rates across model groups.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the threat model to verify the practical assumptions: one poisoned document, black-box access, and control only over the corpus. Then read the method section for the passage template and the role of X, the denial rationale, and Y. Compare it with PoisonedRAG, AuthChain, and CorruptRAG to understand the mechanism-level differences. In the experiments, focus on attack success across the eight models, robustness under the five defenses, and the component ablation. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful parts are the ablation and stability analyses, because they reveal when models rely on parametric knowledge, retrieved evidence, or local conflict resolution in context.

recommendation.zh: 关于 RAG 鲁棒性和 LLM 处理冲突上下文机制的有趣研究，显式否定（Denial）策略的有效性值得关注，建议扫读方法和实验结果。
recommendation.en: Interesting study on RAG robustness and LLM mechanisms for handling conflicting contexts; the effectiveness of the explicit denial strategy is worth noting; skim the method and results.

paper.title: Training Documents Reranker with Search Rubrics for Deep Research Agent
paper.abstract: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-qualit

summary.core_problem: 为 deep research agent 选择文档时，单篇相关性最高的 top-k 文档不一定组成满足复杂信息需求的文档集合。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向研究型 Agent 的检索重排训练方法。它把“好文档集合”的要求显式写成 search rubrics，并用这些 rubrics 驱动 SFT 和 RL；对通用 Agent 的检索质量控制有参考价值，但不是基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 使用强 LLM 合成层级化 search-oriented rubrics，明确文档集合应满足的要求，例如多样性、简洁性和权威性。随后训练 RubricRanker：第一阶段做 rubrics-guided supervised fine-tuning，第二阶段做 rubric-based reinforcement learning。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 RubricRanker 在 extensive experiments 中优于现有重排方法，但未给出具体数据集、模型参数、baseline 列表或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles document selection for deep research agents, where individually relevant top-k documents may not form a set that satisfies complex agent queries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a retrieval reranking training method for research agents. It makes set-level document requirements explicit through search rubrics and uses them for SFT and RL. This is relevant to agent retrieval quality, but not to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A strong LLM synthesizes hierarchical search-oriented rubrics that specify properties such as diversity, conciseness, and authority. RubricRanker is then trained with rubric-guided supervised fine-tuning followed by rubric-based reinforcement learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that RubricRanker outperforms existing methods in extensive experiments, but does not provide datasets, model sizes, baseline details, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China.

recommendation.zh: Agent 检索里“集合质量”比单篇相关性更接近真实瓶颈；只看 rubric 构造和 RL 奖励即可。
recommendation.en: Set quality is the right bottleneck for research-agent retrieval; read the rubric construction and RL reward, skip most leaderboard claims.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space Models (SSMs) avoid the second cost by construction; we eliminate the first, collapsing prefill from $O(L_{context})$ to $O(1)$ per query. We introduce PRECOG (Pre-Computed Context Injection), a retrieval mechanism that exploits a property unique to SSMs: the fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent

summary.core_problem: RAG 在 Transformer 上需要 O(L) 的 prefill 代价来重新摄入检索到的上下文，且 KV-cache 随上下文线性增长。论文利用 SSM 固定大小、位置无关的循环隐状态，将文档语料预编码为状态并在查询时直接注入，把 prefill 从 O(L) 降到 O(1)。
summary.importance: 对架构研究的价值在于揭示了 SSM 一个结构性优势：时间平移不变性使得预计算状态可以无损注入，这在带位置编码的 Transformer 上根本不成立。Theorem 1 证明了 PRECOG 与 in-context RAG 产生完全相同的状态轨迹，这不是经验近似而是数学保证。这一性质对检索增强、持久记忆、上下文复用等场景有架构层面的启发，也为 SSM vs. Transformer 的比较提供了一个新的维度——不仅是推理效率，更是状态可组合性。论文的边缘部署定位不影响其核心洞察的通用性。
summary.technical_approach: PRECOG 离线对每个文档 chunk 运行 SSM 语言模型，捕获逐层隐状态；查询时通过轻量 embedding 索引检索最匹配的状态，直接作为模型循环状态的初始条件注入。由于 SSM 递推具有时间平移不变性（Δt 和 B 仅依赖当前 token，A 固定），预计算状态与在查询开头重新摄入该 chunk 达到的状态完全一致。同一机制无法迁移到 Transformer：RoPE 或绝对位置编码使 KV-cache 位置纠缠，预计算 cache 在其他位置失效；即使忽略位置问题，3000-token 上下文的 Transformer KV-cache 存储量约为 SSM 隐状态的 500 倍。论文还提出 SMC（Structured Memory Consolidation），将历史交互状态组织为分层持久记忆，按认知域聚类、两级检索、可调保真度-存储权衡，会话初始化保持 O(1)。
summary.experiments: 在 TENNs-LLM（1.2B 参数，24 层 gated selective SSM，d=2048，N=4096，总隐状态 192KB at FP16）上实例化。领域问答任务上 PRECOG 与 in-context RAG 质量持平（数学保证一致），部署目标上 prefill 延迟从约 27s 降至 <6ms，约 4500 倍加速。存储对比：3000-token chunk 的 SSM 隐状态远小于等效 Transformer KV-cache（约 500 倍差异）。SMC 部分报告了分层记忆的经验行为，但全文未提供大规模通用 benchmark 上的对比，实验主要面向边缘部署场景。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Section 2 的 Theorem 1 及其证明思路——这是全文最有价值的部分，解释了为什么状态注入在 SSM 上是精确的而在 Transformer 上不可行。Introduction 中关于 KV-cache 位置纠缠的讨论也值得读。TENNs-LLM 架构细节和 SMC 部分可快速浏览。预计阅读时间 25-35 分钟。对架构方向研究者，建议思考：这种状态可注入性是否可以推广到混合 SSM-Transformer 架构（如 Jamba），以及预编码状态的检索质量如何评估。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队未在提供内容中明确列出机构信息，涉及 TENNs-LLM 和神经形态边缘处理器部署，相关专利申请中。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG on Transformers incurs O(L) prefill cost to re-ingest retrieved context, and the KV-cache grows linearly with context. The paper exploits the SSM's fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent hidden state to pre-encode document corpora as states and inject them directly at query time, reducing prefill from O(L) to O(1).
summary_en.importance: The architectural value lies in a structural advantage of SSMs: time-translation invariance enables lossless state injection, which is fundamentally impossible for Transformers with positional encodings. Theorem 1 proves that PRECOG and in-context RAG produce identical state trajectories—a mathematical guarantee, not an empirical approximation. This property has implications for retrieval augmentation, persistent memory, and context reuse, and adds a new dimension to SSM vs. Transformer comparisons: not just inference efficiency but state composability. The edge-deployment framing does not diminish the generality of the core insight.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRECOG offline-encodes each document chunk by running the SSM language model over it and capturing per-layer hidden states. At query time, a lightweight embedding index retrieves the best-matching state, which is injected directly as the initial condition of the model's recurrent state. Because the SSM recurrence is time-translation invariant (Δt and B depend only on the current token; A is fixed), the pre-computed state is identical to what the model would reach by ingesting the chunk at the start of the query. The same mechanism fails for Transformers: RoPE or absolute positional encodings make the KV-cache position-entangled, so a pre-computed cache is invalid at other positions; even setting position aside, a Transformer KV-cache for 3000 tokens requires roughly 500× more storage than the SSM hidden state. The paper also proposes SMC (Structured Memory Consolidation), which organizes states from past interactions into a hierarchical persistent memory with cognitive-domain clustering, two-level retrieval, and an adjustable fidelity-storage dial, keeping session initialization O(1).
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated on TENNs-LLM (1.2B parameters, 24-layer gated selective SSM, d=2048, N=4096, total hidden state 192KB at FP16). On domain-specific QA, PRECOG matches in-context RAG quality (mathematically guaranteed identical), with prefill latency reduced from ~27s to <6ms on the deployment target—a ~4500× speedup. Storage comparison: the SSM hidden state for a 3000-token chunk is roughly 500× smaller than an equivalent Transformer KV-cache. The SMC section reports empirical behavior of hierarchical memory, but the paper lacks large-scale general-benchmark comparisons; experiments are oriented toward edge deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 2, Theorem 1 and its proof sketch—the most valuable part, explaining why state injection is exact on SSMs but infeasible on Transformers. The introduction's discussion of KV-cache position entanglement is also worth reading. The TENNs-LLM architecture details and SMC section can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. For architecture researchers, a useful follow-up question: can this state injectability extend to hybrid SSM-Transformer architectures (e.g., Jamba), and how should retrieval quality over pre-encoded states be evaluated?
summary_en.authors_note: Author affiliations not explicitly identified in the provided content; involves TENNs-LLM and neuromorphic edge processor deployment, with a related patent pending.

recommendation.zh: 思路新颖：利用SSM隐状态做O(1)上下文注入跳过prefill，需验证隐状态注入的性能损失与位置对齐问题，重点看方法章节
recommendation.en: Novel idea of O(1) context injection via SSM hidden states to skip prefill entirely; verify performance degradation and position alignment, focus on the method section

paper.title: Gradient-free Task-Conditioned Retrieval for On-Device In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: On-device in-context learning (ICL) relies on pre-inference retrieval to select demonstrations for useful context before downstream model inference. This retrieval must exploit task-specific information while operating over local memories under limited computation, memory, and data-exposure budgets. We propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment (CoRA), a gradient-free framework that converts a frozen encoder into a task-conditioned retriever using paired candidate inputs and outputs. CoRA selects c

summary.core_problem: 在端侧 ICL 场景中，如何在不能训练模型、计算和隐私预算有限的条件下，为当前任务检索更合适的 demonstrations。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/ICL 检索方法改进。它不直接改变预训练方法，但触及一个有用问题：上下文示例选择是否能用轻量闭式方法获得任务条件化，而不依赖梯度更新或在线访问输出标签。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Conditional Retrieval Alignment，简称 CoRA。方法冻结 encoder，用候选输入-输出对构造任务条件空间；选择互补 encoder 层，通过闭式 ridge regression 将候选输入表示对齐到由输出派生的空间；再用低秩分解得到紧凑检索基。候选输出只在离线建索引时使用，查询时只需输入和预计算索引。
summary.experiments: 摘要称给出了 rank-constrained basis 的最优低秩压缩性质，并在端侧 ICL 检索任务中验证。公开摘要未提供具体任务、模型、设备预算、baseline 或提升幅度，需要正文确认是否只是 retrieval reranking 的常规增量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses task-specific demonstration retrieval for on-device ICL under frozen-model, limited-compute, limited-memory, and data-exposure constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a retrieval method for RAG/ICL. It does not directly affect pretraining, but it is relevant to how lightweight task conditioning can be obtained without gradient updates or online access to candidate labels.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Conditional Retrieval Alignment, or CoRA. A frozen encoder is adapted by using paired candidate inputs and outputs: complementary encoder layers are selected, an output-derived conditioning space is built, input representations are aligned to that space via closed-form ridge regression, and low-rank factorization yields a compact retrieval basis. Candidate outputs are used only during offline indexing; query-time retrieval uses only the input and precomputed index.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states an optimal low-rank compression result for the rank-constrained basis and reports empirical validation for on-device ICL retrieval. It does not provide task lists, model sizes, hardware budgets, baselines, or gains, so the full paper is needed to judge whether the result is more than incremental reranking.

recommendation.zh: 作为端侧 ICL 检索备查即可；重点看 ridge 对齐的闭式推导，实验若缺少强 retriever baseline 就别过度解读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for on-device ICL retrieval; read the closed-form ridge alignment, but do not overread the results without strong retriever baselines.

paper.title: TCA-SIR: Learning Target-Conditioned Abstractions for Scientific Inspiration Retrieval
paper.abstract: Scientific hypothesis generation for AI for Science typically involves Scientific Inspiration Retrieval (SIR) followed by hypothesis composition. Existing SIR methods rank papers by topical similarity and do not explicitly represent how a candidate inspiration transfers to a target problem. This is especially limiting for remote inspirations, whose value often lies in reusable problem-solving principles rather than topical overlap. Motivated by how humans abstract transferable aspects of a sourc

summary.core_problem: 现有科学灵感检索方法仅按主题相似度排序，无法显式表示候选灵感向目标问题的可迁移性，限制了跨领域远程灵感的利用
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将科学灵感检索重构为目标条件抽象任务，聚焦可迁移问题求解原理而非主题重叠
summary.technical_approach: 提出TCA-SIR框架，学习针对目标问题从候选论文中抽取出可迁移的抽象原则，基于抽象原则的表示预测迁移性并用于检索排序
summary.experiments: 在ResearchBench数据集上优于现有SIR方法和直接LLM检索，较MOOSE-Chem的HitRate@top4%提升超过10个百分点

summary_en.core_problem: Existing scientific inspiration retrieval methods only rank papers by topical similarity, failing to explicitly represent transferability of candidate inspirations to target problems, which limits utilization of cross-domain remote inspirations
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first reformulation of scientific inspiration retrieval as target-conditioned abstraction task, focusing on transferable problem-solving principles rather than topical overlap
summary_en.technical_approach: TCA-SIR framework learns to generate target-conditioned transferable abstract principles from candidate papers, then predicts transferability based on abstraction representations for retrieval ranking
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms prior SIR methods and direct LLM retrieval on ResearchBench, improving HitRate@top4% by over 10 percentage points over MOOSE-Chem

recommendation.zh: 科学检索领域的特定方法，目标条件抽象的思路可作为通用RAG优化的弱信号，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Domain-specific scientific retrieval method; the target-conditioned abstraction idea serves as a weak signal for general RAG optimization, no need to read full text.

paper.title: WikiLoop: Jointly Learning to Build and Navigate Agent-Native Wikis with Downstream Feedback
paper.abstract: Knowledge-base construction and querying are typically optimized in isolation: retrieval-augmented agents operate over a fixed, externally maintained index, whereas construction receives no signal from downstream use. We present WikiLoop, a feedback-coupled framework that jointly learns to build and navigate an agent-native Wiki, a persistent linked-page knowledge base designed for machine navigation. A role-conditioned shared policy supports two interfaces: a Navigator retrieves evidence from t

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是知识库构建与检索式 agent 使用之间脱节的问题：现有 RAG 或 tool-use agent 通常在固定索引上检索，而知识库构建过程并不直接接收下游问答成功率的反馈。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不属于基座预训练核心论文，但对 post-train、agent memory、外部知识状态的训练信号设计有启发。它关心的不是单次检索排序，而是持久化知识库如何被 agent 使用反馈持续改写。对预训练研究员比较有用的部分是 reward 设计和 credit assignment：如何让一个结构化 memory 的编辑获得可归因的下游效用信号，同时避免只优化目标 query 而损害其他 query。
summary.technical_approach: WikiLoop 使用 agent-native Wiki 作为持久状态。Wiki 由结构化页面、页面间链接、以及指向源文档的 provenance 组成。系统中有两个角色：Navigator 通过 search、read、follow links 等动作收集证据并回答问题；Builder 接收新 source 与当前 Wiki 状态，输出 schema-constrained patch，用于创建或修改页面、链接和 provenance。两者由同一个 role-conditioned policy 支持，但保留不同的 prompt、状态、动作空间和 reward。训练流程是先做 Joint SFT 初始化两个接口，再做 Navigator RL，然后用 frozen Navigator 作为 evaluator 做 Builder RL，最后在 role-homogeneous batches 上做 Joint RL 以减轻角色间干扰。Navigator 的目标采用 sufficiency-before-efficiency：先保证证据覆盖充分，再施加检索成本惩罚，避免模型为了少检索而提前停止。Builder 的目标采用 guarded utility difference：对每个候选 edit，构造 affected queries 与 guard queries，在 edit 前后的隔离 Wiki 状态上用 frozen Navigator 评估下游效用变化；affected queries 衡量收益，guard queries 检测无关问题退化。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 Qwen3.5-9B。AuthTrace 上 WikiLoop 达到 62.6 All AC，相比 Joint SFT 高 4.4 分，相比 LLM-Wiki base 高 6.3 分。训练轨迹显示，Navigator AC 从 Joint SFT 后的 58.2 提升到 NAV-RL 后的 60.4；经过 BUILD-RL 后略降到 59.7；Joint RL 后恢复并提升到 60.8，说明共享策略中两个角色会互相干扰，需要最后的联合阶段重新协调。论文还报告了同 backbone 在 HotpotQA 和 MuSiQue 上的 zero-shot 迁移，以及更大规模模型结果，用于验证方法是否只是在 AuthTrace 上过拟合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Method，弄清楚 Wiki 状态、Navigator 动作、Builder patch 三者的接口。重点读两个 reward：Navigator 的 sufficiency-gated cost penalty，以及 Builder 的 guarded utility-difference scoring。实验部分优先看 AuthTrace 主表、训练 lineage 表、guard query 消融和 held-out Navigator 评估。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过任务细节，把注意力放在“持久外部状态如何用下游反馈训练”这一类信号设计上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the mismatch between knowledge-base construction and downstream agent use. Retrieval-augmented agents usually operate over a fixed index or externally maintained structure, while the construction process receives little direct feedback from whether downstream navigation and answering actually improve.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training, agent memory, and feedback design for persistent external state. The useful idea is the credit-assignment setup: edits to a structured memory should be scored by their marginal downstream utility, while also checking whether they harm unrelated queries. That framing is more informative than optimizing a retriever or a summarizer in isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: WikiLoop represents external knowledge as an agent-native Wiki containing structured pages, inter-page links, and provenance to source passages. A Navigator searches, reads pages, follows links, accumulates evidence, and answers questions. A Builder proposes schema-constrained patches that create or revise pages, links, and provenance. Both roles are implemented by a shared role-conditioned policy, but with separate prompts, states, actions, and rewards. The training schedule starts with Joint SFT, then applies Navigator RL, Builder RL with a frozen Navigator evaluator, and finally Joint RL over role-homogeneous batches. The Navigator objective uses a sufficiency-before-efficiency rule: retrieval-cost pressure is applied only after evidence coverage is complete, reducing premature stopping. The Builder objective uses guarded utility differences. Each candidate edit is evaluated on affected queries and guard queries by comparing isolated before-and-after Wiki states under a frozen Navigator; affected queries measure target benefit, while guard queries penalize regressions.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen3.5-9B. On AuthTrace, WikiLoop reaches 62.6 All AC, improving over Joint SFT by 4.4 points and over LLM-Wiki base by 6.3 points. The training trajectory is informative: Navigator AC is 58.2 after Joint SFT, rises to 60.4 after NAV-RL, drops to 59.7 after BUILD-RL, and recovers to 60.8 after Joint RL. This supports the claim that shared-policy roles interfere and need a consolidation stage. The paper also reports same-backbone zero-shot transfer to HotpotQA and MuSiQue, plus larger-scale results, to test whether the learned construction/navigation loop generalizes beyond the main benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should focus on the framework rather than dataset details. Start with Figure 1 and the method section to understand the interfaces among Wiki state, Navigator actions, and Builder patches. Then read the two reward designs: sufficiency-gated navigation and guarded utility-difference scoring. In experiments, prioritize the AuthTrace main table, the training-lineage table, guard-query ablations, and held-out Navigator evaluation. For base-model research, the main takeaway is how downstream feedback can train persistent external memory, not the specific QA benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统定义和 Builder 打分机制即可；它对预训练无直接动作，但长期记忆的数据闭环设计值得记一笔。
recommendation.en: Skim the system formulation and Builder scoring; it does not change pretraining practice, but the memory-feedback loop is worth noting.

paper.title: Filesystem-Based Memory for LLM Agents: Organization, Evolution, and Sustainability
paper.abstract: Deployed LLM agents increasingly keep their long-term memory as a filesystem: a directory tree of markdown files that the agent itself reads, writes, and reorganizes through generic file tools. Yet research has largely passed over this medium: prior systems design bespoke memory representations and study retrieval over them, leaving the default's two working assumptions untested: that an agent can keep a growing store organized as memories accumulate, conflict, and go stale, and that this organi

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM Agent 把长期记忆存成文件系统时，目录、Markdown 文件和技能记录能否在长期增长、冲突和过期信息下保持可用。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 长期记忆介质的系统化分析。它不是基座预训练问题，但触及现实 Agent 部署中最常见、却很少被严格评估的记忆表示。
summary.technical_approach: 把文件系统记忆形式化为围绕同一 memory filesystem 的三类角色：management agent 负责整合和组织新内容，search agent 负责带引用地回答查询，execution agent 产生任务轨迹并蒸馏为技能。系统把陈述性记忆和技能统一放入同一个文件存储，并比较不同 memory shape 的效果。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在长对话 benchmark 和 embodied tasks 上评估，并改变记忆形状、组织方式和演化策略；未给出具体模型、任务数量、数据规模和结果幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UIUC、UC San Diego、UC Merced、Adobe Research 和 Texas A&M University；Julian McAuley 是推荐系统和信息检索方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLM agents can maintain useful long-term memory when the memory is simply a filesystem of directories and Markdown files that grows, conflicts, and becomes stale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic study of a practical agent-memory substrate. It is not foundation-model pretraining, but it examines a default representation used in many deployed agents yet rarely evaluated cleanly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setting is formalized around three roles sharing one memory filesystem: a management agent integrates and organizes new content, a search agent answers queries with cited sources, and an execution agent produces task trajectories that are distilled into reusable skills. Declarative memories and skills are stored in one filesystem, and different memory shapes are varied.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on long-conversation benchmarks and embodied tasks while varying memory organization and evolution, but does not provide model names, task counts, data size, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UIUC, UC San Diego, UC Merced, Adobe Research, and Texas A&M University. Julian McAuley is a well-known researcher in recommender systems and information retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 记忆工程备查即可；问题设得干净，但离基座训练较远，不需要读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-memory engineering reference; the setup is clean, but it is far from base-model training and not worth a full read.

paper.title: RAGuard: A Layered Defense Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems Against Data Poisoning
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) in external corpora, but this reliance exposes them to corpus poisoning: maliciously injected passages that manipulate retrieved evidence. We introduce RAGuard, a layered defense against \emph{factual} corpus-poisoning attacks on RAG pipelines. The first layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, and reasoning traps), teaching it to downrank ma

summary.core_problem: RAG系统依赖外部语料，易受事实型语料投毒攻击，恶意段落被检索后操纵模型输出。
summary.importance: 系统创新：提出双层防御框架RAGuard，结合检索端对抗训练与生成端无监督黑盒过滤。
summary.technical_approach: 第一层用合成投毒文档（伪造事实、矛盾、推理陷阱）对抗微调稠密检索器，降低恶意段落排序；第二层ZKIP对每个检索文档做留一解码，通过语义偏移与输出熵变化打分，无需投毒标签、真值答案或模型内部权限。
summary.experiments: 在5%-30%投毒比例的Natural Questions数据集上测试，对比基线RAG管线，两层防御联合显著降低投毒攻击成功率。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG systems are vulnerable to factual corpus poisoning, where maliciously injected passages are retrieved and manipulate LLM outputs.
summary_en.importance: Systems contribution: a layered defense framework RAGuard combining retrieval-side adversarial fine-tuning and generation-side unsupervised black-box filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: First layer adversarially fine-tunes a dense retriever on synthetic poisoned documents (fabricated facts, contradictions, reasoning traps) to downrank malicious passages; second layer ZKIP performs leave-one-out decoding per document and scores via semantic shift and output entropy change, requiring no poison labels, ground truth, or model internals.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Natural Questions with 5–30% poison ratios; the combined two-layer defense substantially reduces attack success rate against baseline RAG pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 属于RAG安全的应用型防御方案，对预训练研究员无直接方法启发，了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: An applied RAG security defense with no direct methodological insights for pretraining researchers; worth knowing the high-level idea only.

paper.title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
paper.abstract: Wikipedia and Wikidata are widely used for information access, LLM pre-training, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their knowledge is deeply connected but scattered across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. This raises a practical question: when these modalities disagree, how can we detect and explain the conflict? We study this problem as \emph{modality-level inconsistency detection}. We first introduce a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies, covering information granularity dif

summary.core_problem: 检测 Wikipedia 文本、表格和 Wikidata 知识图谱之间的知识不一致，并解释冲突类型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是数据质量与知识一致性分析。由于 Wikipedia/Wikidata 常用于 LLM 预训练和 RAG，这类跨模态冲突会影响事实性、检索证据质量和数据清洗策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出跨模态知识不一致 taxonomy，覆盖信息粒度差异、直接冲突、时间变化和知识图谱不完整；构建 Kontrast 框架，结合 Text-to-SPARQL 和 LLM reasoning，将表格问答得到的答案与 KG 证据比较并分类。
summary.experiments: 在多个 Table-QA 数据集上实验，发现跨模态不一致普遍存在且包含不同来源：真实知识冲突、缺失的 KG 结构、时间错配等。摘要也指出该框架受 Text-to-SPARQL 质量限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper detects and explains knowledge inconsistencies across Wikipedia text, tables, and Wikidata knowledge graphs.
summary_en.importance: This is a data-quality and knowledge-consistency contribution. Since Wikipedia and Wikidata are widely used for LLM pretraining and RAG, such cross-modal conflicts matter for factuality, retrieval evidence quality, and data-cleaning policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies, including granularity mismatch, direct conflict, temporal change, and KG incompleteness. They introduce Kontrast, which combines Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-derived answers with KG evidence and categorize inconsistencies.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on several Table-QA datasets show that cross-modal inconsistencies are common and informative. They expose true knowledge conflicts, missing KG structure, and temporal mismatches, while the framework remains limited by Text-to-SPARQL quality.

recommendation.zh: 作为预训练数据清洗的弱信号可留档；方法依赖 Text-to-SPARQL，别把冲突率直接当语料质量指标。
recommendation.en: Worth filing as a weak signal for pretraining-data cleaning; Text-to-SPARQL dependence makes raw conflict rates unsafe as corpus-quality metrics.

paper.title: Beyond Self-Knowledge: Propagating Uncertainty Across Reasoning and Retrieval in LLMs
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation improves knowledge-intensive question answering, but indiscriminate retrieval can introduce irrelevant evidence and unnecessary computation. We investigate whether verbalized confidence from black-box language models can serve as an actionable signal for retrieval routing. Our method, BeyondUncertainty, first elicits a structured provisional answer and confidence estimate, then applies a model-specific threshold selected on held-out validation data and frozen befor

summary.core_problem: RAG中无差别检索会引入无关证据和不必要计算，缺乏有效的检索路由信号来动态判断是否需要执行检索
summary.importance: 增量方法创新，验证黑盒LLM的自报告置信度可作为检索路由的可操作信号
summary.technical_approach: 提出BeyondUncertainty方法，首先生成结构化临时答案与置信度估计，在验证集上选择模型特定的阈值并冻结，低置信度问题执行top-5 TF-IDF检索后二次生成，高置信度直接返回临时答案
summary.experiments: 在6个QA基准、3个模型家族、3种检索策略上测试27000个策略实例；BeyondUncertainty平均token级F1达0.483，优于始终检索的0.467与无检索的0.401，检索段落数相对始终检索减少20.4%
summary.authors_note: 北京航空航天大学信息检索团队，无公开知名核心作者

summary_en.core_problem: Indiscriminate retrieval in RAG introduces irrelevant evidence and unnecessary computation, and there is a lack of effective routing signals to dynamically decide whether retrieval is needed
summary_en.importance: Incremental methodological contribution; validates that verbalized confidence from black-box LLMs can serve as an actionable signal for retrieval routing
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BeyondUncertainty, which first generates a structured provisional answer and confidence estimate, applies a model-specific threshold selected on held-out validation data and frozen at test time; low-confidence questions get top-5 TF-IDF retrieval followed by a second answer call, while high-confidence questions return the provisional answer directly
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 27,000 policy instances across 6 QA benchmarks, 3 model families, and 3 retrieval policies; BeyondUncertainty achieves 0.483 mean token-level F1, vs 0.467 for always-retrieve and 0.401 for no-retrieve, while reducing retrieved passages by 20.4% relative to always-retrieve
summary_en.authors_note: Information retrieval team from Beihang University; no widely known core authors identified

recommendation.zh: 用LLM自报告置信度做RAG路由的增量工作，效果提升有限，仅需了解置信度可作为路由信号的结论
recommendation.en: Incremental RAG routing work using LLM verbalized confidence with limited gains; only note the conclusion that confidence can serve as a routing signal

paper.title: TokenMem: Faithful Knowledge Injection for Frozen LLMs
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but suffers from knowledge conflicts: when retrieved information contradicts parametric memory, the shared self-attention pathway produces unpredictable outputs. We present TokenMem, a lightweight memory system that injects knowledge into frozen LLMs through a dedicated cross-attention channel, bypassing competition with parametric memory in the residual stream. TokenMem trains only a thin gating

summary.core_problem: TokenMem 解决的是冻结 LLM 在 RAG 知识冲突场景下不服从外部权威知识的问题。标准 RAG 把检索文本和用户问题拼接后送入同一条 self-attention 路径，外部知识 token 和模型已有上下文 token 共享同一个 softmax 归一化。论文认为这会造成注意力预算竞争：当模型参数中的先验很强时，检索证据即使正确、甚至被系统指定为权威，也可能被压制。作者用 Knowledge Compliance 衡量这种可控性，即在外部 passage 与参数记忆冲突时，模型是否按 passage 作答，而不是按参数记忆作答。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练 recipe 论文，但对基座研究有两个直接启发。第一，它把 RAG 失效的一部分原因归到架构通路，而不只是检索质量或提示词格式；这对设计可更新记忆、continual knowledge interface 和 posttrain 数据有参考价值。第二，它区分了“事实准确率”和“服从指定知识源”的可控性。对于需要外部写入知识的系统，KC 比普通 QA accuracy 更接近真实约束。论文还观察到 vanilla RAG 的 inverse scaling：模型越大、参数先验越强，外部知识服从性可能越差。这提醒基座模型并不天然更容易被上下文覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: TokenMem 由三部分组成。第一是 TokenMemoryBank，用 FAISS 存储和检索知识 passage。第二是在冻结 LLM 每一层加入 cross-attention adapter，把检索知识通过独立通道注入。关键点是 cross-attention 对外部知识单独做 softmax，不和原 self-attention 中的 query/context token 争同一个归一化预算。adapter 通过零初始化 gate 接入残差流，训练开始时不破坏原模型行为。第三是两阶段 CoT curriculum SFT，只训练约 3–7M 参数的薄 gate/adapter。Phase 1 训练一般知识利用能力，Phase 2 用 counterfactual knowledge 强化冲突场景下的服从。这个设计和普通 prompt-RAG 的区别在于外部知识有独立注意力通道；和模型编辑或 LoRA 微调的区别在于主模型参数保持冻结，知识更新主要发生在外部 memory 和轻量注入模块上。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个模型、3 个模型家族：Qwen3-4B/8B/14B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B。评估重点是冲突样本上的 Knowledge Compliance，使用 greedy 输出是否匹配 passage-supported answer 来计数。论文报告了几个关键现象：vanilla RAG 在知识冲突下存在参数记忆偏置，并且在更大模型上 KC 更低；仅有 cross-attention 通道还不够，Phase 1 只训练知识利用时 KC 会接近崩塌，说明架构给了容量，但训练信号必须显式覆盖反事实服从；两阶段训练后，gate adapter 会形成按冲突程度和层位置变化的注入策略。给出的材料没有包含完整表格数值，具体 KC 提升幅度、各模型分项和消融数字需要核对实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 §3.1 对标准 RAG attention 竞争的形式化描述，这是论文最有信息量的部分。然后看 cross-attention adapter 和 zero-initialized gate 的接入方式，重点判断它是否真的隔离了知识通道，还是只是在残差流中延后融合。实验部分优先看三类结果：vanilla RAG 的 inverse scaling、Phase 1/Phase 2 curriculum 消融、gate 的层级分析。若关注 continual learning 或外部知识写入，KC 指标定义也值得单独记录。

summary_en.core_problem: TokenMem addresses a specific failure mode of frozen LLMs under retrieval augmentation: when retrieved knowledge conflicts with the model’s parametric memory, the model may ignore the retrieved passage even if that passage is treated as authoritative. The paper frames this as Knowledge Compliance rather than ordinary factual accuracy. The architectural claim is that standard RAG routes retrieved tokens and query tokens through the same self-attention softmax, so external evidence competes with strong parametric priors for a fixed attention budget.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining recipe, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it studies the interface between frozen parametric knowledge and writable external memory. It also separates controllability from truthfulness: in some systems, the desired behavior is to follow the designated memory entry, even when it contradicts what the model has learned. The reported inverse-scaling behavior in vanilla RAG is an important warning: stronger parametric memory can make a model less compliant with external evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokenMem combines a FAISS-backed TokenMemoryBank, a layer-wise cross-attention adapter, and a two-phase SFT curriculum. Retrieved passages are injected through a separate cross-attention channel, with its own normalization, instead of being concatenated into the prompt and processed only by self-attention. The adapter is gated and zero-initialized, so the frozen backbone is initially preserved. Only a small adapter of roughly 3–7M parameters is trained. The curriculum first teaches general knowledge use, then trains on counterfactual conflicts to force compliance with the injected passage. This differs from prompt-only RAG by removing the direct attention-budget competition, and differs from model editing by leaving the main model weights frozen.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five models from three families: Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and OLMo-3-7B. The main metric is Knowledge Compliance on conflicting examples, measured by whether greedy decoding follows the passage-supported answer. The paper reports that vanilla RAG shows a bias toward parametric memory and that larger models can be less compliant. It also reports that Phase 1 alone is insufficient: knowledge-utilization training without explicit counterfactual compliance can drive KC close to zero even with the cross-attention channel present. The adapter analysis suggests conflict-aware and layer-specific gating behavior. Exact per-model numbers and gain sizes are not available in the supplied content and should be checked in the result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the formal argument in §3.1 about shared-softmax competition in standard RAG. Then read the adapter design, especially the separate cross-attention path and the zero-initialized gate. In the experiments, prioritize the inverse-scaling result, the two-phase curriculum ablation, and the gate/layer analysis. The Knowledge Compliance metric is worth noting for anyone working on external memory, model editing, or continual knowledge updates.

recommendation.zh: 通过外挂 Cross-Attention 旁路解决 RAG 知识冲突，思路干净且参数极小（<10M），值得关注其两阶段 Curriculum 训练策略。
recommendation.en: Solves RAG knowledge conflicts via an external Cross-Attention bypass; a clean approach with minimal parameters (<10M), worth noting its two-phase curriculum training strategy.

paper.title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
paper.abstract: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：当上下文里提供的证据与模型参数中已记住的知识（in-weight, IW）发生重叠时，现有 context attribution 方法（基于删除/扰动的敏感性度量）会把“模型本来就会”误判成“上下文不重要”，从而无法在知识层面区分 ICL 贡献与 IW 贡献，导致 attribution 分数在证据支持性判断上失真。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于改进训练，而在于把“训练数据记忆/IW 知识”作为 attribution 评测中的关键混杂因素显式化：1）提醒研究者与工程系统不要把 removal-based attribution 当作证据归因或溯源工具；2）提供一套围绕 IW/ICL 混叠的评测指标与带 provenance 标注的数据集，使得后续工作可以更严谨地讨论“模型已知 vs 上下文提供”的边界。这对训练数据重叠、记忆与可解释性/溯源评测的接口问题有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上主要做两件事：
1）把 attribution 的语义从“文本片段是否改变输出”提升到“知识是否支持正确答案”。核心观察是：删除某段上下文不改变输出，可能是因为该段无关，也可能是因为同一知识已存在于权重里；两者在 removal-based 框架下不可辨。
2）提出一套专门测 IW/ICL 混叠的评测协议与指标：
- BCS（base-model context attribution score）：用 base model（未被注入/未被强化相关 IW 知识的模型）来测上下文 attribution，作为对照，意图把“模型已知”因素最小化。
- CAC（cross-model attribution consistency）：跨模型一致性，检查当模型的 IW 知识状态变化时，attribution 排名/分数是否稳定；若方法把 IW overlap 当成 irrelevance，会表现出不合理的不一致。
- APS（attribution preservation score）：在控制 IW 知识变化的条件下，评估 attribution 是否能保持对真正 supporting 片段的高分。
- SSP（source separation precision）：把任务明确为来源分离（ICL vs IW），直接衡量方法能否把 supporting 但 IW-overlap 的片段与真正 irrelevant 片段区分开。
3）构建 WMDP-Cyber++：在网络安全/知识问答语境下，为每个 context segment 提供“来源/溯源”层面的 ground-truth（哪些信息应归因于上下文，哪些应归因于权重），用来系统性测上述指标。
整体上，这篇工作不是提出新的 attribution 算法，而是证明现有方法在 IW overlap 下的结构性失败，并给出能暴露该失败的评测工具。
summary.experiments:
全文主实验围绕四类 attribution 方法（ContextCite、AttriBot、TracLLM、Token-Shapley）在 IW/ICL overlap 控制条件下的表现：
- 现象复现：当 supporting 片段的知识同时存在于权重中时，方法会给出接近 0 的分数（论文用 pandas 版本差异示例直观展示）。
- 指标层面：通过 BCS/CAC/APS/SSP 显示这些方法的分数会随“模型是否已知该知识”显著漂移；尤其在 SSP（来源分离）上表现不佳，说明它们不能简单改造为 provenance/溯源工具。
- 论文强调：传统 top-k log-prob drop、LDS 等 removal-based 评测会掩盖该问题，因为它们与被测方法共享同一类假设（删除导致变化才算贡献）。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字与所有模型/设置细节；精读时应以论文结果表为准补齐各指标的具体数值与显著性结论。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义→评测协议→数据集→结果”顺序读：
- 先看 Introduction + Figure 1：把 IW overlap 导致的语义歧义建立起来，这是全文的主线。
- 重点读方法部分对四个指标（BCS/CAC/APS/SSP）的形式化定义：它们分别在控制变量上解决什么评测盲点。
- 精读 WMDP-Cyber++ 的构建与 provenance 标注逻辑：标注粒度、如何定义 IW vs ICL ground-truth、如何控制模型的“已知/未知”。这决定了指标是否可信。
- 看主结果表：对比同一方法在 base model vs IW-overlap model 下的 attribution 漂移；再看 SSP 相关结果，理解“不能简单适配为来源分离”的证据链。
预计泛读 30–45 分钟能抓住结论；想复现或用于自家系统评测，需要把指标实现与数据构建细节读透。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of context attribution under training-data/weight overlap: when the evidence in the prompt context duplicates knowledge already stored in the model weights (in-weight, IW), perturbation/removal-based attribution methods conflate “the model already knows it” with “the context is irrelevant”, producing misleading importance scores and failing to separate ICL contributions from IW contributions at the knowledge level.
summary_en.importance: Its main impact on pretraining-oriented research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic: it turns IW knowledge overlap (a byproduct of pretraining and memorization) into an explicit confounder in attribution evaluation. This matters for provenance, evidence retention in RAG, and any attempt to use attribution as a proxy for “supported by context”. The proposed metrics and the WMDP-Cyber++ benchmark give the community a way to measure whether an attribution method is robust to changes in what the model already knows.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is an evaluation framework.
- Key reframing: attribution should be judged at the knowledge/support level, not merely by output sensitivity. Under IW/ICL overlap, sensitivity is not identifiable: removing a supporting span may not change the output because the same fact is available in weights.
- Metrics to expose this confounding:
  - BCS (Base-model Context attribution Score): evaluate attribution using a base model intended to have less IW access to the target knowledge, creating a control condition.
  - CAC (Cross-model Attribution Consistency): measure how attribution changes across models with different IW knowledge states; large, systematic drift indicates the method is reacting to IW overlap rather than contextual support.
  - APS (Attribution Preservation Score): quantify whether supporting spans keep their attribution when IW availability changes.
