  - SSP (Source Separation Precision): treat the task as explicit source separation (ICL vs IW) and measure precision directly.
- Dataset: WMDP-Cyber++ adds provenance-style ground truth labels over context segments (which spans are truly supporting vs irrelevant, and which are IW-overlapping), enabling systematic evaluation.
The paper evaluates several representative methods (ContextCite, AttriBot, TracLLM, Token-Shapley) and argues the failure is structural for removal-based approaches, not a tuning issue.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments compare multiple attribution methods under controlled IW overlap conditions.
- Qualitative demonstration: supporting spans can receive near-zero attribution when the same information is present in weights (illustrated with a version-specific pandas example).
- Quantitative evaluation: the proposed metrics (BCS/CAC/APS/SSP) show attribution scores/rankings shift with the model’s IW knowledge state, and methods perform poorly on SSP, indicating they do not perform reliable provenance/source separation.
- The paper also argues standard evaluation (top-k log-prob drop, LDS) can mask the issue because it shares the same removal-based assumption.
(Full numeric results and per-setting details should be taken from the main tables/appendix; they are not included in the provided excerpt.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
1) Introduction + the motivating figure to internalize the IW-overlap ambiguity.
2) The formal definitions of BCS/CAC/APS/SSP—this is the reusable artifact.
3) WMDP-Cyber++ construction and labeling: how provenance ground truth is defined and how IW knowledge is controlled.
4) Main result tables: look for cross-model drift (CAC) and the gap between “looks good under removal-based metrics” vs “fails SSP”.
Skimming for the main idea takes ~30–45 minutes; implementing the protocol requires careful reading of the dataset and metric details.

recommendation.zh: 做 RAG、归因或记忆分析的人应看；它提醒你很多“能归因到上下文”的结果其实只是参数记忆泄漏，先看指标定义和 failure case 就够了。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on RAG, attribution, or memorization: many “context-grounded” attributions may just be parametric recall leakage; read the metric definitions and failure cases first.

paper.title: Decoupled Attention Fusion: Accelerating RAG with Efficient KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively mitigates hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) but suffers from prohibitive Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency in long-context scenarios. Reusing pre-computed document KV caches addresses this but introduces a distribution mismatch, where offline caches lack the inter-document attention patterns required for coherent reasoning. CacheBlend reduces recomputation via selective attention, but suffers severe accuracy degradation at longer con

summary.core_problem: RAG 场景下如何复用离线预计算的文档 KV cache，同时避免独立编码文档带来的 KV cache mismatch。核心矛盾是：全量在线 prefill 准确但慢，直接复用离线 cache 快但缺少文档间注意力，质量会下降。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理效率方向，对长上下文 RAG serving 有直接价值。它不解决预训练目标或模型结构训练问题，但对基座模型部署和长上下文系统设计有启发：RAG 的文档语料通常是静态的，可以把一部分 prefill 计算前移到离线阶段；难点在于如何用很少的在线计算补回跨文档依赖。DAF 的价值在于把这个补偿问题改写成硬件友好的 dense attention，而不是依赖复杂稀疏 mask 或大量条件分支。
summary.technical_approach: DAF 将 prefill 拆成三部分。第一，选择重要 token，并只让这些 token 之间做 self-attention，用一个较小的全局交互场修复跨文档依赖。重要 token 的选择不只看单层 KV 偏移，而是聚合第 2 到第 4 层等多层信号，降低层间方差带来的误选。第二，question-document self-attention 让问题 token attend 到全部文档和问题上下文，其中重要 token 的 KV 已经在前一步更新，因此在线问答阶段使用的是混合 KV cache。第三，state fusion 将重要 token 路径和问题-文档路径的输出融合为最终 hidden states。复杂度从 CacheBlend 近似的 O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) 降到 O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q))，其中 r 是重要 token 比例，L_d 是文档 token 总长，L_q 是问题长度。由于 DAF 的两个 attention 子问题都能表示为标准 dense attention，它可以直接使用 Flash-Attention，避免非标准 mask 和 GPU thread divergence。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-7B，在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 上 greedy decoding。对比对象包括 vLLM 全量重算和 CacheBlend，重要 token 比例固定为 r = 0.3。评测覆盖 2WikiMultiHopQA、SAMSum 等 6k–9k token 任务，也包括 RULER、LongBench-V2 等最长约 136k token 的长上下文任务。指标包括 TTFT 和任务准确性指标，如 QA 的 Exact Match、摘要的 Rouge-L，并在表中统一为 Accuracy。结果显示，在 9k token 左右 DAF 与 CacheBlend 接近；到约 130k token 时，DAF 相比 CacheBlend 最高约 2 倍加速，相比 vLLM 全量重算约 5.6 倍加速，同时保持接近或更好的准确性。限制也比较明确：r 需要按任务调节；大规模语料的 KV cache 存储和调度仍然是系统瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看 Methods 中三个模块：important-token self-attention、question-document self-attention、state fusion。复杂度分析值得看，关键是 r L_d^2 到 r^2 L_d^2 的差别，以及为什么 L_q 通常较小。硬件部分重点看它如何保持 Flash-Attention 兼容，这决定了理论复杂度能否转成真实 TTFT 收益。实验部分重点看长上下文长度增加时 DAF 与 CacheBlend 的分化，以及 r = 0.3 的固定设置是否足够支撑不同任务。若关注生产系统，还应重点看限制部分，因为 KV cache 存储可能比 attention 计算更早成为瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV cache reuse for RAG. Offline document caches can reduce prefill latency, but independently encoded documents miss inter-document attention, causing a representation mismatch and quality loss.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to inference efficiency and long-context RAG serving rather than pretraining itself. Its main lesson is that static retrieval corpora create an opportunity to move part of prefill computation offline, but the online stage must repair the missing cross-document dependencies. DAF is useful because it formulates this repair as standard dense attention operations that can run efficiently on existing Flash-Attention kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decoupled Attention Fusion splits prefill into three components. First, it selects important document tokens and performs self-attention only among this subset, creating a compact interaction path across document boundaries. Unlike CacheBlend-style selection based on a single layer, DAF aggregates signals from multiple early layers, typically layers 2–4, to reduce layer-specific noise. Second, question tokens perform question-document self-attention over the full context, using a hybrid KV cache where important-token states have already been updated. Third, a state fusion step combines the outputs into final hidden states. The complexity changes from roughly O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) in CacheBlend to O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q)), where r is the important-token ratio, L_d is total document length, and L_q is question length. The practical design choice is to keep the operations dense and Flash-Attention-compatible, avoiding custom masks and GPU branch divergence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5-7B on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU with greedy decoding. Baselines include full recomputation with vLLM and CacheBlend, with the important-token fraction fixed at r = 0.3. The evaluation spans shorter RAG tasks such as 2WikiMultiHopQA and SAMSum at around 6k–9k tokens, plus long-context tasks from RULER and LongBench-V2 up to about 136k tokens. Metrics include TTFT and task accuracy measures such as Exact Match and Rouge-L, reported under a unified Accuracy column. Around 9k tokens, DAF and CacheBlend are similar. Around 130k tokens, DAF reaches up to 2x speedup over CacheBlend and 5.6x over full recomputation with vLLM, while maintaining comparable or better accuracy. The main limitations are task-dependent tuning of r and the storage and management cost of large offline KV caches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the method section: important-token self-attention, question-document self-attention, and state fusion. The complexity analysis is the key technical part, especially the reduction from r L_d^2 to r^2 L_d^2 and the assumption that L_q is much smaller than L_d. The hardware compatibility discussion is also worth reading because Flash-Attention support is what makes the wall-clock speedup plausible. In the results, inspect how the gap between DAF and CacheBlend grows with context length. For production RAG systems, read the limitations carefully, since KV cache storage can become the dominant bottleneck even if online attention is accelerated.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和长上下文 ablation；如果数字扎实，DAF 是 RAG cache 预计算里比粗暴拼 KV 更干净的折中。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and long-context ablations; if the numbers hold, DAF is a cleaner compromise than blindly concatenating precomputed KV caches.

paper.title: Learning on the Job: Continual Learning from Deployment Feedback for Frozen-Weights Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents encounter learning opportunities in every episode they run, and discard nearly all of them: the underlying models are frozen at deployment, so an agent that resolves a difficult request today starts from zero when it recurs tomorrow. Yet ordinary operation already produces feedback, in the form of outcome verdicts and after-the-fact corrections. We show that this feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils

summary.core_problem: 部署后的 agent 往往冻结模型权重，单次任务中得到的结果判定和事后修正没有被转化为后续可复用的经验。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent continual learning 的系统方法。它不更新模型权重，而是用外部自然语言记忆吸收部署反馈；对长期运行 agent 的经验积累有参考意义，但与基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 方法将每个 episode 的 outcome verdict 或 after-the-fact correction 蒸馏成可检索的自然语言规则，存入外部 memory。下次遇到相似任务时，agent 检索这些规则辅助决策。对照组是 static RAG，即从完整政策语料中检索，而不是从历史 episode 中学习规则。
summary.experiments: 在 τ-bench 的 banking domain 上评测。相对 static-RAG control，使用一比特 outcome verdict 学习使 single-trial success 达到 baseline 的 1.6 倍；使用 corrections 学习达到 2.6 倍，并解决了 baseline 从未完成的 84 个任务中的 22 个。摘要提到覆盖 Mistral Large 和一个 open-weights model，但未给出完整模型与任务配置。

summary_en.core_problem: Deployed agents often keep model weights frozen, so outcome verdicts and post-hoc corrections from each episode are not converted into reusable experience.
summary_en.importance: This is a system method for continual learning in agents. It uses external natural-language memory rather than weight updates to absorb deployment feedback. The idea is relevant for long-running agents, but only weakly connected to base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each episode is distilled into retrievable natural-language rules using either a one-bit outcome verdict or after-the-fact corrections. Future episodes retrieve these rules as memory. The control is static RAG over the full policy corpus, rather than learning from previous episodes.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is on the banking domain of τ-bench. Against a static-RAG control, learning from one-bit outcome verdicts improves single-trial success to 1.6x the baseline; learning from corrections improves it to 2.6x and solves 22 of 84 tasks the baseline never solves. The abstract mentions Mistral Large and an open-weights model but does not provide the full model or task setup.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表就够；把反馈写成可检索规则很实用，但 banking setup 限制了泛化判断。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough; rule memory from feedback is practical, but the banking setup limits any generalization claim.

paper.title: CRAG-MM-Diagnostics: Enabling Stage-Wise Analysis of Knowledge-Intensive VQA
paper.abstract: Knowledge-Intensive Visual Question Answering (KI-VQA) benchmarks evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as multimodal knowledge assistants by requiring external information beyond a provided image to answer questions. KI-VQA involves multiple sub-problems -referring expression understanding, visual grounding, object recognition, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning-yet existing benchmarks typically report only end-task accuracy, obscuring where failures arise. To analyze the full KI-VQA pipeline,

summary.core_problem: 知识密集型 VQA（KI-VQA）是一个多阶段管线问题：指代理解与视觉定位、目标实体识别（映射到规范实体如 Wikipedia 页面）、以及外部知识检索与推理。现有基准多只报端到端准确率，无法定位失败来自哪一阶段，导致模型改进与系统设计缺乏可操作的诊断信号。
summary.importance:
属于评测/诊断资产，对“VLM 作为知识助手”的系统性瓶颈拆解更有价值，而非直接改进预训练算法。对预训练研究的启发点主要有两类：
1) 训练目标与数据构造：如果错误主要集中在检索与推理阶段，单纯扩大视觉预训练或图文对齐未必带来端到端收益；需要更明确的 retrieval-aware / tool-aware 训练信号。
2) 评测分解方式：把端到端任务拆成可度量的中间变量（grounding、entity linking、retrieval+reasoning），能更稳定地指导 mid-train / continual pretrain 的数据配比与能力补齐。
summary.technical_approach:
构建 CRAG-MM-Diagnostics：在 CRAG-MM（约 1.9K egocentric、视觉复杂场景、13 个领域）基础上，增加可用于分阶段评测的人工标注与元数据。
关键标注包括：
- 目标区域 bbox（用于语言驱动的视觉定位评测）；
- 目标实体名称与 Wikipedia URL（用于 object identification / entity linking 评测）；
- 指代表达类型（区分显著/歧义指代、是否有图像内线索 vs 需要知识线索）；
- 对歧义样本提供 disambiguated question；并提供 text-only question 等控制变量。
评测设置覆盖 fully parametric VLM、各阶段专用模型、以及 retrieval-augmented VLM；并用分阶段指标分析误差来源，最后用“组件化管线”把各阶段更强的组件组合起来验证可提升端到端效果。
summary.experiments:
从引言给出的关键结论与数字：
- 多数 KI-VQA 错误来自知识检索与推理不足，而非实体识别：以 GPT-5 为例，仅 20.9% 的错误能通过提供 ground-truth 目标物体名称被修复（暗示剩余错误在检索/推理或问题歧义等）。
- 视觉定位对图像检索帮助显著，尤其在歧义查询中（定性结论，需在实验章节看具体提升幅度与设置）。
- 通过组合分阶段组件的建模管线，端到端准确率提升：GPT-5 +13.3 个百分点，Qwen +8.5 个百分点（相对基线的绝对提升）。
- 还报告了若干诊断发现：专有模型的视觉定位更难；QA 的语言歧义会贯穿整个管线；VLM 相比专用模型更难识别“冷门实体”。
更细的实验细节（各阶段指标定义、样本分桶、检索库/检索器、不同模型列表与超参）需要看第 4/5/6 节与附录。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看数据构建与标注规范（Section 3 与附录 A）：bbox 标注质量、歧义问题如何重写、实体链接到 Wikipedia 的一致性，这决定诊断结论是否可信。
- 重点看分阶段评测协议（Sections 4–6）：每一阶段的输入/输出是什么、允许模型使用哪些信息、指标如何定义，避免把阶段间信息泄漏当成能力。
- 精读引言里提到的两个“可行动结论”的证据链：①为什么说主要瓶颈在 retrieval+reasoning；②组件化管线如何组合、提升来自哪里（grounding 还是 retrieval）。
- 如果要把它用于预训练/中训决策，建议关注按“歧义类型/实体流行度/目标显著性”分桶后的曲线，这些分桶往往直接对应数据配比与合成数据策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Knowledge-Intensive VQA is inherently a multi-stage pipeline (language-driven grounding, entity identification/linking, and knowledge retrieval + reasoning). Existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end accuracy, which hides where failures originate and makes it hard to design targeted model or system improvements.
summary_en.importance:
Primarily an evaluation/diagnostic contribution rather than a new pretraining method. The pretraining-relevant takeaways are:
1) If most errors come from retrieval and reasoning, scaling vision pretraining or generic image-text alignment may not translate into KI-VQA gains without retrieval-aware/tool-aware training signals.
2) Stage-wise measurable intermediates (grounding, entity linking, retrieval+reasoning) provide cleaner feedback for mid-training/continual pretraining decisions, such as data mixture adjustments and targeted capability patching.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CRAG-MM-Diagnostics extends CRAG-MM (≈1.9K egocentric, visually complex images across 13 domains) with stage-specific annotations:
- Bounding boxes for target regions (to evaluate language-based visual grounding).
- Canonical entity name + Wikipedia URL (to evaluate object identification / entity linking).
- Referring expression type labels (salient vs ambiguous; in-image cue vs knowledge-intensive cue).
- Disambiguated questions for ambiguous cases, plus text-only questions as controls.
They evaluate fully parametric VLMs, specialized models per stage, and retrieval-augmented VLMs, then validate findings by building a componentized pipeline that mixes best-in-class components across stages.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers and findings from the provided excerpt:
- Error attribution: for GPT-5, only 20.9% of errors can be fixed by providing the ground-truth target object name, suggesting the dominant bottleneck is knowledge retrieval/reasoning (and/or ambiguity), not entity identification.
- Grounding helps image retrieval substantially, especially under ambiguous queries (quantitative deltas should be in Sections 4–6).
- A combined multi-component pipeline improves end-to-end accuracy by +13.3 points for GPT-5 and +8.5 points for Qwen.
- Additional diagnostics: proprietary models struggle more on grounding; linguistic ambiguity propagates through the pipeline; VLMs have difficulty identifying unpopular entities compared to specialized models.
For rigorous use, the exact stage metrics, model list, retrieval setup, and ablations need to be checked in the main experiment sections and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the dataset/annotation section and Appendix A first: bbox quality control, ambiguity rewriting rules, and entity-linking consistency determine whether the diagnostics are trustworthy.
- Focus on the stage-wise evaluation protocol in Sections 4–6: what each stage consumes/produces, what information is allowed, and how leakage is prevented.
- Track the evidence behind two actionable claims: (a) why retrieval+reasoning dominates the error budget, and (b) where the +13.3/+8.5 gains come from in the componentized pipeline.
- For pretraining implications, pay attention to bucketed analyses by ambiguity type, entity popularity, and target saliency—these buckets often map directly to data mixture and synthetic data strategies.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §实验分析；它把 VLM-RAG 失败拆得较干净，可用来校准多模态 pretrain 后的诊断集。
recommendation.en: Skim the analysis section; the failure decomposition is clean enough to inform diagnostic sets after multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Information Discernment in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used with external knowledge sources like the internet. Do they weigh information appropriately -- updating more for reliable sources (source discernment) and more when claims bring priors closer to the truth (truth discernment)? We formalize this as information discernment and introduce Learn2Discern (L2D), an experimental framework and benchmark grounded in three normative axioms with interpretable metrics. To establish external validity, a pre-registered, quota-matched u

summary.core_problem: 当 LLM 接收外部信息时，它们是否会根据来源可靠性和信息是否让自身判断更接近真值来做合理更新。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测与行为分析工作。对预训练研究员的意义不在 benchmark 本身，而在它把“模型如何吸收外部证据”拆成 source discernment 和 truth discernment 两个可测维度，能为 RAG、tool-use、post-training 乃至预训练中的证据整合能力提供更细的诊断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Learn2Discern (L2D) 框架与 benchmark，基于三个规范性公理定义可解释指标，衡量模型是否对更可靠来源更新更多、以及是否在新信息让判断更接近真值时更新更多。为验证外部效度，作者还做了预注册、配额匹配的用户研究，检验真实用户是否认同这些公理。随后在 13 个模型、约 67 万次试验上系统测量信息辨别能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个模型和近 670K trials。摘要中的主要结论是：模型在 source discernment 和 truth discernment 上接近随机；对来源流行度的依赖约为对来源可靠性的两倍；无论新 claim 让模型更接近还是更远离真值，更新幅度都近似相同。用户研究样本量为 299，支持三条规范性公理。论文更像行为诊断而非方法改进，没有给出训练修复方案。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Michigan；Eric Gilbert 与 Ceren Budak 在 HCI、社会计算与平台研究领域较知名。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs appropriately update on external information, weighting evidence by source reliability and by whether the claim moves beliefs closer to the truth.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and behavioral-analysis paper. Its value to pretraining researchers is not the benchmark alone, but the decomposition of evidence integration into source discernment and truth discernment, which is useful for diagnosing RAG, tool use, post-training, and possibly pretraining-era evidence integration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Learn2Discern (L2D), an experimental framework and benchmark grounded in three normative axioms with interpretable metrics. It measures whether models update more for reliable sources and more when new claims move them closer to ground truth. To establish external validity, they run a preregistered, quota-matched user study testing whether real users endorse these axioms. They then evaluate 13 models over roughly 670K trials.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 13 models and nearly 670,000 trials. The headline findings are that models perform near chance on both source and truth discernment, rely about twice as much on source popularity as on source reliability, and update similarly whether a claim improves or worsens alignment with the truth. The user study includes 299 participants and supports all three normative axioms. The paper is diagnostic rather than a method paper and does not propose a training fix.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Michigan; Eric Gilbert and Ceren Budak are known in HCI, social computing, and platform studies.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座方法，但这个 failure mode 切得很准；看指标定义和主结果表就够，若你做 RAG/tool-use/post-train，应把 source reliability 与 popularity 明确拆开测。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-method paper, but the failure mode is carved cleanly; read the metric definitions and main result table, and explicitly separate source reliability from popularity in your own RAG/tool-use/post-training evals.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Model Selective Evidence Adoption from Contaminated Retrieval Results
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented large language models frequently face contexts that interleave useful evidence with misleading statements or instruction-like content. Blanket refusal discards valid evidence, whereas uncritical adoption yields incorrect or unsafe answers. The ability to selectively adopt relevant information while rejecting deceptive or harmful content is therefore critical for reliable deployment in real-world retrieval settings. We introduce SelectBench, a controlled benchmark and training

summary.core_problem: 研究RAG场景中模型如何在混合了有用证据、误导信息和指令注入的检索结果里选择性采纳证据。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是SelectBench评测与训练集，以及一个小规模RL后训练实验。它对RAG安全和后训练信号设计有参考意义，但数据规模和提升幅度都偏小。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造SelectBench，用受控样本测试模型是否采纳相关证据并拒绝欺骗或有害内容；随后用DAPO对Qwen3.5-4B进行后训练，奖励来自确定性规则或冻结的语义judge。
summary.experiments: 在修正后的325例SelectBench-v2测试集上，原始checkpoint严格成功率为22.46%，DAPO-Rule达到25.54%，DAPO-DeepSeek达到26.46%。训练后模型减少了禁用内容采纳，回答更短更聚焦，但prompt-injection following没有改善。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自East China Normal University和Shandong University；未看到知名大模型实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether RAG-augmented LLMs can selectively use relevant evidence while rejecting misleading statements and instruction-like contamination.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is SelectBench plus a small RL post-training study. The result is relevant to RAG robustness and reward design, but the reported gains are modest and the test set is small.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build SelectBench as a controlled benchmark and training set, then post-train Qwen3.5-4B with DAPO using either deterministic rule rewards or a frozen semantic judge.
summary_en.experiments: On the corrected 325-example SelectBench-v2 test set, strict success improves from 22.46% for the base checkpoint to 25.54% with DAPO-Rule and 26.46% with DAPO-DeepSeek. The trained policies adopt less forbidden content and produce shorter answers, but prompt-injection following does not improve.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are East China Normal University and Shandong University.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表就够了：RL能压一点污染采纳，但没修好prompt injection，说明reward覆盖面太窄。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough: RL reduces some contaminated adoption, but prompt injection remains, pointing to a narrow reward signal.

paper.title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM serving 中非前缀 KV cache 复用与 KV 压缩难以同时成立的问题，目标是在减少 prefill 计算的同时降低 KV 存储和访问成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与缓存表示方法创新。长上下文 RAG、多文档推理和会话复用场景里，prefill 计算和 KV cache 内存都会成为瓶颈；已有 KV reuse 多关注省算力，较少处理大规模缓存的存取成本，而直接压缩非前缀 KV 往往损伤精度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C2KV，将非前缀 KV reuse、KV extraction 和 inference-time concatenation 放在同一个框架里优化。方法学习一个可组合、压缩且位置无关的 KV cache manifold，并引入轻量 sidecar Extractor、可学习 compression tokens 和结构化注意力机制，使抽取出的 KV 表示能在不同上下文位置下复用。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未提供模型参数量、数据规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是长上下文推理、RAG 或多文档场景下的 prefill latency、KV 内存占用、cache access cost 与任务精度之间的折中；需要看正文确认压缩率、吞吐提升和非前缀复用下的质量退化。
summary.authors_note: Alibaba Group 参与的 LLM inference / serving 方向工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the mismatch between non-prefix KV cache reuse and KV compression in long-context LLM serving, aiming to save both prefill compute and KV storage/access cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and cache-representation contribution. In long-context RAG, multi-document reasoning, and reusable-session serving, prefill compute is only part of the cost; storing and reading large KV caches can dominate. Existing reuse methods mostly optimize compute, while naive compression of non-prefix reusable KV often hurts accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: C2KV jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation for non-prefix reuse. It learns a compressed, composable, position-agnostic KV cache manifold, using a lightweight sidecar Extractor, learnable compression tokens, and structured attention so that extracted KV states can be reused across different context positions.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The relevant experiments should be long-context reasoning, RAG, or multi-document serving, measuring prefill latency, KV memory footprint, cache access cost, and accuracy retention under non-prefix reuse; the full paper is needed for compression ratios and quality trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Alibaba Group on LLM inference and serving.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；如果非前缀 KV 复用要进生产，这篇的“位置无关压缩表示”值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if non-prefix KV reuse matters in production, the position-agnostic compressed cache representation is worth reproducing.

paper.title: RIMS: Preference Optimization via Smoothed Multi-pair Aggregation for Small-Scale LLM Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Small-scale language models (SLMs) are attractive for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in resource-constrained settings, but their limited capacity makes them highly sensitive to noisy or spurious retrieved evidence. Existing preference-based methods such as RoseRAG select only the hardest single preference pair via hard argmin/argmax, discarding the remaining signal; others treat multiple pairs as independent binary comparisons, resulting in low data utilization. We propose RIMS, a three-st

summary.core_problem: 解决小模型在 RAG 场景中对噪声检索证据敏感，以及现有偏好优化方法只使用单个 hard preference pair 或把多 pair 独立处理导致训练信号利用不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是面向 RAG 的后训练目标改进。它不直接推进预训练，但涉及偏好数据构造、拒绝采样和多比较信号聚合，对理解小模型如何利用弱偏好信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RIMS 三阶段框架：先用目标小模型自身通过拒绝采样生成合成 CoT 偏好数据，不依赖闭源教师；再用可微的 soft aggregation 替代 hard argmin/argmax，从多个 preference pairs 中保留梯度；最后用平滑后的多 pair preference objective 做优化。方法主要是对 RAG 偏好优化目标和数据利用方式的改进。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、RAG 数据集、baseline 名称、指标或提升幅度。需要看正文确认是否只在小规模 RAG benchmark 上有效，以及 self-generated CoT preference 是否引入确认偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets small-scale LMs for RAG, where noisy or spurious retrieved evidence can dominate, and existing preference optimization methods waste signal by selecting a single hard pair or treating many pairs as independent binaries.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training objective contribution for RAG. It is not central to base pretraining, but the treatment of synthetic preference data and multi-pair aggregation is mildly useful for understanding how small models can learn from weak preference signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: RIMS uses a three-stage pipeline: generating synthetic chain-of-thought preference data with rejection sampling from the target SLM itself, replacing hard pair selection with a differentiable soft aggregation operator, and optimizing a smoothed multi-pair preference objective. The novelty is mainly in the preference loss and data-utilization strategy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, RAG datasets, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains. The full paper should be checked for whether the method holds beyond small RAG benchmarks and whether self-generated CoT preferences create self-confirmation bias.

recommendation.zh: 作为小模型 RAG 偏好优化备查即可；关键看 soft aggregation 是否比多 pair DPO 有干净增益。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for small-model RAG preference tuning; the only real question is whether soft aggregation beats multi-pair DPO in a clean setup.

paper.title: Is Progressive Disclosure All You Need for Long-Context Agents?
paper.abstract: Long-document question answering usually forces a choice between loading the whole document into the context window and bolting on a separate retriever. Agentic AI suggests a broader option, giving the agent the document path and letting it decide how and what to read. Agent Skills, a standard for packaging expertise into folders an agent loads on demand, supply a ready mechanism: progressive disclosure, which exposes only what a query needs, from a short description down to the specific passage

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文评估一个很实际的问题：长文档 QA 中，让 agent 按需打开文件的 progressive disclosure，是否真的比直接读原文或传统检索更好。核心变量不是模型能力，而是文档被组织成什么可导航结构：raw document、flat skill pack、hierarchical skill pack。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文模型评测、agentic reading、工具化上下文管理有启发。它把“长上下文能力”拆成两个部分：模型是否能在长输入中保持有效注意力，以及 agent 是否能用外部文件结构降低上下文负担。结论也比较克制：progressive disclosure 主要买到的是上下文预算和导航结构，不是更强推理能力。对做长上下文预训练和评测的人，价值在于提醒评测时要区分模型内生长上下文能力和外部组织结构带来的收益。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 ∞Bench 的长文档 QA 改造成交互式 agent 环境，让 agent 可以通过工具读取、搜索、打开文档片段，并记录完整轨迹和最终 reward。对同一本书构造三种输入方式。第一种 raw：直接给原始文档路径，让 agent 自己导航。第二种 flat：构造一个 Agent Skills pack，根目录有 SKILL.md，正文里包含 chunk 索引，具体内容放在 references/ 下，agent 先读总索引，再按需打开片段。第三种 hierarchical：每个 chunk 都变成一个独立 skill，每个 skill 有常驻描述，再由 meta-router 路由到具体 chunk。两种 disclosure pack 使用相同 chunk set 和 LLM 生成的 chunk 描述，因此实验主要比较路由深度和索引放置位置，而不是切分质量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三种 agent harness 和三个模型家族，并以 classical hybrid retrieve-and-rerank 作为外部参照。单本书场景下，flat disclosure 的收益取决于 agent 自身导航能力：在 Pi 和 Claude-Code 下，它能匹配或超过 raw navigation；在 Codex 下收益不明显，因为裸 agent 已经会对问题中的实体做 grep 式搜索。hierarchical disclosure 没有超过 flat，部分设置还显著退化，例如 Pi gpt-5.4-mini 上 En.MC 从 0.9126 降到 0.6398。库级场景下结论变化明显：当二十本书一起打包时，raw navigation 使 Codex 的 English open QA 降到 0.26，而 flat disclosure 保持在 0.46。论文还报告，语料规模扩大不仅降低准确率，也提高达到固定准确率所需的每题成本，说明更大的库不是简单“多给材料”，而是会降低 agent 阅读效率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3 的三种文档组织方式，尤其 flat 与 hierarchical 的变量控制；Section 4 的 ∞Bench agent 环境改造；Section 5 的单书与多书对比结果。图 1、图 2 可以快速理解 skill pack 结构。最值得细看的不是最终准确率，而是 hierarchical 为什么失败：常驻 chunk 描述增加了上下文负担，递归路由也增加了决策错误面。对长上下文研究者，可重点关注它如何把“上下文窗口长度”转化为“可导航外部记忆”的实验问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether progressive disclosure, as used in Agent Skills, is actually a better way to handle book-length QA than raw document navigation or a conventional retriever. The main variable is the document interface given to the agent: raw files, a flat skill pack, or a hierarchical skill pack.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for long-context evaluation and agentic context management. It separates model-side long-context competence from interface-side context compression. The main lesson is that progressive disclosure gives the agent a cheaper routing structure; it does not add reasoning ability. This distinction matters when interpreting long-context benchmark results, because external document organization can change accuracy without changing the underlying model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors turn ∞Bench into an interactive agent environment. The agent receives a document or skill directory, can inspect files through tools, and is scored by the final QA reward while the trajectory is logged. They compare three routes to the same content. Raw navigation gives the agent the document directly. Flat disclosure uses one SKILL.md with a short always-visible description and an index that points to chunk files under references/. Hierarchical disclosure makes each chunk its own skill, with chunk descriptions always exposed and a meta-router selecting among them. The flat and hierarchical packs share the same chunking and LLM-written chunk descriptions, so the comparison isolates the wiring and routing depth rather than the chunk construction.
summary_en.experiments: The study runs across three agent harnesses and three model families, with a hybrid retrieve-and-rerank system as an external reference. On a single book, flat disclosure helps mainly when the agent cannot already navigate well. It matches or improves over raw navigation under Pi and Claude-Code, but adds little under Codex, whose raw setup already searches for entities named in the question. Hierarchical disclosure never beats flat disclosure and can fail badly; one reported case drops En.MC on Pi gpt-5.4-mini from 0.9126 to 0.6398. At library scale the result changes: with twenty books, raw navigation hurts even Codex, with English open QA falling to 0.26, while flat disclosure keeps it at 0.46. The larger corpus also increases the per-question cost needed to reach a fixed accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read Section 3 for the controlled construction of raw, flat, and hierarchical document interfaces; Section 4 for the ∞Bench agent environment; and Section 5 for the single-book versus multi-book results. Figures 1 and 2 are enough to understand the two skill-pack layouts. The most useful detail is why hierarchy underperforms: always-loaded chunk descriptions consume context, and deeper routing creates more opportunities for agent-level navigation errors.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文/Agent系统的人重点看§3的对照设计和不同harness的交互效应，结论可直接指导工程取舍。
recommendation.en: For long-context / agent system builders, focus on §3 controlled design and harness interaction effects; conclusions directly inform engineering tradeoffs.

paper.title: HG-RAG: Hierarchy-Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Knowledge Graphs
paper.abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) has proven to be a widely successful process at improving the quality of outputs from a Large Language Model (LLM) for wider context. However, RAG systems typically retrieve context from flat document stores, which struggles when queries require hierarchical or relational reasoning across structured knowledge. I present HG-RAG (Hierarchy-Guided RAG), a framework that performs graph-traversal over a hierarchical knowledge graph to deliver structured context to

summary.core_problem: 普通 RAG 从扁平文档库检索上下文，难以处理需要层级、关系和多跳推理的结构化知识查询。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向层级知识图谱的 RAG 检索管线。它属于通用 RAG 系统的小幅方法改造，对基座预训练启发有限，但可作为结构化上下文组织的参考案例。
summary.technical_approach: HG-RAG 先从查询中解析命名实体锚点，再围绕该节点进行图遍历：向上取父节点，横向取关系邻居，必要时向下取子节点，最后把结构化上下文交给语言模型生成答案。方法主要是检索策略改进，不是新的 LLM 训练方法。
summary.experiments: 在 18 到 800 节点的三种知识图谱规模上，与 dense retrieval baseline 对比；查询类型包括 local fact、hierarchical、neighborhood 和 multi-hop。摘要称在层级、关系和多跳查询上持续优于扁平检索，但未给出绝对分数、统计显著性和更强图检索 baseline。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RAG retrieves from flat document stores and struggles when queries require hierarchical, relational, or multi-hop reasoning over structured knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a hierarchy-guided retrieval pipeline over knowledge graphs. It is a modest general RAG-system method rather than a foundation-model training result, but it is a useful reference for structured context construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: HG-RAG resolves a named-entity anchor from the query, then traverses a hierarchical knowledge graph upward to parents, laterally to relational neighbors, and downward to children when needed. The retrieved structured context is then provided to the language model.
summary_en.experiments: The method is compared with a dense retrieval baseline across three graph scales from 18 to 800 nodes and four query types: local fact, hierarchical, neighborhood, and multi-hop. The abstract reports consistent gains on hierarchical, relational, and multi-hop queries, but does not give exact scores or stronger graph-retrieval comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 只看检索流程图即可；小图谱上的规则化 graph traversal，对预训练没有新信号。
recommendation.en: Skim only the retrieval pipeline; rule-like graph traversal on small KGs gives no new signal for pretraining.

paper.title: LakeQuest: A Three-Domain Benchmark for Grounded Question Answering across Data Lakes
paper.abstract: While modern question answering (QA) systems excel on clean, schema-aligned corpora, real-world knowledge is rarely so neatly packaged. Answering questions over enterprise and scientific data lakes requires systems to navigate heterogeneous, weakly structured collections of tables, passages, and linked metadata. Current benchmarks abstract away this noisy discovery process, failing to evaluate end-to-end performance. To bridge this gap, we introduce LakeQuest, a human-validated benchmark of 9,84

summary.core_problem: 评测问答系统在真实 data lake 中端到端发现证据并合成答案的能力，而不是只在干净、schema 对齐的语料上做 QA。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 benchmark。它把检索源发现、跨表格/文本/元数据证据定位、答案合成放在同一个评测链路里，能暴露标准 RAG 在真实企业和科研数据湖中的失败模式；但它更偏 RAG/QA 系统评测，对基座预训练方法的直接信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 LakeQuest，包含 9,846 个人工验证 QA pair，覆盖 AI/ML metadata、retail banking、multimodal biomedical drug information 三个领域。每个问题配有精确的、模态感知的 evidence pointer，并把 source discovery 与 cross-modal synthesis 分开分析。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了标准 RAG 等 baseline 的评测，用于衡量端到端 retrieve-and-synthesize pipeline。摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据或提升幅度，只明确指出该 benchmark 能分离源发现错误和跨模态合成错误。
summary.authors_note: University of Waterloo；Victor Zhong 长期做语义解析、结构化数据问答和检索问答相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether QA systems can discover evidence and synthesize answers over realistic data lakes, rather than over clean and schema-aligned corpora.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a benchmark contribution. It stresses end-to-end source discovery, heterogeneous evidence grounding, and answer synthesis across tables, passages, and metadata. The connection to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, but it is useful for understanding where RAG-style systems fail outside sanitized datasets.
summary_en.technical_approach: LakeQuest contains 9,846 human-validated QA pairs across three domains: AI/ML metadata, retail banking, and multimodal biomedical drug information. Each question is paired with exact modality-aware evidence pointers, and the evaluation separates source discovery from cross-modal synthesis.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates standard RAG baselines and related retrieve-and-synthesize pipelines. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data details, or numerical gains, but emphasizes diagnostic failure decomposition.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Waterloo; Victor Zhong is known for work on semantic parsing, structured QA, and retrieval-grounded question answering.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RAG 评测资产知道即可；预训练研究员只需看数据构造和错误分解，不必读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as a RAG evaluation asset; for pretraining work, skim only the dataset design and failure decomposition.

paper.title: On-Device Deep Research at 4B: Exposure Bounds Faithfulness, Retrieval Bounds Coverage
paper.abstract: On-device research agents search a corpus, read sources, and write a cited brief on a personal laptop. Whether their citations are faithful, and at what cost, is unmeasured for a deployable small model. This study fixes one 4B generator on a 24 GB laptop and asks what makes its citations faithful. It separates two quantities usually reported as one number. Cited claim faithfulness asks whether the cited source supports the claim. Trustworthy coverage asks whether the agent also cites the right s

summary.core_problem: 测量小模型 research agent 在本地设备上写带引用摘要时，引用是否真实支持结论，以及检索是否覆盖了正确来源。
summary.importance: 核心价值在评测拆分：把常被混在一起的 citation quality 分成 faithfulness 与 coverage 两个量。这对 RAG/agent 评测设计有启发，但对预训练本身较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定一个 4B 生成模型和 24GB 笔记本部署条件，交叉控制两个变量：生成器能看到的每篇源文档暴露长度（400 vs 1500 字符）和输入来源质量（gold papers vs retrieved papers）。据此区分 cited claim faithfulness 与 trustworthy coverage，并分析二者分别受什么因素限制。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出关键结果：在 retrieved sources 上，增加 exposure 可把 faithfulness 从 0.45 提到 0.58；在 gold sources 上从 0.37 提到 0.58，二者收敛，说明 faithfulness 主要受 exposure 限制。另一方面，coverage 主要受 retrieval 质量限制，而不是生成器看到每篇文档的长度。实验是单一 4B 模型、单设备设定，外推性有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures whether citations produced by an on-device small-model research agent actually support the claims, and whether retrieval covers the right sources in the first place.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is evaluative: it separates citation quality into faithfulness and coverage, two quantities that are often conflated. This is useful for RAG and agent evaluation design, though only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study fixes a 4B generator on a 24GB laptop and crosses two factors: how much of each source the generator sees (400 vs 1500 characters) and the quality of supplied sources (gold papers vs retrieved papers). It then evaluates cited-claim faithfulness and trustworthy coverage separately to identify what bounds each metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the key finding that increasing exposure raises faithfulness from 0.45 to 0.58 on retrieved sources and from 0.37 to 0.58 on gold sources, with convergence between the two settings. This suggests faithfulness is bounded mainly by exposure. Coverage, by contrast, is bounded by retrieval quality rather than source exposure length. The setup uses a single 4B model on one device, so external validity is limited.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新，但评测拆分是干净的：faithfulness 看 exposure，coverage 看 retrieval；读摘要和主结果表即可，不必深挖正文。
recommendation.en: The result is not surprising, but the metric split is clean: faithfulness tracks exposure, coverage tracks retrieval; the abstract and main result table are enough.

paper.title: Evaluating RAG Metrics in Applied Contexts: An Experiment, Its Findings and Its Limitations
paper.abstract: This paper reports an empirical study evaluating the relevance of several RAG metrics. The experiment is based on a question-answering dataset created by human annotators from business data. The generated responses and retrieved spans of a RAG system are scored using evaluation metrics from four libraries (Ragas, DeepEval, RAGChecker, Opik). These metrics are compared to scores given by two evaluators, as well as to standard metrics such as recall. An analysis of correlations is conducted. Final

summary.core_problem: 在真实业务数据上，现有RAG评测指标（多库实现）与人工评审的一致性到底如何、哪些指标更可信。
summary.importance: 属于RAG评测方法的“落地对照实验”；对预训练本身不直接，但对“用自动指标做训练信号/回归测试”的可靠性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 用人工从业务数据构建的QA集，运行一个RAG系统；用Ragas/DeepEval/RAGChecker/Opik等库对生成答案与检索片段打分，并与两位人工评审及传统指标（如recall）做相关性分析；同时讨论方法学局限并对比文献常见做法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据规模、RAG系统配置、具体相关系数数值与显著性；核心产出是“相关性分析结果+局限性清单”。（该文为法语工作坊EvalLLM 2026论文的英文翻译。）
summary.authors_note: Orange Research, Lannion

summary_en.core_problem: How well do popular RAG evaluation metrics (across multiple libraries) correlate with human judgments in applied/business settings?
summary_en.importance: An applied metric-validation study for RAG; not pretraining-focused, but useful for judging whether automated metrics are trustworthy as training signals or regression tests.
summary_en.technical_approach: Create a human-annotated QA dataset from business data, run a RAG system, score outputs and retrieved spans with Ragas/DeepEval/RAGChecker/Opik, and analyze correlations against two human evaluators and standard metrics like recall; discuss methodological limitations and compare with common literature practices.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits dataset size, RAG configuration, concrete correlation numbers, and significance testing; the main deliverable is correlation findings plus a limitations checklist. (English translation of an EvalLLM 2026 workshop paper.)
summary_en.authors_note: Orange Research, Lannion

recommendation.zh: 把它当“RAG自动指标不一定能当训练信号”的体感验证；只看相关性表格和局限性段落，别指望有新方法。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a sanity check that RAG auto-metrics may be shaky as training signals; read the correlation tables and the limitations section only.

paper.title: Mitigating Errors in LLM-Generated Web API Invocations via Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Constrained Decoding
paper.abstract: Integration of web APIs is a cornerstone of modern software systems, yet writing correct web API invocation code remains challenging due to complex and evolving API specifications. Although LLMs are increasingly used for code generation, previous work has empirically shown that their ability to generate correct web API integrations is limited. At the same time, mitigation techniques and their effectiveness for this setting remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we propose and systemati

summary.core_problem: 缓解 LLM 生成 Web API 调用代码时常见的端点选择、参数填充和规范遵循错误。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是代码生成场景下的方法评估与工程改进；价值在于把 OpenAPI 规范显式接入生成过程，比较 RAG 与 constrained decoding 两类干预的效果，而不是只依赖模型记忆或自然语言提示。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两部分：一是面向 OpenAPI 规范的检索器，将复杂 API spec 压缩成端点表示并注入 prompt；二是把 OpenAPI 规范自动翻译成基于正则的生成约束，在解码时限制输出空间。两者分别作用于上下文供给和输出合法性，可单独或组合使用。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 WAPIIBench 中的合成任务及相关 Web API 调用基准，比较普通 LLM 代码生成、RAG、constrained decoding 及其组合。摘要未给出具体模型规模、提升幅度或完整数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error mitigation for LLM-generated Web API invocation code, especially endpoint selection, parameter use, and compliance with API specifications.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an engineering-oriented method study for code generation: it makes OpenAPI specifications operational during generation and compares retrieval-based context injection with decoding-time validity constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach has two components. The RAG system parses OpenAPI specifications and retrieves compact endpoint representations for prompting. The constrained decoding component automatically translates OpenAPI specs into regex-based constraints enforced during generation. The two interventions target different failure modes and can be combined.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on WAPIIBench synthetic tasks and related Web API invocation settings, comparing baseline LLM generation against RAG, constrained decoding, and their combination. The provided abstract does not include model sizes or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是代码 Agent 的局部修补论文；若你关心工具调用格式约束，只看 OpenAPI 到 regex 的转换设计即可。
recommendation.en: This is a local fix for code agents; if tool-call validity matters to you, skim only the OpenAPI-to-regex constraint design.

paper.title: CheckRLM: Effective Knowledge-Thought Coherence Checking in Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) have significantly improved performance on complex tasks by extending the reasoning chain. However, these chains are prone to containing factual errors, particularly in knowledge-intensive tasks. To address this issue, we propose CheckRLM, a framework that improves the reliability of the reasoning process through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by timely checking and correcting factual errors. Specifically, CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning

summary.core_problem: 在检索增强推理中，及时发现并修正 reasoning chain 里的事实性错误，减少长链推理中的错误累积。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 推理流程改进。它不直接影响基座预训练，但对长链推理中“知识一致性”和 verifier/checker 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: CheckRLM 从推理链中抽取 factual claims，用检索到的外部知识检查 claim 与知识之间的不一致；一旦发现错误，通过 refinement 机制进行低成本、局部化修正，而不是重写整条推理链。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在知识密集型和长程推理任务上进行了 extensive experiments，并显著优于现有 baseline，同时降低纠错成本；但摘要未给出模型参数、数据集名称、baseline 列表或具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Normal University、Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、Tsinghua University、Northeastern University 等机构。Xu Han 是清华大学 NLP/知识增强与大模型方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to detect and repair factual errors inside reasoning chains during retrieval-augmented reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time RAG reasoning framework. It is not a base-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to verifier-style control of long reasoning and knowledge consistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: CheckRLM extracts factual claims from the reasoning chain, checks them against retrieved external knowledge, localizes subtle inconsistencies, and applies a refinement mechanism that makes minimal targeted corrections instead of regenerating the full chain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive long-horizon reasoning and claims substantial improvements over existing baselines with lower cost. It does not provide model sizes, dataset names, baseline details, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Beijing Normal University, Institute of Information Engineering CAS, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, and Northeastern University. Xu Han is a known researcher in NLP, knowledge-enhanced modeling, and LLMs at Tsinghua University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RAG 推理纠错备查即可；预训练研究员只需看 claim 抽取与局部修正是否可复用。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a RAG correction reference; a pretraining reader only needs to inspect whether claim extraction and local repair are reusable.

Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Beyond Document Grounding: Span-Level Hallucination Detection over Code, Tool Output, and Documents
paper.abstract: Hallucination detection for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is usually evaluated on natural-language document evidence. However, grounded generation systems increasingly rely on structured inputs: source code, developer-tool output, markdown documents, tables, and repository metadata. We introduce a unified benchmark for span-level hallucination detection over code, tool output, structured documents, and existing natural-language RAG datasets. The benchmark is built by starting from grounde

summary.core_problem: 如何在“结构化证据”场景下做可操作的幻觉检测：给定请求、上下文（可能是代码仓库文件/commit、开发者工具输出、markdown/表格/论文段落等）和已经生成的答案，模型需要在答案中定位哪些“字符级 span”缺乏证据支持，而不是只做整段 accept/reject。
summary.importance:
对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-generation verification / RAG 与 code-agent 的评测与数据构造有现实价值：
1) 把幻觉检测从纯自然语言证据扩展到代码与工具输出，覆盖真实 agent 工作流里更常见的证据形态；
2) 用“从正确答案出发、局部注入错误、用编辑距离恢复精确 offset”的方式，提供了可规模化的 span 标注范式，适合做 verifier/detector 的监督数据；
3) 统一任务定义后，可以更清楚地区分：模型是否真的在做证据一致性检查，还是在做表面启发式（例如只看引用格式、只看局部词匹配）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是数据与任务配方，而不是新模型结构。
- 任务定义：输入 (q, c, a)，输出 a 中“不被 q 与 c 支持”的字符区间。强调 span-level 的原因是：在代码/工具输出里，一个小的错误字段、方法名、数值就可能改变行为，但整段答案仍“看起来合理”。
- 标签体系：三大类 hallucination（Contradiction / Unsupported addition / Fabricated reference），再配 13 个表面子类（entity/temporal/numerical/value/relational/identifier/section/attribute/claim/behavior/elaboration/subjective/unspecified），把 RAGTruth、FAVA 以及代码幻觉工作里的分类做了对齐与折中：顶层保持可解释，子类用于误差分析。
- 数据构造：从“已验证的 grounded 正确答案”出发，注入小范围、局部的 hallucination 编辑；通过编辑操作恢复精确字符 offset；并按 grounding source 做切分，保证测试集是未见过的 repo/paper/article（减少模板记忆与泄漏）。代码测试集额外做 evidence-based review/仲裁，降低自动注入带来的标签噪声。
- 模型路线：两类 detector。
  1) 生成式 detector：LettuceDetect-Qwen-2B（Qwen3.5-2B 微调），支持 32,768 上下文，用生成/判别式提示把 span 定位输出出来。
  2) 编码器 token-classification：LettuceDetect-mmBERT-base（307M），作为更传统的序列标注基线。
- 训练信号：包含 PsiloQA 的 14 语言部分，给 detector 提供一定的多语监督（更偏评测覆盖，而非方法创新）。
summary.experiments:
论文的关键结果围绕“统一 benchmark + span-F1”。从全文可抓的硬信息：
- 数据规模：新增构造样本 74,285（覆盖 code、tool output、structured docs），并把现有自然语言 RAG 数据集转换到同一 span 标注格式。
- 最佳模型：LettuceDetect-Qwen-2B 在 unified test 上 span-F1 = 0.689；在 code-agent source 上 span-F1 = 0.60。
- 对比结论（定性）：生成式 detector 在 code-agent split 上显著优于 off-the-shelf detectors 与 zero-shot LLM judges；在自然语言 RAG 上保持竞争力。编码器基线作为下限，主要用于说明“只做 token 分类 + 较短上下文”在结构化证据场景下的不足。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格与所有 baseline 数字；若需要逐项对比与显著性，需回看实验章节的主表与分源分析表。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
1) 先看 Task 定义与三大类/13 子类标签：这决定了 detector 学到的“错误类型边界”，也影响 span-F1 的可解释性。
2) 重点看数据构造流程：从正确答案注入局部错误、offset 恢复、以及按 grounding source 切分的细节；这是这篇文章最可复用的工程资产。
3) 看 code test 的 evidence-based review/仲裁流程：它决定了代码部分评测是否可信（自动注入在代码里很容易产生“语法对但语义不清”的灰区）。
4) 实验部分建议优先看：不同 source（code/tool/doc/NL-RAG）的分项结果、错误类型分布、以及与 zero-shot judge 的差距；这些能帮助判断 detector 是否在“读证据”而不是学格式。
5) 如果要把它用于训练 verifier：额外关注 32k 上下文设置、输入拼接方式、以及 span 输出格式（字符级 vs token 级）对训练稳定性的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Span-level hallucination detection when the grounding evidence is not plain natural-language documents but structured artifacts such as source code, developer tool outputs, markdown/tables, and repository metadata. The detector must localize unsupported character spans in an already-generated answer given (query, context, answer), rather than issuing a single accept/reject label.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation/data contribution rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its value to foundation-model researchers is practical: it broadens hallucination verification beyond NL-RAG into code-agent and tool-augmented settings, and it provides a scalable recipe for producing span-supervised verifier data via localized edits with exact offsets. It also makes it easier to test whether a verifier truly checks evidence consistency instead of exploiting superficial cues.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper’s core is a unified task + dataset construction pipeline.
- Task: predict unsupported character spans in the answer conditioned on the request and structured context.
- Taxonomy: three top-level hallucination types (Contradiction, Unsupported addition, Fabricated reference) plus 13 surface subtypes aligned across prior NL-RAG and code-hallucination taxonomies.
- Data: start from grounded correct answers, inject small localized hallucinations, recover exact character offsets from the edit operations, and split by grounding source so test sets contain unseen repos/papers/articles. The code test split is additionally validated via evidence-based review/arbitration.
- Models: (1) a generative detector LettuceDetect-Qwen-2B (fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B) with a 32,768-token context window; (2) an encoder token-classification baseline LettuceDetect-mmBERT-base (307M). Multilingual supervision is partly provided by the 14-language PsiloQA portion.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported numbers from the provided full text:
- Dataset: 74,285 newly constructed examples spanning code, tool output, and structured documents, plus converted examples from existing NL-RAG benchmarks.
- Best model: LettuceDetect-Qwen-2B achieves 0.689 span-F1 on the unified test set and 0.60 span-F1 on the code-agent source.
- Main qualitative finding: the generative detector substantially outperforms off-the-shelf detectors and zero-shot LLM judges on the code-agent split while remaining competitive on NL-RAG.
(Additional per-source tables/ablations are referenced but not fully visible in the excerpt; consult the main results tables for complete baseline comparisons.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
1) Read the task definition and labeling taxonomy first; it determines what “hallucination” means operationally at span level.
2) Focus on the dataset construction section: localized edit injection, exact offset recovery, and the grounding-source split strategy.
3) For code, pay attention to the evidence-based review/arbitration procedure; it largely determines label reliability.
4) In experiments, prioritize per-source breakdowns (code vs tool output vs structured docs vs NL-RAG) and comparisons against zero-shot judges to see where verification actually fails.
5) If you plan to train verifiers, inspect the 32k context formatting and the span-output representation (character vs token) since these details affect training stability and evaluation fidelity.

recommendation.zh: 读 benchmark 构造和代码 split 验证即可；小模型胜过 LLM judge 的幅度值得校准内部 verifier。
recommendation.en: Skim the benchmark construction and code-split validation; the small-detector-vs-LLM-judge gap is useful for calibrating internal verifiers.

paper.title: Aligning Sentence Embeddings to Human Concepts via Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Dense sentence embeddings are fundamental to modern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems but suffer from a lack of interpretability due to feature superposition. This opacity hinders the alignment of retrieval processes with human intent, as the entangled representations are difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we propose a method to disentangle the dense representations of sentence transformers (e.g., E5) into human-interpretable concepts using Top-k Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs)

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 中 dense sentence embedding 难解释、难控制的问题，尝试把句向量拆解为人类可理解的稀疏概念。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示分析与轻量控制方法。它不是预训练方法，但把 SAE 从 LLM activation 扩展到 sentence transformer embedding，对检索模型可解释性和可控 RAG 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 E5 等 sentence transformer 的 dense embedding 上训练 Top-k Sparse Autoencoder，将原本纠缠的向量表示分解为稀疏 latent features。作者进一步提出 activation steering，通过 clamp 特定 latent feature 来重排检索结果，而不重新训练 backbone。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 SAE 特征可对应语义、句法和语用类别，并能通过特征钳制让检索结果更符合用户约束。未在摘要中给出模型规模、数据规模、具体 baseline 或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the opacity and limited controllability of dense sentence embeddings in RAG by decomposing them into human-interpretable sparse concepts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is representation analysis plus lightweight control. It is not a pretraining method, but it extends SAE-style interpretability from LLM activations to sentence-transformer embeddings, which is relevant to controllable retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains Top-k Sparse Autoencoders on dense embeddings from sentence transformers such as E5, aiming to disentangle superposed features into sparse latents. It then uses activation steering by clamping selected latent features to re-rank retrieval results without retraining the backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that learned SAE features align with semantic, syntactic, and pragmatic categories, and that clamping features can steer retrieval toward user constraints. It does not provide model sizes, data scale, baselines, or effect sizes in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: SAE 用在 embedding 上是自然外推；只看 feature 语义验证和 steering 实验，别把它当预训练 insight。
recommendation.en: Applying SAEs to embeddings is a natural extension; read the feature validation and steering tests, but do not overread it as a pretraining result.

paper.title: PRA-RAG: Provably Robust Aggregation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation against Retrieval Corruption
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating external knowledge, effectively mitigating their inherent knowledge limitations. However, RAG remains vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate retrieved texts to mislead model outputs. Existing defense mechanisms often lack theoretical robustness guarantees and perform unreliably when the LLM has limited knowledge of the retrieved content. In this work, we propose PRA-RAG, a provably robust retriev

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 在检索文本被投毒或污染时，生成结果容易被误导且现有防御缺少理论鲁棒保证的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 鲁棒性方法与理论分析。它不属于预训练研究，但对“外部知识作为推理时训练信号/上下文信号”的可靠性有边际参考，尤其适合关注检索污染、上下文攻击和检索聚合稳定性的研究者。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRA-RAG，通过采样多个 retrieved text 组合，并利用 embedding 空间的几何结构识别鲁棒子集，再从该子集形成稳定的聚合表示。论文给出被污染检索内容最大影响的理论上界，并定义 RAG 鲁棒性的定量度量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个 benchmark 和 RAG 架构上实验，验证对 retrieval corruption 或 poisoning attack 的防御效果。摘要未给出具体模型、检索器、攻击强度、污染比例、性能数字和与现有防御的详细差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses RAG vulnerability to poisoned or corrupted retrieved texts, where generated answers can be misled and existing defenses lack theoretical robustness guarantees.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a robustness method and theoretical analysis for RAG. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is marginally relevant to researchers thinking about external knowledge as an inference-time signal and the reliability of retrieved context under contamination.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRA-RAG samples multiple combinations of retrieved texts and uses geometric structure in embedding space to identify a robust subset. It then derives a stable aggregated representation from that subset. The paper provides bounds on the maximum impact of poisoned retrieved content and defines a quantitative robustness measure for RAG.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is tested across multiple benchmarks and RAG architectures against retrieval corruption or poisoning. It does not provide the specific models, retrievers, attack strengths, poisoning ratios, numeric gains, or detailed comparisons with prior defenses.

recommendation.zh: 可扫理论界限和污染比例实验；若只靠 embedding 几何聚合，强对抗检索下结论要打折。
recommendation.en: Skim the robustness bound and poisoning-ratio experiments; embedding-geometry aggregation may not survive strong adaptive retrieval attacks.

paper.title: How Do LLMs Cite? A Mechanistic Interpretation of Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to enhance the trustworthiness of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their outputs in external documents, often using inline citations for verifiability. However, the faithfulness of these citations -- whether the model genuinely uses a source to generate an answer -- remains a critical, unverified assumption. This paper offers the first mechanistic account of how a large language model decides whether to attach an inline citation while answering

summary.core_problem: RAG 系统中模型给出的引文可能只是“看起来对”，但未必真的是在生成回答时读取并使用了被引文档——这种 citation faithfulness（忠实引用）问题无法从输入输出表层判断，需要从模型内部机制层面解释模型“什么时候、为什么、由哪些组件决定发出一个引文标记”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的直接启发在于：RAG 中的 grounding 不是一个抽象概念，而是体现在具体的内部计算路径上。如果引文行为主要由浅层启发式触发，比如实体匹配或格式模仿，而不是由真正读取上下文内容的组件驱动，那么依靠“带引用”来衡量可信度会产生系统性误判。这类 mechanistic 证据对设计更可靠的 attribution loss、RAG 指令后训练数据、以及 grounding 评测协议都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为研究对象，构造一个受控的 PopQA 风格数据集：同一个问题分别配一个真实支持文档和一个结构匹配的干扰文档，要求模型仅在文档支持回答时插入内联引文。核心方法是 activation patching：在支持文档运行和干扰文档运行之间，逐组件替换中间激活，观察“发起引文 token（[）”和句末终止 token（.）之间的 logit difference 如何变化，从而定位哪些注意力头和 MLP 层真正控制引文决策。随后通过定向干预验证这些组件的因果作用，包括补引缺失引文和抑制错误引文。
summary.experiments: 实验聚焦于能在干净条件和干扰条件下产生明确相反偏好的同质样本，以降低 patching 噪声。作者识别出一个分布式、多阶段的 attributional ensemble：并非单一头或单层决定引文，而是由若干特定 attention heads 和 MLP layers 分阶段协作完成。针对这些组件的干预能够在单文档设定下纠正部分引文失败，并在更复杂的多文档问答中带来 citation accuracy 的明显提升。论文全文版本未提供完整数值表，但结论方向明确：引文行为可被内部定位，且具备可操纵的因果结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看方法部分的实验设计和 activation patching 指标定义，以及多阶段 attributional ensemble 的组成图。若关心 mechanistic interpretability 与 RAG 的结合，可继续看干预实验部分，尤其关注“正确引文但不忠实引用”如何被操作化。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Inline citations in RAG systems can look correct without being faithful: a model may append a citation to a source that happens to support the answer, even if the answer was generated from parametric memory rather than grounded in the retrieved document. This faithfulness failure cannot be diagnosed from input-output behavior alone and requires looking inside the model to understand how citation decisions are made.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant because it moves evaluation of RAG grounding from surface-form checks toward internal mechanism. If citation behavior is driven by shallow heuristics rather than components that actually consume document content during answer construction, then citation-based trust signals are systematically misleading. This has direct implications for how researchers think about attribution-oriented training data, post-training objectives for grounded generation, and evaluation protocols that claim to measure grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in a controlled PopQA-style setup. For each question, they run the same prompt twice: once with a supporting document and once with a structurally matched distractor document. The model is instructed to emit an inline citation marker only when the document supports the answer. Using activation patching between the supporting and distractor runs, they localize attention heads and MLP layers whose activations causally affect the model's preference for emitting the citation-initiating token versus ending the sentence. They then validate these components through targeted interventions designed to induce missing citations or suppress spurious ones.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis is restricted to examples where the supporting and distractor conditions produce clear, opposite token preferences at the decision point, reducing variance in patching. The authors identify a distributed, multi-stage attributional ensemble rather than a single citation head or layer. Interventions on these components correct a portion of citation failures in the single-document setting and produce meaningful improvements in citation accuracy in a more complex multi-document QA setting. The publicly available excerpt does not include full numerical tables, but the reported evidence supports a causal, manipulable internal circuit for citation behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper for the experimental design, the logit-difference metric used to detect citation behavior, and the structure of the proposed attributional ensemble. Readers interested in mechanistic interpretability for grounded generation should spend extra time on the intervention results and the distinction between citation correctness and citation faithfulness. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对“citation=grounding”的先验；只看机制定位和干预结果，别把它外推到所有 RAG 场景。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining recipe, but it should change your prior that citation equals grounding; read the circuit localization and intervention results, not the broadest claims.

paper.title: HMARS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Memory System for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning requires models to access, retrieve, and integrate evidence scattered across documents, dialogues, and accumulated interaction histories. Standard retrieval-augmented generation reduces this problem to top-$K$ chunk retrieval, but such passive access can discard relevant evidence before reasoning begins, especially when relevance depends on broader context. We propose HMARS, a hierarchical multi-agent memory system that treats long contexts as managed memory rather than a

summary.core_problem: 传统RAG采用top-K块检索的被动访问模式处理长上下文推理时，存在两个核心缺陷：一是散落在文档远距离位置的相关证据容易因为单块相关性得分低被提前过滤；二是部分内容的相关性只有结合全局语境才能判断，独立块嵌入无法捕捉这类依赖。现有改进方法要么侧重长程交互中的记忆内容存储/更新/遗忘机制，要么仍然采用集中式的单步检索逻辑，会在推理开始前就丢弃潜在相关证据，长上下文的内存访问机制缺乏合理设计。
summary.importance: 该工作提出的分层内存思路为长上下文推理的工程实现提供了参考，通过重构长上下文的访问模式，避开盲目扩大上下文窗口带来的推理成本问题，同时清晰刻画了传统RAG在上下文依赖相关性场景下的失效模式。但工作核心是推理阶段的系统架构设计，不涉及预训练范式、基座模型架构或训练流程的改动，对预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: HMARS将长文档/交互历史划分成分层的内存区域，采用非对称模型配置平衡检索覆盖率与推理成本：轻量子智能体绑定固定大小的局部内存页，负责本地区域的查询相关性判断；中等强度的中间智能体管理区域级共享记忆，做查询相关的路由协调；最强的前沿基座模型只在最终阶段对检索到的接地证据页做推理，不直接读取全量上下文。这种设计避免了集中式top-K检索提前过滤全文档区域的问题，同时控制了推理算力开销。流程分两步：离线建索引时完成文档分区、子/中智能体绑定与本地记忆卡生成；在线查询时沿着层级路由，每个子智能体都对自己负责的局部区域做查询条件下的相关性评估，不会在初始阶段就排除大段内容，最终聚合相关证据页交给基座模型生成答案。该工作还构造了两个诊断基准，专门测试跨远距离块证据整合、上下文依赖相关性的场景。
summary.experiments: 实验在两个自建诊断基准上开展：一个改造自LongBench-v2，筛选出需要整合远距离散列证据、常规RAG召回率低的问题；另一个是参考RealMem设计的累积交互基准，其中关键事实散落在多轮交互中，仅在后续语境下才体现相关性。根据已披露的结果，HMARS的性能优势集中在被动top-K检索、集中式记忆访问失效的场景；具体的模型尺寸配置、绝对性能提升幅度、消融实验结论在提供的手稿片段中未完整披露。
summary.reading_guide: 属于长上下文推理的系统应用型工作，泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对传统RAG两类核心失效模式的刻画，以及方法部分非对称算力分配、分层内存管理的核心设计思路，具体的prompt设计、实现细节可跳过。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。做长上下文工程、RAG系统的研究者可进一步参考其诊断基准的构造逻辑；做预训练的研究者快速扫过核心设计思路即可，该工作不涉及模型架构、训练目标或数据相关的改动。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard top-K retrieval-augmented generation for long-context reasoning has two core flaws: relevant evidence scattered across distant document positions is often pre-filtered out due to low individual chunk relevance scores, and the relevance of some content only becomes apparent with global context, which independent chunk embeddings cannot capture. Existing improvements either focus on memory content storage, update, and forgetting mechanisms for long-horizon interactions, or rely on centralized single-step retrieval logic that discards potentially relevant evidence before reasoning starts, leaving a gap in properly designed memory access mechanisms for long context.
summary_en.importance: The hierarchical memory design proposed provides an engineering reference for long-context inference systems, avoiding the inference cost of naive context window expansion by restructuring long context access patterns, while clearly articulating failure modes of standard RAG under context-dependent relevance. The work is, however, focused on inference-stage system architecture design, with no changes to pretraining paradigms, base model architecture, or training pipelines, so its direct relevance to pretraining research is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: HMARS partitions long documents or interaction histories into hierarchical memory regions with asymmetric model allocation to balance retrieval coverage and inference cost: lightweight sub-agents are bound to fixed-size local pages and perform query-conditioned relevance assessment on their assigned regions; mid-tier agents manage regional shared memory and coordinate query routing; the strongest frontier base model only performs final reasoning on retrieved grounded evidence pages, never reading the full context. This design avoids the premature filtering of entire document regions that plagues centralized top-K retrieval, while keeping compute overhead manageable. The workflow has two phases: offline indexing partitions documents, binds agents to regions, and generates local memory cards; online querying routes requests through the hierarchy, with every sub-agent evaluating its local region against the query rather than being filtered out upfront, then aggregates relevant evidence pages and passes the compact evidence set to the base model for answer generation. Two diagnostic benchmarks are also constructed to stress cross-region evidence integration and context-dependent relevance, scenarios where standard RAG has low recall.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two custom diagnostic benchmarks: a filtered subset of LongBench-v2 containing questions that require evidence from distant chunks and exhibit low vanilla RAG recall, and a cumulative interaction benchmark inspired by RealMem where key facts scattered across multi-turn interactions only become relevant in later context. Disclosed results indicate HMARS shows the largest gains on settings where passive top-K retrieval and centralized memory access fail; specific model size configurations, absolute performance improvements, and ablation results are not fully disclosed in the available manuscript segment.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is an applied systems work for long-context inference, suitable for skimming. Focus on the introduction's characterization of two core failure modes of standard RAG and the core design ideas of asymmetric compute allocation and hierarchical memory management in the method section; specific prompt designs and implementation details can be skipped. Expected reading time is 15-20 minutes. Researchers working on long-context engineering and RAG systems may refer to the diagnostic benchmark construction logic; pretraining researchers can quickly scan the core design ideas, as the work involves no changes to model architecture, training objectives, or data pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 架构设计有启发，重点看§3分层内存的职责划分和附录的诊断基准构造，可作为长上下文预训练任务设计的参考
recommendation.en: Architecture design is insightful; focus on §3 hierarchical memory responsibility split and appendix diagnostic benchmark construction, useful for long-context pretraining task design.

paper.title: AB-RAG: Adaptive Budgeted Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Reliable Question Answering
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the standard way to ground large language models in external knowledge, yet most systems retrieve a fixed number of passages for every question regardless of its difficulty. This wastes computation on easy questions, starves hard ones, and gives no signal for when a generated answer can be trusted. With a growing share of question answering systems built on top of commercial language model APIs, a method that can decide how much to retrieve, and ho

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 系统对所有问题使用固定检索量的问题，使系统能按问题难度自适应分配检索预算，并给出答案可信度信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 RAG 推理流程改进。它不改动底层模型，也不需要训练，主要价值在于把检索成本、答案置信度和停止决策放进同一个预算控制框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AB-RAG，一个 training-free、backbone-agnostic 的自适应检索框架。系统先生成答案，再用三类信号估计置信度，包括模型自身确定性、答案间一致性以及检索证据支持度；若置信度不足，则继续检索，直到达到预算或停止条件。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、baseline 和数值结果。论文应主要比较固定 top-k RAG 与自适应预算 RAG 在问答可靠性、检索成本和停止准确性上的取舍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fixed-retrieval-budget problem in RAG, where easy questions waste retrieval calls and hard questions receive too little evidence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general RAG inference-control method rather than a pretraining result. Its value is in jointly modeling retrieval cost, confidence estimation, and stopping under a fixed evidence budget.
summary_en.technical_approach: AB-RAG is training-free and backbone-agnostic. It generates an initial answer, estimates confidence from three signals, including model certainty, answer agreement, and retrieved-evidence support, and decides whether to stop or retrieve more passages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete models, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected evaluation compares adaptive retrieval against fixed top-k RAG on reliability-cost trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和置信度组合即可；这是实用 RAG 控制器，不会改变预训练或模型范式判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and confidence estimator only; this is a practical RAG controller, not a result that changes pretraining or modeling priors.

paper.title: Temporal Validity in Retrieval Memory: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors for AI Agents over Evolving Knowledge
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives agents access to accumulated knowledge, but has no model of time. When a fact changes (e.g., a function is renamed or API restructured), RAG retrieves both the stale and current value with near-identical embedding similarity. The agent then either abstains or serves the superseded fact. We show this is a structural problem: on a calibrated dataset, cosine similarity distinguishes a contradicted fact from a duplicated one with AUROC 0.59 (near chance), a

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG/agent memory 在知识随时间变化时无法区分过期事实和当前事实，导致检索到 stale fact 并误用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory / RAG 系统设计。它指出 embedding similarity 对“矛盾更新”和“重复改写”的区分能力接近随机，这对长期运行 agent 的记忆机制有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemStrata，一个带 temporal validity 的 retrieval memory。系统以事实三元组形式存储信息，当 subject-relation-object 中对象值被新事实 contradicted 时，用确定性的 supersession rule 在 bi-temporal ledger 中退休旧值，不依赖相似度阈值，也不调用 LLM 判定。
summary.experiments: 论文称在校准数据集上，cosine similarity 区分 contradicted fact 与 duplicated fact 的 AUROC 只有 0.59。使用本地 7B 模型在六个 benchmark 上测试，MemStrata 在静态知识上与 RAG 持平，并针对变化事实减少 stale-fact 错误。摘要未给出完整数值。
summary.authors_note: MemStrata.dev / Called It Inc. 的企业侧工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets stale-fact errors in RAG and agent memory when retrieved knowledge changes over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a system-level contribution for agent memory and RAG. Its useful observation is that embedding similarity is nearly unable to separate contradicted updates from paraphrased duplicates, which matters for long-running agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemStrata stores facts like a retrieval memory but adds temporal validity. When a subject-relation-object fact is superseded by a contradictory value, a deterministic supersession rule retires the old value in a bi-temporal ledger, without similarity thresholds or LLM calls.
summary_en.experiments: On a calibrated dataset, cosine similarity distinguishes contradicted facts from duplicated facts with AUROC 0.59. The paper reports six local benchmarks with a 7B model, where MemStrata preserves static-knowledge recall comparable to RAG and reduces stale-fact errors. The abstract does not provide full numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Enterprise work from MemStrata.dev / Called It Inc.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和实验表就够；时间有效性是长期 agent 的真问题，但 SRO 规则更像工程约束，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Abstract and result tables are enough; temporal validity is real for long-lived agents, but the SRO ledger is an engineering constraint, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Lacuna: A Research Map for Machine Learning
paper.abstract: Lacuna is a research map for machine learning that uses LLMs to turn papers and scholarly metadata into markdown summaries, concept elements, research directions, and research proposals. Each item keeps links to the primary source records and papers that support it. We release the map with web, markdown, and MCP interfaces. Across LitSearch, Multi-XScience-CS/ML, and ScholarQA-CS-ML, Lacuna outperforms OpenScholar with the strongest gains on LitSearch retrieval (Recall@10 0.538 vs. 0.424 for Ope

summary.core_problem: 构建一个面向机器学习研究的 LLM 驱动研究地图，把论文、元数据、概念、研究方向和报告生成连接成可检索系统。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统创新和研究工作流工具，而不是预训练方法本身；对基座研究员的价值在于观察 LLM 如何被用于文献结构化、引用追踪和研究问题生成。
summary.technical_approach: Lacuna 使用 LLM 将论文与学术元数据转换为 markdown 摘要、概念元素、研究方向和研究提案，并保留到原始论文和记录的链接；系统提供 Web、markdown 和 MCP 接口，并在研究地图之上构建多阶段 Deep Research 报告 agent。
summary.experiments: 在 LitSearch、Multi-XScience-CS/ML、ScholarQA-CS-ML 上评估检索和学术问答能力；LitSearch Recall@10 为 0.538，高于 OpenScholar v3 的 0.424。25 个 ReportBench-ML 综述任务上，Lacuna Deep Research 的 citation F1 为 0.052、citation precision 为 0.339、专家参考命中 99、RACE 报告质量 7.82/10；GPT-Researcher 分别为 0.039、0.290、72、5.24/10。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Hugo Larochelle、Chris Pal、Nasim Rahaman 等机器学习社区知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds an LLM-based research map for machine learning, linking papers, metadata, concepts, research directions, and report generation into a searchable system.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a research-workflow system rather than a pretraining method. For foundation-model researchers, the useful part is the design of structured literature representations with source-grounded links and downstream report agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Lacuna uses LLMs to convert papers and scholarly metadata into markdown summaries, concept elements, research directions, and research proposals, while preserving links to primary source records. It exposes web, markdown, and MCP interfaces and adds a multi-stage Deep Research agent operating over the map.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on LitSearch, Multi-XScience-CS/ML, and ScholarQA-CS-ML. On LitSearch, Recall@10 reaches 0.538 versus 0.424 for OpenScholar v3. On 25 ReportBench-ML survey tasks, Lacuna Deep Research obtains 0.052 citation F1, 0.339 citation precision, 99 expert-reference hits, and 7.82/10 RACE report quality, compared with 0.039, 0.290, 72, and 5.24/10 for GPT-Researcher.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes well-known ML researchers such as Hugo Larochelle, Chris Pal, and Nasim Rahaman.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文；只看系统设计和检索评测，作为内部文献 agent 的参考即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the system design and retrieval results if building an internal literature agent.

paper.title: Is GraphRAG Needed? From Basic RAG to Graph-/Agentic Solutions with Context Optimization
paper.abstract: As advanced RAG variants like GraphRAG and Agentic RAG emerge, one leading question is when and how to use them. Here, we introduce a framework for different RAG scenarios evaluation and comparison on semi-structured knowledge bases, including regular RAG, GraphRAG, Modular RAG and Agentic RAG. We provide implementation for 9 standardized RAG scenarios, and conduct experiments for a comprehensive comparison.
