These scenarios are designed for real use cases regarding data and domain restrictions,

summary.core_problem: 回答在半结构化知识库场景中，普通 RAG、GraphRAG、Modular RAG 和 Agentic RAG 分别适合什么任务，以及如何控制复杂 RAG 的上下文开销。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统比较和工程方法：把 9 类 RAG 使用场景标准化，覆盖文档检索、文本-图混合检索、领域知识图谱、agent 多步规划和 agent-graph 集成，并针对 GraphRAG 与 Agentic RAG 的上下文溢出问题提出压缩与管理策略。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建了一套 RAG 场景评估框架，并实现 9 个标准化流程。方法侧重点不是新的基础模型，而是 context engineering：用新的文本/图表示管理检索内容，在 agentic loop 中控制记忆和上下文增长，减少不必要的 graph/text retrieval token 注入。
summary.experiments: 实验比较 regular RAG、GraphRAG、Modular RAG、Agentic RAG 等方案在多类半结构化知识库任务上的表现。摘要明确报告 context optimization 可减少 19%-53% token 使用，但未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体任务分数细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 AWS Generative AI Innovation Center 和 Cisco Systems，工作更偏企业 RAG 系统与落地场景比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when basic RAG is enough and when graph- or agent-based RAG is justified for semi-structured knowledge bases, especially under context budget limits.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly a systems comparison and engineering framework: it standardizes nine RAG scenarios ranging from document retrieval to hybrid graph-text retrieval, domain knowledge graphs, multi-step agent planning, and agent-graph integration.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work implements regular RAG, GraphRAG, Modular RAG, and Agentic RAG variants, then adds a context engineering method for GraphRAG and Agentic RAG. The method uses new text/graph representations and an agentic loop design to reduce memory and context overflow.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare multiple RAG pipelines over semi-structured knowledge-base settings. The abstract reports a 19%-53% reduction in token usage from the context optimization method, but does not specify model sizes, dataset sizes, or full task metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from AWS Generative AI Innovation Center and Cisco Systems; the paper is oriented toward enterprise RAG design rather than foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练帮助有限，只看系统矩阵和 token 节省结果；它更像 RAG 选型指南，不会改变模型训练 prior。
recommendation.en: Limited value for pretraining; scan the scenario matrix and token-saving results, since this is mostly a RAG design guide rather than a model-training signal.

institutions: Generative AI Innovation Center, Amazon Web Services
Generative AI Innovation Center, Amazon Web Services (AWS)

paper.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
paper.abstract: Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary ov

summary.core_problem: 论文关注开放式、多步 persuasion agent 中的误差累积问题，尤其是早期检索或策略选择失误如何在长轨迹中放大并导致问题漂移与迎合。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 系统方法，不是基座预训练工作。价值在于它指出语义检索在主观任务中会把“主题相似”误当成“策略可迁移”，对做 agent memory/RAG 的研究员有参考意义，但对 pretrain 的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者将标准 RAG 的失败归因于 semantic leakage：检索器按词汇/语义相似度取回内容，混入了与当前任务无关但表面相似的主题信息。为此提出 Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG)，通过离散类别瓶颈先把策略映射到 taxonomy，再按类别路由检索，以解耦论证结构与主题内容，减少长程轨迹中的污染传播。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 zero-shot、cross-domain 设定下，TS-RAG 相比标准语义检索能更好迁移抽象逻辑，并在不对称部署中帮助轻量模型借助重模型生成的策略库。未见模型参数、数据规模和量化提升幅度，说明更像系统概念验证而非大规模严谨 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies compounding failures in open-ended, multi-step persuasion agents, where early retrieval or strategy errors amplify over long trajectories and lead to drift and sycophancy.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining work. Its main value is the observation that semantic retrieval can confuse topical similarity with strategic transferability in subjective tasks. Useful for agent memory/RAG work, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors attribute failures of standard RAG to semantic leakage: retrieval based on lexical/semantic overlap pulls in topically similar but strategically irrelevant content. They propose Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), which inserts a discrete categorical bottleneck by mapping strategies into a taxonomy and routing retrieval through that taxonomy, decoupling argumentative structure from topical content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims zero-shot cross-domain gains over standard semantic retrieval, especially for transferring abstract logic, and highlights asymmetric deployments where smaller models benefit from strategy libraries produced by stronger models. No model sizes, dataset scales, or effect sizes are given, so this reads more like a systems proof-of-concept than a large-scale clean benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 想做 agent memory/RAG 可以看它对 semantic leakage 的诊断；但实验信息不够干净，先读问题定义和方法图，别急着把 taxonomy bottleneck 当通用解。
recommendation.en: Worth a look for its semantic-leakage diagnosis in agent memory/RAG, but the setup looks under-specified; read the problem framing and method figure before treating the taxonomy bottleneck as a general solution.

paper.title: Fixed RAG Compression Collapses Measured Reader Scaling
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) compression papers often evaluate a compressor on one to three readers and treat the compressed evidence layer as evaluation-neutral. We show this assumption is false: fixed compression can raise average accuracy while hiding reader upgrades and reversing model rankings. Across 20 readers and ten domain-method settings over four QA benchmarks and one summarization benchmark, compression gain decreases with reader baseline (nine of ten settings significant, p

summary.core_problem: 这项工作指出，RAG 压缩层不是评测中性的组件。固定压缩器可能提高平均准确率，但会遮蔽强 reader 的真实增益，甚至改变模型排序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在评测方法。它提醒模型能力比较不能把检索后处理视为固定背景变量。对于长上下文、RAG、memory benchmark 和 reader scaling 评测，这个问题会把“模型是否真的更强”混入“压缩后还剩多少信息”。如果用压缩后的证据层评估基座模型或指令模型，强模型可利用的细节被提前删掉，测得的 scaling 曲线会变平。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把固定压缩看成 reader 评测中的信息瓶颈，而不是提出新压缩器。论文用两个相反作用解释现象：一是 noise-reduction benefit，压缩删掉无关内容，弱 reader 更容易受益；二是 information-loss cost，压缩也会删掉多跳关系、否定、时间线索、消歧数字等细节，强 reader 原本能利用这些信息，因此受损更明显。论文提出 upgrade retention，用来衡量 raw evidence 上的模型升级有多少能在压缩后保留下来；又做 row-level outcome decomposition，把样本分成 rescued、damaged、unchanged、corrected generations，以区分“去噪带来的真实帮助”和“信息丢失造成的评测压制”。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 20 个 reader，来自 12 个模型家族，能力范围从 7B 到 frontier 级别；任务包括四个 QA benchmark 和一个 query-focused meeting summarization benchmark，并测试多个 post-retrieval transformation。主要结果很清楚：十个 domain-method setting 中有九个显示压缩收益随 reader baseline 升高而下降，且统计显著，p < 0.05。HotpotQA 上，从 Qwen 7B 升级到 GPT-4.1-mini，在 raw evidence 下准确率提升 45.4 个百分点；使用固定 RECOMP 后只剩 9.0 个百分点，约 80% 的升级被压缩层遮蔽。LongMemEval-S 上，generic summarization 反转了 31% 的 pairwise model rankings。行级分析也支持机制解释：最弱 reader 有 98 个 rescued rows 和 32 个 damaged rows，rescue:damage 为 3.1:1；最强 reader 变成 45 个 rescued 和 41 个 damaged，比例接近 1.1:1。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 HotpotQA 和 LongMemEval-S 的两个例子，能快速理解问题规模。然后看 Framework: Two Opposing Forces，重点是 B(x) 与 D(x) 的设定，以及 row-level decomposition 的定义。图 1 和图 2 值得看，前者说明固定压缩层如何变成评测瓶颈，后者展示弱模型和强模型的 rescued/damaged 分布差异。若关心 RAG benchmark 设计，应重点看 upgrade retention 的定义和 prior compression papers reanalysis，因为这部分最容易迁移到自己的评测协议中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper shows that a fixed RAG compression layer is not evaluation-neutral. It can improve average accuracy while suppressing real reader upgrades and even reversing model rankings.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation methodology rather than pretraining algorithms. It matters for measuring reader scaling, long-context capability, memory benchmarks, and RAG-augmented model comparisons. Once evidence is compressed before reaching the reader, the benchmark no longer measures reader capability alone. It also measures which clues survived the compressor. This can make stronger models look less improved because they are prevented from using details that would have been available in raw retrieval results.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper treats fixed compression as an evaluation bottleneck. It explains the effect through two forces. Compression gives a noise-reduction benefit, which is larger for weak readers because irrelevant retrieved passages are hard for them to filter. Compression also creates an information-loss cost by dropping multi-hop links, negations, temporal cues, disambiguating numbers, and other clues that stronger readers could have used. The paper introduces upgrade retention, the fraction of a raw reader upgrade that remains after compression. It also decomposes row-level outcomes into rescued, damaged, unchanged, and corrected generations, separating helpful denoising from harmful evidence loss.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers 20 readers from 12 model families, ranging from 7B-scale models to frontier-scale readers. It evaluates multiple post-retrieval transformations on four QA benchmarks and one query-focused meeting summarization benchmark. In nine out of ten domain-method settings, compression gains decrease significantly as reader baseline improves, with p < 0.05. On HotpotQA, the raw-evidence upgrade from Qwen 7B to GPT-4.1-mini is 45.4 accuracy points; under a fixed RECOMP layer, the measured upgrade shrinks to 9.0 points, hiding about 80% of the raw improvement. On LongMemEval-S, generic summarization flips 31% of pairwise model rankings. Row-level analysis supports the mechanism: for the weakest reader, 98 rows are rescued and 32 are damaged, a 3.1:1 rescue-to-damage ratio; for the strongest reader, the ratio drops to 45 rescued versus 41 damaged, close to 1.1:1.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25-minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with the Introduction examples on HotpotQA and LongMemEval-S to understand the size of the artifact. Then read the “Two Opposing Forces” framework, especially the definitions of B(x), D(x), upgrade retention, and row-level outcome decomposition. Figures 1 and 2 are the most useful entry points: one frames compression as an evaluation bottleneck, and the other shows how rescued and damaged rows shift with reader strength. For RAG benchmark design, spend extra time on the upgrade-retention protocol and the reanalysis of prior compression papers.

recommendation.zh: RAG压缩评测的致命盲区，做检索增强预训练或长上下文评测的团队必须读§4的机制拆解与Table 2的排名翻转数据
recommendation.en: A critical blind spot in RAG compression evaluation; teams working on retrieval-augmented pretraining or long-context evaluation must read §4 for mechanism decomposition and Table 2 for ranking flip data.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
paper.abstract: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of ag

summary.core_problem: 分散部署的多Agent群体中，每个Agent产生的轨迹（procedural knowledge）通常用完即丢，新Agent反复重解已有问题，缺乏群体级记忆共享基础设施。
summary.importance: 把RAG从'Agent检索人类产出物'扩展到'Agent群体共享自身产出轨迹'的transactive memory框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MATM（Multi-Agent Transactive Memory）：producer Agent将解决任务的轨迹写入群体级存储，后续Agent通过检索这些Agent生成的轨迹复用程序性知识，而不是只依赖人类文档或重新探索。
summary.experiments: 论文为框架性提案，摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据或定量SOTA结果。

summary_en.core_problem: In decentralized multi-agent populations, agent trajectories encoding reusable procedural knowledge are typically discarded after single use, forcing new agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions.
summary_en.importance: Extends RAG-style retrieval of human-authored artifacts to population-level storage and reuse of agent-generated trajectories via a transactive memory framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MATM (Multi-Agent Transactive Memory), where producer agents contribute their trajectories to a population-level memory, and downstream agents retrieve and reuse this agent-generated procedural knowledge instead of relying only on human-authored documents or rediscovering solutions.
summary_en.experiments: A framework proposal; the abstract does not report concrete model scales, datasets, or quantitative SOTA results.

recommendation.zh: 把'Agent轨迹当语料'做群体级记忆是个干净的想法，对长期运行Agent系统的数据回流有启发，但当前是框架论文无硬结果，知道即可。
recommendation.en: A clean framing of treating agent trajectories as first-class retrievable artifacts for population memory; conceptually relevant to data flywheels, but framework-only with no hard results—know the idea, skip the details.

paper.title: Navigating Unreliable Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: Explicit Knowledge Conflict Resolution for LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of language-based tasks by leveraging both extensive parametric knowledge and in-context learning ability, enabling them to incorporate external information provided in the input prompt. However, the integration of external knowledge can introduce conflicts, not only between the model's internal parametric knowledge and the external information, but also among multiple pieces of external contexts. Existing approach

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 推理时同时处理参数知识与上下文知识之间、以及多段上下文之间的冲突，且不预设任一来源完全可靠。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理时知识冲突处理框架。它触及 RAG 和长上下文推理中的真实问题，但从摘要看更像 inference-time orchestration，而不是预训练、后训练或知识编辑方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MACR，一个显式知识冲突解决框架，用多智能体推理机制识别并处理参数知识和外部上下文的不一致；核心区别是避免简单地偏向模型记忆或偏向检索上下文，而是尝试对冲突本身做解析。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集、被测模型、baseline、冲突类型划分或提升幅度；因此只能判断问题设定合理，无法判断方法是否稳健。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to resolve conflicts between an LLM's parametric knowledge and external context, as well as conflicts among multiple context passages, without assuming either source is reliable.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time knowledge-conflict resolution framework. It addresses a real RAG and long-context issue, but from the abstract it looks more like orchestration than pretraining, post-training, or model editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: MACR introduces an explicit conflict-resolution mechanism based on multi-agent reasoning. Rather than always trusting model memory or always trusting retrieved context, it attempts to identify inconsistencies and reason over them directly.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide datasets, evaluated models, baselines, conflict taxonomies, or effect sizes, so the robustness of the method cannot be assessed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 问题设定对 RAG 很现实，但多 agent 解冲突常有包装风险；只看实验里冲突构造是否干净。
recommendation.en: The RAG conflict setting is real, but multi-agent resolution is easy to over-package; only check whether the conflict construction is clean.

paper.title: SproutRAG: Attention-Guided Tree Search with Progressive Embeddings for Long-Document RAG
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems must balance retrieval granularity with contextual coherence, a challenge that existing methods address through LLM-guided chunking, single-level context expansion, or hierarchical summarization. These approaches variously depend on costly LLM calls during indexing or retrieval, limit context aggregation to a single granularity level, or introduce information loss through summarization. We present SproutRAG, an attention-guided hierarchical RAG framew

summary.core_problem: 解决长文档 RAG 中检索粒度、上下文连贯性和索引/检索成本之间的权衡问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG 系统方法改进。它不是基座预训练工作，但对长上下文外部记忆、分层检索和无 LLM 索引的工程设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SproutRAG：用句间 attention 构建二叉 chunking tree，把句级片段组织成逐步变大的语义单元；检索时可在多粒度节点上搜索，不依赖额外 LLM 调用，也不通过摘要压缩文档。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集、模型规模和数值结果。实验应与 LLM-guided chunking、固定窗口扩展、层次摘要和普通 dense retrieval 等方法比较，重点看准确率、召回、上下文长度和索引/查询成本。
summary.authors_note: University of British Columbia 与 ServiceNow Research。Peter West 是长文本生成、评测和 NLP 系统方向较活跃的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off between retrieval granularity, contextual coherence, and cost in long-document RAG.
summary_en.importance: This is a RAG systems contribution rather than a pretraining paper. It is still relevant as a design point for hierarchical external memory and non-LLM indexing.
summary_en.technical_approach: SproutRAG builds a binary chunking tree from sentence-level chunks using learned inter-sentence attention. Retrieval can operate over multiple granularities without extra LLM calls or lossy summarization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report datasets, model sizes, or numerical gains. The relevant comparisons are against LLM-guided chunking, fixed context expansion, hierarchical summarization, and standard dense retrieval.
summary_en.authors_note: University of British Columbia and ServiceNow Research. Peter West is known for work around long-form generation, evaluation, and NLP systems.

recommendation.zh: 看树构建和检索策略即可；对预训练没直接动作，但可借鉴到长上下文记忆组织。
recommendation.en: Skim the tree construction and retrieval policy; it does not change pretraining, but it is a useful memory-organization pattern.

paper.title: A Unified Framework for Context-Aware and Relation-Aware Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, yet existing graph-based methods face a fundamental limitation: entity-centric and chunk-centric approaches operate on representations anchored to original text without true knowledge fusion. While entity-centric methods connect logically related content and chunk-centric methods preserve context, both retrieve information separately through similarity search, missin

summary.core_problem: 解决图RAG中实体中心和chunk中心方法各自割裂的问题：前者能连接关系但丢上下文，后者保留上下文但难以融合关系知识。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是RAG系统方法改进。它试图把上下文信息和关系信息融合进层级图索引，用于提升检索阶段的综合表示能力。对预训练本身不直接相关，但对外部知识接入和agent memory有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HyGRAG层级图RAG框架，在混合表示上构建层级索引，生成同时整合上下文和关系信息的摘要节点，并利用这些合成表示进行检索；同时考虑动态语料下层级结构的高效更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出数据集、模型、baseline和具体提升数值。可确认评估重点应是graph-based RAG检索与问答表现，以及动态语料更新效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a split in graph RAG: entity-centric methods capture relations but lose context, while chunk-centric methods preserve context but fail to fuse relational knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is a RAG-system method contribution. It aims to fuse contextual and relational information into a hierarchical graph index for better retrieval representations. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may be useful for external knowledge access and agent memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: HyGRAG builds hierarchical index structures over hybrid representations, creates summary nodes that integrate both contextual and relational information, retrieves through these synthesized representations, and includes mechanisms for efficient updates under dynamic corpora.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide datasets, models, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation focus is graph-based RAG retrieval/QA quality and update efficiency for dynamic corpora.

recommendation.zh: 常规RAG系统增量；若做agent memory可看索引构造，预训练视角不必读实验细节。
recommendation.en: A conventional RAG-system increment; useful for agent-memory indexing, but pretraining researchers need not read the experiments closely.

paper.title: Context Compression Is Not One Thing: Readable Symbolic Re-expression vs. Coherent Summary at Matched Budget
paper.abstract: We study context compression for multi-hop question answering with small language models. We propose Telegraph English, a readable symbolic format that rewrites retrieved passages into structured entity-relation statements, preserving reasoning evidence at lower token cost. In controlled experiments on MuSiQue, TwoWiki, and HotpotQA, Telegraph English outperforms three matched-budget compression baselines (character-level deletion, truncation, and random sub-sampling) on every dataset, with gain

summary.core_problem: 研究长上下文压缩时，同样 token 预算下，结构化可读重写与连贯自然语言摘要是否保留了不同类型的推理证据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长上下文推理中的压缩表示分析。它提醒上下文压缩不是单一问题：压缩后的文本是否流畅，和是否高密度保留实体关系证据，是两件事。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Telegraph English，将检索段落改写成可读的实体-关系式符号表达。方法重点不是生成摘要，而是在更少 token 中显式保留多跳问答需要的实体、关系和证据链。
summary.experiments: 在 MuSiQue、TwoWiki 和 HotpotQA 上，用小语言模型做多跳问答。Telegraph English 在三个数据集上都超过字符删除、截断、随机子采样三个同预算压缩 baseline，提升 13 到 20 个 F1 点；在最难数据集上也超过同一 encoder 生成的连贯 prose summary。预注册的推理深度交互假设未成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether, at the same token budget, readable symbolic re-expression and coherent prose summaries preserve different evidence for multi-hop QA.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis and method contribution for context compression. It separates fluency from evidence density, which matters for long-context and retrieval-augmented inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Telegraph English, a readable symbolic format that rewrites retrieved passages into structured entity-relation statements. The goal is to retain multi-hop evidence more densely than natural language summaries.
summary_en.experiments: On MuSiQue, TwoWiki, and HotpotQA with small language models, Telegraph English beats character deletion, truncation, and random sub-sampling at matched budgets by 13 to 20 F1 points. It also beats a coherent prose summary from the same encoder on the hardest dataset. The pre-registered depth-interaction hypothesis is null.

recommendation.zh: 结论像工程常识但数字干净；看实验表和深度交互的 null result，别把它当通用压缩定律。
recommendation.en: The finding is plausible but cleanly measured; read the tables and the null depth-interaction result, not as a universal compression law.

paper.title: Understanding the Behaviors of Environment-aware Information Retrieval
paper.abstract: Recent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches have demonstrated strong capability in handling complex queries, yet current research overlooks a critical challenge: different retrievers require fundamentally different query formulation strategies for optimal performance. In this work, we present the first systematic analysis of how LLMs can learn to adapt their query formulation strategies for different retrievers via reinforcement learning (RL). Our empirical study reveals that RL effec

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在 RAG 中如何针对不同 retriever 学会不同的 query formulation，而不是把检索器当作统一黑盒。
summary.importance: 价值在于把“环境感知的检索策略学习”明确化，并用 RL 分析 retriever-specific policy。它更偏 agent/RAG 训练，但对 post-train 如何适配外部系统有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过强化学习让 LLM 在多步检索轨迹中学习面向特定 retriever 的查询风格；论文还引入 branching-based 机制来改善多步检索训练，并分析人类指导和模型规模的作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示比较了不同 retriever 下的最优 query style，发现描述式与问句式等风格偏好显著不同；还考察了 RL、人工指导和模型规模扩展的影响。未从摘要看到预训练规模级实验，更像 RAG policy learning 的系统分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、阿里达摩院、香港中文大学、斯坦福大学、上财等。阿里达摩院参与使其在工业 RAG 研究上有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how an LLM in RAG should learn retriever-specific query formulation instead of treating all retrievers as the same black box.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in making environment-aware retrieval policy explicit and analyzing retriever-specific RL behavior. This is more agent/RAG training than pretraining, but it does inform how post-training should adapt to external systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses reinforcement learning to teach an LLM to produce query styles tailored to specific retrievers over multi-step retrieval trajectories, with a branching-based mechanism to support trajectory learning and analyses of human guidance and model scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that different retrievers prefer markedly different query styles, such as descriptive versus question-like formulations, and that RL, human guidance, and larger models improve adaptation. It does not read like a pretraining-scale study; it is closer to a system-level RAG policy analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Fudan University, Alibaba DAMO Academy, CUHK, Stanford University, and SUFE. DAMO's involvement gives it some weight as an industrial RAG research effort.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你别把 retrieval interface 当静态组件；看 query-style 分化和 branching 训练设计，别被 RL 包装吓到。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully breaks the assumption that retrieval is a fixed interface; read it for query-style divergence and the branching RL setup.

institutions: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

paper.title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
paper.abstract: Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison,

summary.core_problem: 在大型语料库上进行 Agentic 搜索时，传统的检索器接口限制了 Agent 重组和验证跨文档信息的能力，而直接语料库交互 (DCI) 在语料库变大时会变得缓慢且不稳定。
summary.importance: 提出了 Dr-DCI 框架，巧妙结合了检索器的高召回率和 DCI 的细粒度操作能力，解决了大规模语料库下 Agent 搜索的扩展性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 将检索视为一种可由 Agent 调用的动作，用于扩展本地工作区 (workspace)。Agent 不直接在全量语料库上操作，而是动态地将相关文档拉取到不断演进的工作区中，并在工作区内执行 DCI 操作（如搜索、过滤、比较）。
summary.experiments: 未提供具体实验数据，但摘要指出该设计结合了 retriever-level recall 和 DCI 的灵活性。
summary.authors_note: 多伦多大学、德州农工和滑铁卢大学合作，Jimmy Lin 和 Wenhu Chen 参与，聚焦于 RAG 和 Agentic Search 的架构改进。

summary_en.core_problem: In agentic search over large corpora, traditional retriever interfaces limit the agent's ability to reorganize and verify cross-document information, while Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) becomes slow and unstable as the corpus scales.
summary_en.importance: Introduces the Dr-DCI framework, which cleverly combines the high recall of retrievers with the fine-grained operational capabilities of DCI, solving the scalability issue of agentic search over massive corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: Treats retrieval as an agent-callable action to expand a local workspace. Instead of operating directly on the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations (search, filter, compare) within it.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental data is not provided in the abstract, but it claims to combine retriever-level recall with DCI flexibility.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration among UofT, Texas A&M, and UWaterloo, involving Jimmy Lin and Wenhu Chen, focusing on architectural improvements for RAG and Agentic Search.

recommendation.zh: 将检索作为 action 来动态构建 local workspace，是解决长上下文/大规模 RAG 扩展性的一种优雅系统设计，做 Agentic RAG 的值得一看。
recommendation.en: Treating retrieval as an action to dynamically build a local workspace is an elegant system design for scaling long-context/massive RAG; worth reading for Agentic RAG researchers.

paper.title: Privacy-Preserving Text Sanitization for Distributed Agents Collaboration via Disentangled Representations
paper.abstract: When distributed agents exchange text across organizational boundaries, privacy leakage arises not only from explicit identifiers but also from distributional signatures such as formatting conventions, vocabulary choices, and syntactic patterns. We propose DiSan(Disentangled Sanitization), a privacy-preserving sanitization framework and a built-in component of Intern-Shannon for multi-agent collaboration. DiSan uses a two-stream encoder to factorize text into a source-invariant role subspace tha

summary.core_problem: 解决跨组织分布式 agent 协作时，文本交换不仅泄露显式 PII，也会通过格式、词汇和句法风格泄露来源身份的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向多 agent 协作的隐私保护组件，强调 stylometric leakage 不是简单脱敏能解决。它不是基座预训练工作，但对 agent 系统中的数据边界和隐私接口有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DiSan，将文本编码为两个子空间：保留任务语义的 source-invariant role subspace，以及只在本地保留的 source-identifying style subspace。训练上使用联邦 prototype alignment 和 adversarial regularization，使多方无需集中原始文本也能联合训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告，简单标识符 mask 掉 19.2% token 后，TF-IDF stylometric attribution 只下降 18.6%；DiSan 将 answer-level PII exposure 降低 20 倍，同时在分布式 multi-agent RAG benchmark 上保持 83% answer faithfulness。未给出模型规模和更多 baseline 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory 和 Shanghai Jiao Tong University；DiSan 被描述为 Intern-Shannon 的内置组件。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses privacy leakage in cross-organization distributed agent collaboration, where exchanged text can reveal source identity through formatting, vocabulary, and syntax beyond explicit PII.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a privacy-preserving component for multi-agent collaboration, with a useful emphasis on stylometric leakage. It is not a foundation-model pretraining result, but it informs privacy boundaries in agent systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiSan factorizes text into a source-invariant role subspace that preserves task semantics and a source-identifying style subspace that remains local. It uses federated prototype alignment and adversarial regularization so parties can train jointly without centralizing raw text.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that masking 19.2% of tokens reduces TF-IDF stylometric attribution by only 18.6%, while DiSan reduces answer-level PII exposure by 20x and preserves 83% answer faithfulness on a distributed multi-agent RAG benchmark. Model scale and detailed baselines are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and Shanghai Jiao Tong University; DiSan is described as a built-in component of Intern-Shannon.

recommendation.zh: 结论比方法更有用：显式 PII mask 挡不住风格泄露；agent 隐私接口设计时应记住这个负例。
recommendation.en: The finding is more useful than the method: explicit PII masking misses style leakage, a failure mode to remember when designing agent privacy interfaces.

institutions: Privacy-Preserving Text Sanitization for Distributed Agents Collaboration

paper.title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers an effective approach for large language models to access external knowledge. However, existing methods rely on dense similarity retrieval and face inherent limitations in handling structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning. Incorporating knowledge graphs partially alleviates these issues, but at the cost of semantic fragmentation, high maintenance overhead, and difficult incremental updates. This paper introduces SAG (SQLRetrieval Augmented Genera

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG方法依赖稠密相似性检索，在处理结构化约束和多跳推理上有局限；知识图谱方法则存在语义碎片化、维护成本高和增量更新困难等问题。
summary.importance: 提出一种结构化检索架构SAG，用SQL动态超边替代预构建的静态知识图谱，支持增量更新。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个文本块转换为一个语义完整的事件和一组索引实体；查询时通过SQL join查询动态链接共享实体的事件，构建局部超边；无需全局图谱重建和持续维护，天然支持增量更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要截断，具体实验结果不可得。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构未明确列出。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RAG methods rely on dense similarity retrieval and struggle with structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning; knowledge graph approaches suffer from semantic fragmentation, high maintenance cost, and difficult incremental updates.
summary_en.importance: Proposes SAG, a structured retrieval architecture using SQL dynamic hyperedges as an alternative to pre-built static knowledge graphs, supporting incremental updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Converts each chunk into one semantically complete event and a set of indexing entities; at query time, uses SQL join queries to dynamically link events sharing entities into local hyperedges; avoids global graph rebuilding and ongoing maintenance, naturally supports incremental updates.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; specific experimental results unavailable.
summary_en.authors_note: Author institutions not explicitly listed.

recommendation.zh: 用SQL动态超边替代静态KG的RAG架构，思路有新意但属于检索工程优化，与预训练研究无关，扫一眼摘要。
recommendation.en: RAG architecture using SQL dynamic hyperedges instead of static KG; novel idea but retrieval engineering optimization, unrelated to pretraining. Glance at abstract.

paper.title: Authority, Truth, and Citation Bias: A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Benchmark for Studying Epistemic Susceptibility in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in citation-augmented settings, yet the effect of citation presence on model behavior independent of factual content remains poorly understood. We introduce AuthorityBench, a 220,564-prompt multi-domain benchmark that isolates how citation-based authority signals influence epistemic behavior in LLMs. The benchmark uses a fully balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing claim veracity with citation veracity, the first to do so, across four domains (gene

summary.core_problem: 构造一个评测来隔离“引用看起来权威”这一信号本身如何改变 LLM 对事实真假的判断和幻觉行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Benchmark 和评测协议：AuthorityBench 用大规模平衡实验设计把 claim 真伪和 citation 真伪解耦，直接测量模型对权威线索的认识论脆弱性；这对 RAG、引用增强回答、后训练偏好数据和事实性评测都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 2x2 factorial design：同时控制 claim veracity 与 citation veracity，并加入无引用 baseline。数据覆盖 general knowledge、science、law、medicine 四个领域，包含 40 个 prompt templates、四档 venue prestige、带国家编码的作者姓名变量，尽量把“引用存在感”“引用真实性”“命题真实性”“声望线索”分开测。
summary.experiments: Benchmark 规模为 220,564 个 prompts，评测 7 个模型和 12 个结构化研究问题。主要发现是：无论引用真实还是伪造，引用存在都会相对无引用 baseline 提高幻觉率；当真实命题搭配伪造引用时，幻觉率上升最明显，幅度为 3 到 22 个百分点。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark isolates how citation-based authority cues, independent of factual content, change LLM truth judgments and hallucination behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation asset and protocol. AuthorityBench decouples claim veracity from citation veracity, making it useful for studying citation-augmented generation, RAG-style interfaces, factuality training, and post-training reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a balanced 2x2 factorial design crossing true versus false claims with true versus fabricated citations, plus a no-citation baseline. It spans general knowledge, science, law, and medicine, with controlled prompt templates, venue prestige tiers, and country-coded author-name variation.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 220,564 prompts and evaluates seven models across 12 structured research questions. The reported finding is that citation presence, whether real or fabricated, consistently increases hallucination relative to no citation; fabricated citations attached to true claims raise hallucination by 3 to 22 percentage points.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 hallucination 分解表；它会提醒你别把“带引用”当作事实性 reward 的干净信号。
recommendation.en: Read the design and hallucination breakdown; it is a useful warning against treating citation presence as a clean factuality reward signal.

paper.title: From Verdict to Process: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Stage Fact Verification
paper.abstract: Recent approaches combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented reasoning have shown promise for automated fact verification. To process complex claims, these verification pipelines typically execute multi-stage workflows that coordinate tightly coupled modules, including claim decomposition, evidence gathering, and verdict prediction. However, existing methods optimize individual stages in isolation or rely on fixed heuristics, which limits adaptive coordination among stages a

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂事实核查流水线中 claim decomposition、evidence seeking、answer generation 和 verdict prediction 各阶段被孤立优化，导致整体轨迹协调不佳的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agentic RL 方法，用过程奖励优化多阶段检索增强推理轨迹。它不是预训练工作，但对 RL 训练信号设计、process supervision、agent pipeline 端到端优化有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProFact，将多阶段事实核查看作一个统一策略的轨迹优化问题。模型学习协调 claim decomposition、证据检索、答案生成和最终 verdict；为缓解最终真假标签带来的稀疏延迟监督，引入 process-aware rewards，在中间阶段提供学习信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出数据集名称、模型规模、检索器配置、RL 算法、baseline 或具体提升幅度。实验目标是验证端到端 agentic RL 相比单阶段优化或固定启发式流程能改善事实核查效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses poor coordination in multi-stage fact verification pipelines where decomposition, evidence gathering, generation, and verdict prediction are optimized separately.
summary_en.importance: This is an agentic RL contribution focused on process supervision for retrieval-augmented reasoning. It is not pretraining work, but it offers a useful signal-design pattern for training multi-step LLM systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProFact trains a unified policy over the full verification trajectory, coordinating claim decomposition, evidence seeking, answer generation, and final verdict prediction. To handle sparse delayed supervision from final labels, it adds process-aware rewards at intermediate stages.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify datasets, model sizes, retriever setup, RL algorithm details, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against isolated stage optimization and fixed heuristic workflows.

recommendation.zh: 只看 process reward 设计即可；若实验细节缺失，结论只能当 agent RL 信号工程的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Read only the process-reward design; without clean experimental details, treat it as weak evidence for agent RL signal engineering.

paper.title: The Structural Attention Tax: How Retrieval Format Hijacks In-Context Learning Independent of Content
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems inject external knowledge to improve LLM outputs, yet the format of injected content -- distinct from its semantic relevance -- can independently distort the model's attention distribution. We identify and formalise a phenomenon we term the structural attention tax: knowledge graph (KG) triples, due to their relational delimiters and repeated slot patterns, capture 2-3x more attention per token than semantically equivalent natural-language text ($\hat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“检索到什么”，而是“检索结果以什么格式进入上下文”。作者要解决的核心问题是：在 RAG 或 augmented ICL 中，结构化知识片段，尤其是 KG triples，会不会仅仅因为分隔符、槽位重复、关系词模板这些表面结构，就系统性地吸走注意力，从而挤压 demonstrations 和任务相关上下文的注意力预算。论文把这个现象定义为 structural attention tax，并试图把“格式偏置”和“语义价值”拆开分析：前者决定注意力被转移多少，后者决定这种转移究竟帮忙还是添乱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它提醒人们 transformer 的上下文竞争不只受语义驱动，还受 token 级结构先验影响；这对 prompt 设计、RAG 接口、训练时数据格式混合都有直接意义。第二，它把 retrieval/source quality 与 prompt formatting 分成两条正交轴：语义轴决定检索内容是否有用，结构轴决定这些内容会不会不成比例地占据模型计算资源。这个区分对做长上下文预训练、合成数据模板设计、跨模态离散 token 接口的人都很有参考价值。不过量级上，这更像一个机制分析与接口设计提醒，而不是会直接改写基座训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者建立了一个 attention decomposition 框架。给定 prompt x=[I;D;K;q]，其中 I 是 instruction，D 是 demonstrations，K 是外部知识，q 是 query。作者把 query token 对知识区 K 的注意力分配写成语义项和结构项的组合，其中结构项由 λ·σ(K) 表示。σ(K) 是 structural intensity，来自三类可观测模式：结构分隔符密度、关系/槽位 token 的出现频率、以及局部重复模式。λ 则被视为模型内生的结构敏感系数，依赖层和头。这个分解的关键不是精确恢复真实注意力生成机制，而是提供一个可检验的工作假设：即使语义内容相同，只要格式更“结构化”，也会获得更高 attention mass。

实验设计围绕“格式-内容解耦”展开。作者构造七种条件，把相同语义内容分别写成自然语言、相关 triples、无关 triples、噪声 triples 等形式，比较它们对 demonstrations 区域 attention 的压缩效应。论文还提出一个 compression bound，用来说明在总 attention 归一化约束下，K 区域结构强度升高会怎样压缩 D 区域的可用注意力。

缓解方法部分给了五类策略，核心思路都是削弱 λ·σ(K)。其中真正做了实验的主要有两类。S3 format flattening：把 triples 改写成更接近自然语言或弱结构化文本，降低 delimiter 和 slot pattern 的显著性。S1 structural dispersal：把高度规则的结构打散，减少局部重复和模板集中度。另有 logit suppression、训练期正则等方案主要停留在理论或算法草图层面。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两个开源模型家族：Mistral-7B 和 LLaMA-3-8B；任务是三类 QA。最核心的结果有四点。

第一，KG triples 的 attention capture 明显高于中性自然语言。文中给出的代表性数字是，KG 区域的归一化结构强度估计约为 0.70，而 neutral text 约为 0.25；对应地，triples 每 token 吸收的注意力大约是自然语言的 2 到 3 倍。

第二，这种 attention capture 与语义是否相关关系不大。相关 triples、无关 triples、甚至噪声 triples 的 attention pattern 接近，说明模型先被格式吸引，再谈内容是否有用。这是全文最关键的证据，因为它支撑了“结构税独立于语义价值”的主张。

第三，demonstration attention 会被明显压缩，文中报告最高可达 42%。这说明问题不只是局部 token 被多看几眼，而是 prompt 内部的竞争格局被改写，进而影响 ICL 行为。

第四，在 source selection 上，任务匹配的 BM25 retrieval 相比不匹配的 ConceptNet retrieval，在 HotpotQA 上有超过 30 个百分点的优势，而更复杂的 gating 带来的收益不超过 2 个百分点。作者据此强调，先选对知识源，再谈精细 gating；语义对齐的重要性远大于在错误知识源上做复杂控制。

缓解实验里，S3 format flattening 得到较稳定支持：既改善准确率，也在 attention-level 分析中降低了结构区的吸附效应。S1 structural dispersal 结果较混合，存在模型依赖，说明“打散结构”未必总能转化为更好的任务表现，可能因为它同时损伤了可解析性或局部可读性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先抓三处。

第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里把问题讲得最清楚：attention budget 是固定的，结构化片段会竞争性地挤压 demonstrations。只要接受这个设定，后面的实验就容易理解。

第二，看 Section 3 的分解公式和 Proposition 1。这里不必过度纠结形式化是否严格到可作为理论定理使用，重点是理解作者如何把“结构强度”定义成可测量量，以及为什么它能导出 compression 预测。

第三，看 Section 5 的七条件实验和 attention 可视化。阅读时要特别留意“相关 triples 与噪声 triples attention 类似”这一证据，因为它决定这篇工作的说服力。再看 Section 5.3 的 source-alignment 结果，理解作者为何把 source quality 放在 gating 之前。

如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够把主张、证据和局限读明白。Appendix 里关于 S3 的补充实验值得扫一眼；S1 可以略读。阅读时也要保留一点怀疑：attention 是否能稳定代表功能性依赖、σ(K) 的定义是否对不同 tokenizer 和不同模型稳健、以及 retrieval unit 不一致会不会放大 source-selection 结论，这些都是论文自己也承认的边界。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about what to retrieve, but about how retrieved content is formatted inside the prompt. The core question is whether structured knowledge snippets, especially KG triples, can attract attention simply because of delimiters, slot regularity, and repeated relational patterns, even when their semantic value is unchanged. The authors call this effect the structural attention tax: a format-driven over-allocation of attention to structurally salient regions, which reduces the attention available to demonstrations and other task-critical context.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is mostly conceptual and mechanistic. First, it argues that context competition in transformers is shaped not only by semantics but also by token-level structural priors. That matters for prompt interfaces, RAG design, synthetic data templating, and any training setup that mixes heterogeneous formats. Second, it separates two axes that are often conflated: semantic usefulness of retrieved content versus structural propensity to capture attention. The former determines whether the extra context helps; the latter determines how much compute budget it consumes inside the prompt. This is a useful lens for long-context training, retrieval formatting, and multimodal token interface design, though it is more of an analysis paper than a direct pretraining recipe change.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution is an attention decomposition framework for augmented in-context learning. The prompt is written as x=[I;D;K;q], where I is instruction, D demonstrations, K injected knowledge, and q the query. Attention from query tokens to K is decomposed into a semantic component and a structural component. The structural term is written as λ·σ(K), where σ(K) measures structural intensity and λ is a model-intrinsic sensitivity coefficient that can vary by layer and head.

σ(K) is defined from observable prompt statistics: density of structural delimiters, frequency of relation/slot markers, and repetitiveness of local token patterns. The point is not to claim an exact generative theory of attention, but to provide a testable abstraction: even when semantic content is held fixed, more structured formatting should capture more attention.

The empirical design is built around format-content decoupling. The authors compare semantically equivalent content rendered in different forms, including natural-language passages, relevant triples, irrelevant triples, and noise triples. They also derive a compression-style bound showing that, under normalized attention, increased structural intensity in K must reduce the attention available to D.

The mitigation section proposes five structure-aware strategies, all aimed at reducing λ·σ(K). Two are tested empirically. S3, format flattening, rewrites triples into weaker or more natural language-like forms to reduce delimiter and slot salience. S1, structural dispersal, breaks up highly regular local patterns to reduce repetitive structural cues. Other ideas, such as logit suppression and training-time regularization, are presented more as mathematically motivated directions than fully validated methods.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use two model families, Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3-8B, across three QA tasks. Four results matter most.

First, KG triples capture substantially more attention than neutral natural-language text. The paper reports representative structural intensity estimates around 0.70 for KG-formatted content versus about 0.25 for neutral text, and triples absorb roughly 2x to 3x more attention per token.

Second, this attention capture is largely insensitive to semantic relevance. Relevant triples, irrelevant triples, and even noise triples show very similar attention patterns. That is the central empirical support for the paper’s claim: the tax is driven by format before usefulness is even considered.

Third, demonstration attention is compressed by as much as 42% in some settings. So the effect is not a small local preference; it changes the competitive allocation of context budget inside the prompt and can alter ICL behavior.

Fourth, source alignment dominates gating sophistication. On HotpotQA, task-matched BM25 retrieval outperforms mismatched ConceptNet retrieval by more than 30 percentage points, while more elaborate gating contributes no more than about 2 points. The intended message is that choosing the right knowledge source matters far more than adding control logic on top of a poorly matched source.

For mitigation, S3 format flattening is the strongest result: it improves accuracy and reduces attention concentration on structured regions. S1 structural dispersal is mixed and model-dependent, suggesting that reducing structural regularity does not automatically translate into better task performance, possibly because it also harms readability or local parseability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts.

Start with the introduction and Figure 1. They state the main claim clearly: prompt regions compete for a fixed attention budget, and structured snippets can crowd out demonstrations.

Then read Section 3 and the proposition around the compression argument. The exact formalism is less important than understanding how the authors operationalize structural intensity and why it predicts attention diversion.

Finally, read the seven-condition experiments in Section 5, especially the comparison between relevant triples and noise triples. If those two attract similar attention, the format-driven claim becomes much more convincing. Section 5.3 is also worth reading because it reframes the practical takeaway: source quality matters more than sophisticated gating.

A 30 to 40 minute pass is enough to extract the main idea, evidence, and limitations. The appendix for S3 is worth a quick look. Keep some skepticism while reading: attention is not always a faithful proxy for functional dependence, the σ(K) definition may be tokenizer- and model-sensitive, and the source-alignment result is partly confounded by retrieval-unit differences, which the paper itself acknowledges.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新方法，但它在提醒一个常被忽略的 confound：你以为在测检索质量，实际在测格式诱导的注意力税；先看公式分解和那组 0.70 vs 0.25 的结果。
recommendation.en: Not a new method, but it isolates a confound people often miss: you think you are measuring retrieval quality, but you may be measuring format-induced attention tax; read the decomposition and the 0.70 vs 0.25 result first.

paper.title: Substrate Asymmetry in User-Side Memory: A Diagnostic Framework
paper.abstract: User-side memory in LLMs is typically scored as a single "personalization" capability: given a user's history, is the output more user-aware? We show this aggregate metric hides opposite-direction failures. Memory factorises into at least three orthogonal axes -- behavioral consistency (style, voice), factual presence (recall facts in history), and factual absence (abstain when a fact is absent) -- and no single substrate wins all three. Comparing per-user gamma-LoRA (a small LoRA adapter traine

summary.core_problem: 用户侧 memory 常被当作单一“个性化能力”来评估，但这种聚合指标会掩盖不同记忆机制在风格一致性、事实记住与事实缺失抑制上的相反取舍。
summary.importance: 这是一个带因果探针的机制分析工作。它把 user memory 分解成可分离维度，并比较参数化记忆与检索记忆的能力边界，对理解 RAG、LoRA、长期记忆接口的行为很有参考价值，尤其适合 post-train 与 memory system 设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出三轴诊断框架：behavioral consistency、factual presence、factual absence。然后在受控 50-user synthetic corpus 和 LaMP-3 上，对比 per-user gamma-LoRA 与 BGE-large top-K dense retrieval。进一步做层级与注意力投影的因果干预，定位 attention 21-35 层 query-projection 单元在两类能力上的相反作用，并通过零化 LoRA 权重验证这种 load-bearing 关系。
summary.experiments: 结果显示 gamma-LoRA 明显优于 RAG 的风格一致性，而 RAG 明显优于 gamma-LoRA 的 factual absence；在 attention 21-35 的 query-projection 上做干预后，absence-probe TPR 可提升 33 个百分点，同时 presence-probe TPR 下降 20 个百分点。摘要未给出底座模型规模，但实验设置相对干净，强调机制分解而非单一总分。
summary.authors_note: 独立研究者 Youwang Deng，EpistemicaLab。

summary_en.core_problem: User-side memory is often evaluated as a single personalization capability, but that aggregate metric hides opposing trade-offs across style consistency, factual recall, and abstention on absent facts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-oriented diagnostic paper with causal probing. It decomposes user memory into separable axes and compares parametric memory against retrieval memory, which is useful for understanding RAG, LoRA, and long-term memory interfaces in post-training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a three-axis diagnostic framework: behavioral consistency, factual presence, and factual absence. It compares per-user gamma-LoRA against BGE-large top-K dense retrieval on a controlled 50-user synthetic corpus and LaMP-3, then performs causal interventions to identify attention-layer query projections (layers 21-35) that load-bear both effects in opposite directions.
summary_en.experiments: Gamma-LoRA strongly outperforms RAG on behavioral style, while RAG strongly outperforms gamma-LoRA on factual absence. Zeroing LoRA weights in query-projection cells from attention layers 21-35 raises absence-probe TPR by 33 points and lowers presence-probe TPR by 20 points. The abstract does not state the base model size, but the setup appears cleaner than typical aggregate personalization evaluations.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent research by Youwang Deng at EpistemicaLab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“记住用户”拆成互相冲突的三个可测维度；若你在做 RAG/adapter memory，先看那组 attention 21-35 的因果干预结果。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it decomposes 'remembering the user' into three conflicting measurable axes; if you work on RAG or adapter memory, start with the causal intervention on attention layers 21-35.

paper.title: From Context-Aware to Conflict-Aware: Generalizing Contrastive Decoding for Knowledge Conflict in LLMs
paper.abstract: When large language models generate from retrieved or augmented contexts, conflicts between external context and parametric priors remain a central reliability bottleneck. Existing contrastive decoding methods follow a \emph{context-aware} paradigm that unilaterally amplifies context over parametric priors, overwriting correct priors when the context is erroneous. We generalize this to the \textbf{conflict-aware} paradigm that dynamically allocates authority between prior and context based on co

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是 RAG 或带外部上下文生成时，模型参数知识和上下文证据发生冲突，现有 contrastive decoding 往往默认上下文更可信，容易在上下文错误时覆盖模型原本正确的知识。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对理解 parametric memory、retrieval context 和解码策略之间的接口有启发。它提醒一个常被简化的问题：外部上下文不是天然更可靠，解码时需要同时处理“用上下文纠正模型”和“抵抗错误上下文”两种状态。对基座研究的间接价值在于，它把知识冲突拆成 correction、resistance、agreement 三类，并用模型自身分布来定义评测状态；这有助于分析预训练知识、RAG 数据质量和后训练偏好之间的关系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从无上下文分布 p_pri 和有上下文分布 p_ctx 出发，在 logit 空间做单标量仿射组合，得到 power-family 分布 q_tau(y) ∝ p_pri(y)^(1−tau) p_ctx(y)^tau。tau 在 0 到 1 之间是 interpolation，表示在先验和上下文之间有界地分配权重；tau 大于 1 是 extrapolation，会进一步放大上下文相对先验的增量，并压制先验偏好的 token。论文指出现有 CAD、AdaCAD、COIECD、CoCoA 等方法大多落在偏上下文的 extrapolation 或近似 extrapolation 侧，因此在上下文错误时缺少 resistance 能力。为此提出 TriState-Bench，把样本按模型状态划分为 correction、resistance、agreement；再提出 Adaptive Regime Routing，根据每步 p_pri 和 p_ctx 的冲突信号动态选择 interpolation 或 extrapolation，而不是使用固定的 contrastive 强度。
summary.experiments: 实验在四类模型家族上评估。主要结果是 ARR 在不牺牲 correction 和 agreement 表现的情况下，把 resistance EM 从低于 6 提升到 16–33。这个数字说明问题不是单纯调大或调小上下文权重能解决的：调大权重有利于上下文正确时的纠错，但会放大错误上下文；调小权重能保护先验，但会削弱真实证据。ARR 的收益来自按冲突状态切换 regime。实验还通过 TriState-Bench 分别报告三类状态，避免只看总体准确率时掩盖 resistance 退化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 generalized framework 中 power-family 的推导和 tau regime 的解释，这是方法的核心。然后看 TriState-Bench 的状态划分规则，确认 correction、resistance、agreement 是否依赖模型自身答案。最后看 ARR 的路由信号和主结果表，重点比较 CAD/AdaCAD/COIECD/CoCoA 在 resistance 状态下的失败模式。与预训练直接相关的内容不多，没必要细读所有数据集细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies knowledge conflict during context-augmented generation: the retrieved or provided context may disagree with the model’s parametric prior, and existing contrastive decoding methods often assume that the context should dominate even when it is wrong.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-time decoding and evaluation paper, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research is in the interface between parametric memory and external evidence. The useful idea is to separate conflicts into correction, resistance, and agreement states. A model should follow context when the prior is wrong, preserve the prior when the context is wrong, and avoid unnecessary perturbation when both agree. That framing is helpful for analyzing retrieval quality, pretraining knowledge retention, and post-training behavior under noisy evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts from two distributions from the same model: p_pri without context and p_ctx with context. A scalar affine combination in logit space yields a power-family distribution q_tau(y) proportional to p_pri(y)^(1-tau) p_ctx(y)^tau. When tau is between 0 and 1, the distribution interpolates between prior and context under bounded trust reallocation. When tau is greater than 1, it extrapolates beyond the context signal and suppresses tokens favored by the prior. The work argues that many prior contrastive decoders are biased toward the context-amplifying regime, which explains their poor behavior when the context is false. It introduces TriState-Bench to evaluate correction, resistance, and agreement separately, and Adaptive Regime Routing to choose between regimes at each decoding step using conflict signals derived from p_pri and p_ctx.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across four model families show the main effect in the resistance state. ARR raises resistance exact match from below 6 to the 16–33 range while maintaining correction and agreement performance. This supports the central diagnosis: a static context-aware contrastive strength cannot handle both directions of conflict. Increasing context authority helps when the context is correct but damages cases where the prior is correct; reducing it protects the prior but underuses valid evidence. Reporting the three states separately is important because aggregate accuracy can hide this tradeoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, roughly 20–30 minutes. Read the power-family formulation and the discussion of interpolation versus extrapolation first. Then check how TriState-Bench assigns correction, resistance, and agreement states, since the evaluation protocol is a major part of the contribution. Finally inspect the ARR routing rule and the main tables comparing CAD, AdaCAD, COIECD, and CoCoA. The detailed dataset descriptions are less important for pretraining-oriented readers unless they are studying knowledge-conflict evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 读形式化部分就够；它把“永远信检索”这个 RAG 默认项拆掉，适合纳入内部解码 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the formal section; it breaks the usual “always trust retrieval” default and is worth adding to internal decoding ablations.

paper.title: Decoupling Thought from Speech: Knowledge-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Resilient Multi-Agent Argumentation
paper.abstract: Multi-agent debate frameworks have been shown to improve large language model performance in convergent tasks, but they are currently optimized in a way that heavily favors final output accuracy rather than stability of the process. During long-horizon exchanges reactive systems under sustained perturbations often experience logic degradation, argument repetition, and role drift. To structurally prevent the identity loss and maintain the process fidelity, we introduce Knowledge-Grounded Counterf

summary.core_problem: 多智能体辩论在长程交互和外部扰动下容易出现逻辑退化、重复论证和角色漂移，现有优化又过度关注最终答案准确率。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个偏系统架构的 agent 稳定性方案，关注过程保真度而不只是结果分数；对多 agent debate 的可靠性有一定参考，但距离通用 LLM 训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 KG-CFR，将私有的检索增强规划缓冲区与公开执行层严格解耦；私有层负责知识 grounded 的 counterfactual reasoning 和策略规划，公开层只承担面向对手和裁判的论证执行，以降低身份漂移和反应式退化。
summary.experiments: 在作者构造的 Dynamic Resource Allocation under Uncertainty 1v1v1 环境中评估，包含 270 条完全因子化的危机模拟轨迹和随机环境冲击；摘要称 KG-CFR 能减少由 judge 检测到的关键过程失败，但未给出完整数值和外部 benchmark 结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Warsaw University of Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon multi-agent debates degrade under perturbations through logic drift, argument repetition, and role instability, while current setups optimize mostly for final answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-system design for process stability rather than a core LLM training method. It is useful as a weak signal for debate reliability, but not central to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: KG-CFR separates a private retrieval-augmented planning buffer from a public execution layer. The private layer performs knowledge-grounded counterfactual planning, while the public layer only emits debate-facing arguments, aiming to reduce reactive role drift.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on a custom Dynamic Resource Allocation under Uncertainty 1v1v1 environment with 270 fully factorial crisis-simulation trajectories and stochastic shocks. The abstract reports fewer judge-detected critical process failures, but does not expose full numbers or external benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Warsaw University of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验设定即可；custom crisis env 太窄，作为 debate 稳定性设计的弱信号，不值得深读。
recommendation.en: Skim only the architecture and setup; the custom crisis environment is too narrow, so treat it as a weak signal on debate stability.

institutions: Institute of Computer Science, Warsaw University of Technology, Warsaw

paper.title: SIFT: Selective-Index For Fast Compute of RAG Prefill by Exploiting Attention Invariance
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) injects LLM queries with relevant documents to improve response quality. This injection increases prompt length and slows time to first token (TTFT). Unlike standard queries, RAG queries have a unique property of context reuse where the same documents recur across user queries. Thus, fully recomputing documents for every RAG query does redundant compute and increases TTFT. Prior works precompute KV tensors of RAG documents offline and coarsely recompute some

summary.core_problem: RAG 将文档注入 prompt 导致 prefill 阶段首 token 延迟(TTFT)显著增加，离线缓存 KV 在现代 GPU 上因磁盘传输延迟反而慢于重算。
summary.importance: 利用 RAG 文档在查询间复用的特性，通过精细粒度的注意力不变性选择索引，实现更快更准的 RAG prefill 加速。
summary.technical_approach: SIFT：离线对每个文档提取高注意力得分的精细粒度位置；利用注意力不变性（某些 token 的注意力贡献可被安全跳过），仅在 online 阶段重新计算必要部分，避免磁盘 KV 读取开销。
summary.experiments: 相比粗粒度 KV 复用与完全重算基线，在 TTFT 和准确率两方面均有提升，尤其在磁盘传输瓶颈场景下优势明显。
summary.authors_note: Georgia Tech (Moinuddin Qureshi 组，知名计算机架构学者)。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG document injection increases prompt length and TTFT; offline KV caching on modern GPUs is often slower than recomputation due to high-latency disk transfers.
summary_en.importance: Exploits context reuse across RAG queries and attention invariance to achieve faster and more accurate RAG prefill acceleration.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIFT extracts fine-grained high-attention-score locations per document offline; uses attention invariance to skip safe-to-ignore tokens, recomputing only necessary parts online to avoid disk KV transfer overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms coarse-grained KV reuse and full recomputation baselines on both TTFT and accuracy, especially under disk-transfer bottlenecks.
summary_en.authors_note: Georgia Tech (Moinuddin Qureshi's group, well-known computer architecture researcher).

recommendation.zh: 对 RAG serving 系统有实际参考价值；核心 insight 是"注意力不变性"，只看 §3-4 的技术细节即可。
recommendation.en: Practical for RAG serving systems; the core insight of "attention invariance" is worth checking—read §3-4 only.

paper.title: TrustMargin: Training-Free Arbitration between Parametric Memory and Retrieved Evidence in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models answer knowledge-intensive questions using both parametric memory and retrieved evidence, but neither source is uniformly reliable. Retrieval can fill knowledge gaps, yet distracting passages may override correct closed-book answers. We study this post-generation conflict as answer-level source arbitration: given Direct and RAG answers from the same frozen model, decide which source to trust. We propose TRUSTMARGIN, a training-free, plug-and-play arbitration layer that scor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：当同一个冻结 LLM 给出 closed-book 直答和 RAG 直答两个候选时，如何在不训练新模型的情况下判断该信参数记忆还是检索证据。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理时仲裁策略，而不是预训练或后训练方法。它对 RAG 系统有工程实用性，也触及一个常见但常被粗糙处理的问题：检索并不总比参数记忆可靠，错误证据会把答案拉偏。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 TRUSTMARGIN，一个 training-free 的 arbitration layer。它用模型自身 likelihood 对两个已有答案打分，结合两类 margin：一是 parametric-prior margin，测试模型记忆是否接受检索答案；二是 evidence-binding margin，抑制仅由段落显著性带来的假支持，转而衡量问题相关的证据绑定强度。最终在 Direct 与 RAG 两个答案间二选一。
summary.experiments: 实验在 2WikiMQA 和 CWQA 上，使用三种 LLaMA 尺度模型，对比 Direct generation、BM25-RAG 等方案。摘要声称 TRUSTMARGIN 持续优于直接回答和基础 RAG，但未给出具体提升幅度，也没有显示是否与更强 reranker/judge 或训练式融合方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical question: given both a closed-book answer and a RAG answer from the same frozen LLM, how can we decide which source to trust without training another model?
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time arbitration method rather than a pretraining or post-training contribution. It is practically useful for RAG systems and tackles a real issue: retrieval is not uniformly better than parametric memory, and distracting evidence can override a correct internal answer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose TRUSTMARGIN, a training-free arbitration layer. It scores the two existing candidates using the model’s own likelihoods and combines two margins: a parametric-prior margin that checks whether memory accepts the retrieved answer, and an evidence-binding margin that discounts passage-only salience and measures question-specific support.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on 2WikiMQA and CWQA with three LLaMA scales, comparing against direct generation and BM25-RAG baselines. The abstract claims consistent gains over both direct answering and basic RAG, but does not provide exact margins or show comparisons against stronger trained fusion or judge-based methods.

recommendation.zh: 更像 RAG 工程补丁，不会改变预训练 prior；若你关心 parametric memory vs retrieval 冲突，只看 margin 设计，别在结果表上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: This is more of a RAG patch than a pretraining insight; if you care about parametric-memory vs retrieval conflict, read the margin design and skip the rest.

paper.title: FIDES: Faithful Inference via Deep Evidence Signals for Retrieval-Memory Conflict in RAG
paper.abstract: When retrieved evidence contradicts parametric memory, language models frequently ignore context and default to memorized priors -- a failure that undermines the core purpose of retrieval augmentation. Contrastive decoding amplifies the context-conditioned output to suppress parametric bias, but existing methods rest on an implicit assumption that this bias is uniform across tokens. A single global contrastive weight over-penalizes safe tokens while leaving genuinely conflicted ones insufficient

summary.core_problem: RAG系统中检索证据与模型参数化记忆冲突时，模型常忽略上下文而偏好记忆中的先验；现有对比解码方法假设token间偏差一致，导致全局权重过度惩罚安全token且对冲突token修正不足。
summary.importance: 方法创新：识别并量化了token级冲突集中现象——检索-记忆张力异质集中于少数答案关键步骤；提出了一种训练无关的解码器利用三种内部信号检测冲突。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FIDES（Faithful Inference via Deep Evidence Signals），在三个互补深度层面探测检索-记忆冲突：输出表面、隐藏表示、注意力模式；基于token级冲突信号自适应分配对比解码权重。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要被截断，未给出完整实验数据；方法是训练无关（training-free），无需更新模型参数。
summary.authors_note: 无法从摘要中确认机构；作者含Zhe Yu, Wenpeng Xing, Tiancheng Zhao等，无知名研究者识别。

summary_en.core_problem: When retrieved evidence contradicts parametric memory, LMs frequently ignore context and default to memorized priors; existing contrastive decoding assumes uniform token-level bias, causing global weights to over-penalize safe tokens while under-correcting genuinely conflicted ones.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: identifies token-level conflict concentration—retrieval-memory tension is sharply heterogeneous, concentrated on a small fraction of answer-critical decoding steps; proposes a training-free decoder using three internal signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: FIDES (Faithful Inference via Deep Evidence Signals) probes retrieval-memory conflict at three complementary depths: output surface, hidden representations, and attention patterns; adaptively allocates contrastive decoding weights based on token-level conflict signals.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; method is training-free, no parameter updates required.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not identifiable from abstract; authors include Zhe Yu, Wenpeng Xing, Tiancheng Zhao; no well-known researchers recognized.

recommendation.zh: 对理解RAG的记忆-上下文冲突机制有启发，token级冲突集中现象值得知道，但属于推理层工程，不直接改进预训练。
recommendation.en: Interesting mechanism for understanding memory-context tension in RAG; token-level conflict concentration is worth knowing but this is inference-layer engineering, not directly useful for pretraining.

paper.title: Beyond Vector Similarity: A Structural Analysis of Graph-Augmented Retrieval for Industrial Knowledge Graphs
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fails systematically on queries requiring structural reasoning over interconnected entities. We compare eight retrieval architectures for aerospace supply chain intelligence, progressing from text retrieval through graph traversal to graph computation. Using a 46-node knowledge graph with 64 typed edges, we evaluate 23 queries across 10 intent categories and demonstrate that five query classes are structurally unreachable for vector retrieval. Our central fin

summary.core_problem: RAG系统在需要对互联实体进行结构推理的查询上系统性失效，文本向量检索无法处理五类需要图结构推理的查询。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出operator vocabulary thesis，认为LLM图推理的瓶颈不是模型智能而是可用的计算算子工具；在航空供应链知识图谱场景下验证了图遍历原语+图计算工具的分层架构。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了包含9种类型化遍历原语的LLM查询规划器，以及额外6种图计算工具的分层架构；LLM可根据查询类别选择性调用不同工具层级。
summary.experiments: 在46节点、64条类型化边的航空供应链知识图谱上评测23条查询（10类意图）；LLM查询规划器F1=0.632对比定制handler的0.472；实体级F1系统性低估图推理性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息有限，为单作者Grama Chethan，无法确认机构背景。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG systems fail systematically on queries requiring structural reasoning over interconnected entities; vector retrieval is structurally unreachable for five query classes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution: proposes the operator vocabulary thesis — the barrier to LLM-based graph reasoning is not model intelligence but available computational operators as tools; validates a layered architecture of traversal primitives + graph computation tools on an aerospace supply chain KG.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs an LLM Query Planner with 9 typed traversal primitives, plus an additional 6 graph computation tools forming a layered architecture; the LLM selectively adopts tools for exactly the query categories where traversal fails.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 23 queries across 10 intent categories on a 46-node KG with 64 typed edges; LLM Query Planner achieves F1=0.632 vs. 0.472 for bespoke handlers; identifies that entity-level F1 systematically underscores graph reasoning performance.
summary_en.authors_note: Single-author paper by Grama Chethan; institutional affiliation not confirmed.

recommendation.zh: Operator vocabulary thesis是有价值的框架性观察，但实验在极小KG上进行，对LLM基座研究启示有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The operator vocabulary thesis is a useful framing, but experiments are on a tiny 46-node KG; limited direct insight for LLM base research — read abstract only.

paper.title: Beyond Semantic Organization: Memory as Execution State Management for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks with interdependent decisions, where each action reshapes future constraints and intermediate errors can cascade. Existing RAG and agent memory systems organize histories by semantic similarity, retrieving content-relevant entries at decision time. We argue that this design mismatches execution-state dependencies: it fragments decision trajectories and mixes valid and erroneous traces, hindering coherent state reconstruction and error isola

summary.core_problem: 长程 LLM Agent 的历史记忆如果只按语义相似度检索，容易打散执行轨迹，导致状态重建不完整、错误分支混入当前决策。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆架构改进。它把 memory 从“内容检索库”改成“执行状态管理器”，对长程任务中的回滚、分支、错误隔离有一定方法价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAGE，将交互历史组织成层级状态树。Agent 的当前状态由 active root-to-current path 推导，结合子目标摘要、近期轨迹和历史分支提示。系统包含 Grow、Compress、Maintain、Revise 四类操作，分别负责记录新轨迹、压缩完成子目标、校验摘要、恢复边界并从新分支继续执行。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务集、模型规模、baseline 和数值结果。只能确认论文主张该方法用于长程 Agent 任务，并针对语义检索式 memory 的轨迹碎片化和错误污染问题做实验验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Semantic-similarity memory for long-horizon LLM agents fragments execution trajectories and can mix valid and erroneous traces, making state reconstruction brittle.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory architecture paper. Its useful idea is to treat memory as execution-state management rather than a passive retrieval store, which matters for rollback, branching, and error isolation, though it is not directly about foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes MAGE, which stores interactions in a hierarchical state tree. The active state is reconstructed from the root-to-current path, augmented with subgoal summaries, recent traces, and hints from prior branches. Four operations maintain the tree: Grow, Compress, Maintain, and Revise.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide task suites, model sizes, baselines, or quantitative results. It indicates evaluation on long-horizon agent settings where semantic memory causes trajectory fragmentation and error contamination.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent memory 设计备查即可；核心 prior 是“轨迹结构比语义相似度更重要”，看方法图和消融就够。
recommendation.en: Useful as a reference for agent memory design; the real prior shift is trajectory structure over semantic similarity, so the method diagram and ablations are enough.

paper.title: Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG: A Comparative Study on Structured and Multi-Hop Retrieval
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their responses in external knowledge, but conventional pipelines rely on static, single-step retrieval that limits performance on complex queries. This paper presents an Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG framework that introduces dynamic query decomposition, iterative retrieval, and a bounded self-reflective evaluation loop. We evaluate the system across two complementary datasets: a domain-specific DevOps kno

summary.core_problem: 如何通过 Agent 编排（动态查询分解、迭代检索、自我反思）改进 RAG 系统在复杂查询上的表现？
summary.importance: 对比了 Agentic RAG 在结构化领域和多跳推理基准上的表现差异，揭示了复杂 RAG 机制的适用边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个 Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG 框架，包含动态查询分解、迭代检索和有界的自我反思评估循环。
summary.experiments: 在 DevOps 知识库和 MuSiQue 多跳推理基准上评估。发现查询分解在结构化领域有稳定收益，但在多跳基准上降低了排名精度；反思机制提高了引用准确性，但显著增加了延迟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve RAG system performance on complex queries through Agent orchestration (dynamic query decomposition, iterative retrieval, self-reflection)?
summary_en.importance: Compares the performance differences of Agentic RAG on structured domains and multi-hop reasoning benchmarks, revealing the applicability boundaries of complex RAG mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes an Agent-Orchestrated Adaptive RAG framework featuring dynamic query decomposition, iterative retrieval, and a bounded self-reflective evaluation loop.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a DevOps knowledge base and the MuSiQue multi-hop reasoning benchmark. Found that query decomposition yields consistent gains in the structured domain but degrades ranking precision on the multi-hop benchmark; the reflection mechanism improves citation accuracy at a substantial latency cost.

recommendation.zh: 对比了复杂 RAG 机制在不同数据集上的表现，指出了查询分解在多跳推理上的负面影响，对 RAG 系统设计有参考，但偏应用层。
recommendation.en: Compares complex RAG mechanisms across datasets, noting the negative impact of query decomposition on multi-hop reasoning; useful for RAG design but leans towards the application layer.

paper.title: IA-RAG: Interval-Algebra-Driven Temporal Reasoning for Dynamic Knowledge Retrieval
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has shown strong effectiveness in grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) with external knowledge. However, existing RAG and Graph RAG frameworks largely treat knowledge as static or associate time with coarse-grained timestamps or metadata, failing to capture rich temporal structures such as duration, overlap, and containment. We propose IA-RAG, a hierarchical temporal RAG framework that models knowledge as time intervals and performs retrieval under formal t

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG和Graph RAG框架将知识视为静态或仅关联粗粒度时间戳，无法捕捉持续时间、重叠、包含等丰富时间结构
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出基于Allen区间代数的层级时间RAG框架，是时间推理RAG方向的新尝试
summary.technical_approach: IA-RAG将事实表示为区间事件单元（IEU），组织成层级主题森林，时间依赖由Allen区间代数控制；引入子图时间收紧机制通过连通事件子图内的逻辑约束细化模糊区间；支持通过区间代数驱动的隐式时间语义检索
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验配置和量化结果
summary.authors_note: 华东师范大学、上海AI实验室、上海理工大学、哈尔滨工程大学

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RAG and Graph RAG frameworks treat knowledge as static or with only coarse-grained timestamps, failing to capture rich temporal structures like duration, overlap, and containment
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a hierarchical temporal RAG framework based on Allen's Interval Algebra, a new direction for temporal reasoning in RAG
summary_en.technical_approach: IA-RAG represents facts as Interval Event Units (IEUs) organized into a hierarchical Thematic Forest with temporal dependencies governed by Allen's Interval Algebra; introduces a Sub-graph Time Tightening mechanism to refine fuzzy intervals via logical constraints within connected event subgraphs; supports implicit temporal semantic retrieval via interval-algebra-driven methods
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not provide specific experimental setup or quantitative results
summary_en.authors_note: East China Normal University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Harbin Engineering University

recommendation.zh: 时间RAG的工程化改进，对预训练研究员无直接启发，了解思路即可
recommendation.en: An engineering improvement for temporal RAG; no direct relevance to pretraining; high-level idea is sufficient to know

institutions: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

paper.title: QCFuse: Query-Aware Cache Fusion via Compressed View for Efficient RAG Serving
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves large language model (LLM) answer quality by grounding generation in external evidence, but processing retrieved contexts makes the prefill stage a dominant serving cost. RAG cache fusion reduces this cost by reusing precomputed key-value (KV) caches for retrieved chunks and selectively recomputing tokens under the current prompt. Existing selectors, however, face a dilemma between quality and efficiency: fast query-agnostic or final-layer query-to-c

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG场景下的KV缓存融合方案在选择需要重计算的token时面临质量和效率的两难：查询无关的选择器或仅用最后一层注意力的选择器会丢失关键上下文，全视角的查询感知选择器需要提前加载所有层的KV缓存，打断分层流水线并行，大幅增加延迟。
summary.importance: 优化了RAG服务的预填充阶段效率，对大模型推理部署的成本降低有实际工程价值，也为缓存复用与查询感知的结合提供了新的轻量化思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出QCFuse压缩视角查询感知选择器，从两个维度压缩选择器的计算开销：1）离线阶段为每个RAG语块选择代表性锚点token，在线阶段仅用锚点集合计算查询与语块的相关性，无需遍历全部上下文token；2）离线阶段识别出查询-上下文注意力最能定位相关token的关键层，在线阶段仅扫描这些关键层的注意力信号，无需遍历所有层；整体方案兼容分层缓存融合流水线，不打断并行流程。
summary.experiments: 在多款开源LLM和数据集上测试，相同生成质量下，QCFuse的预填充阶段速度比完全预计算平均快1.7倍，比最强的保质量基线ProphetKV平均快1.5倍。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分了解缓存融合的现有瓶颈，第3章重点看锚点探测和关键层 profiling 的核心设计，实验部分看端到端延迟和质量对比即可，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache fusion schemes for RAG scenarios face a quality-efficiency dilemma when selecting tokens for recomputation: query-agnostic selectors or selectors only using last-layer attention miss critical context, while full-view query-aware selectors require preloading KV caches of all layers, breaking layer-wise pipeline parallelism and significantly increasing latency.
summary_en.importance: QCFuse optimizes prefill stage efficiency for RAG serving, delivering practical engineering value for reducing LLM inference deployment costs, and provides a new lightweight approach for combining cache reuse with query awareness.
summary_en.technical_approach: QCFuse is a compressed-view query-aware selector that reduces computation overhead from two dimensions: 1) Offline stage selects representative anchor tokens for each RAG chunk; during online serving, query-chunk relevance is computed only over anchor sets, eliminating the need to traverse all context tokens. 2) Offline stage identifies critical layers where query-to-context attention best localizes relevant tokens; during online serving, the selector only scans attention signals from these critical layers, avoiding full layer traversal. The entire scheme is compatible with layer-wise cache fusion pipelines and does not interrupt parallel processing.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across multiple open-source LLMs and datasets, at matched generation quality, QCFuse achieves an average 1.7× prefill speedup over full prefill, and 1.5× average speedup over ProphetKV, the strongest quality-preserving baseline.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction to understand existing bottlenecks of cache fusion, focus on the core designs of anchor probing and critical layer profiling in Section 3, and review end-to-end latency and quality comparisons in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 setup 很实；做长上下文 serving 的只看 compressed view selector 和 critical-layer profiling 两个点就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup looks practical; if you care about long-context serving, just read the compressed-view selector and critical-layer profiling pieces.

paper.title: Answer Presence Drives RAG Rewriting Gains
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented QA pipelines often route retrieved passages through an LLM \emph{rewriter} before a smaller reader, lifting F1 by tens of points on multi-hop benchmarks; this gain is typically credited to improved evidence quality. We ask whether that lift is causally driven by the gold answer string appearing in the rewritten context rather than by curation per se, using a controlled intervention audit.
