For each rewritten context we re-run the reader after one of four controlled edits to th

summary.core_problem: RAG 流水线中 LLM rewriter 带来的 F1 提升被广泛归因于证据质量的改善，本文通过控制干预实验检验这一因果归因是否正确。
summary.importance: 机制分析贡献，首次使用干预审计（删除/替换/注入 gold answer 字符串）检验 RAG rewriter 的提升来源，发现 gold answer 的存在是主要驱动因素。
summary.technical_approach: 对改写后的上下文施加四种受控编辑：删除 gold answer span、替换等长随机非 answer span（安慰剂）、在 rewrite 缺失 gold 时注入到前缀或句中边界。在三种 reader 模型族、两个数据集、三种编译器配置下共 12 组干预实验。
summary.experiments: 跨 Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3.5-35B、GLM-4.7 三种 reader，HotpotQA 和 2WikiMultihopQA 两数据集，删除 gold answer 导致 reader F1 下降约 28 点，而安慰剂替换影响很小；注入 gold 到缺失 rewrite 中可恢复大部分 F1。

summary_en.core_problem: The F1 gain from LLM rewriters in RAG pipelines is widely attributed to improved evidence quality; this paper tests that causal attribution via controlled intervention audits.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism-analysis contribution; first to use intervention auditing (remove/replace/inject gold answer string) to disentangle the source of rewriter gains, finding gold-answer presence is the dominant driver.
summary_en.technical_approach: Applies four controlled edits to rewritten contexts: remove gold answer span, replace length-matched random non-answer span (placebo), inject gold at prefix or sentence boundary when absent. 12 intervention runs across 3 reader families, 2 datasets, 3 compiler arrangements.
summary_en.experiments: Across Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3.5-35B, GLM-4.7 readers and HotpotQA / 2WikiMultihopQA, removing gold answer drops reader F1 by ~28 points while placebo has minimal effect; injecting gold into absent rewrites restores most F1.

recommendation.zh: 干预审计方法学值得借鉴（尤其对预训练数据归因研究），但 RAG 域结论与 pretrain 距离较远。
recommendation.en: Intervention-audit methodology is worth borrowing (relevant to pretraining data attribution), but the RAG-domain conclusions are distant from pretrain.

paper.title: ForeSci: Evaluating LLM Agents for Forward-Looking AI Research Judgment
paper.abstract: AI research often requires decisions before future evidence exists: which bottleneck to attack, which direction to pursue, or where a project should be positioned. We introduce ForeSci, a temporally controlled benchmark for evaluating whether LLM agents can make such forward-looking research judgements from historical evidence. ForeSci contains 500 tasks across four fast-moving AI domains and four decision families. Each task is paired with a cutoff-aligned offline knowledge base; post-cutoff pa

summary.core_problem: 这项工作构造 ForeSci，用来评测 LLM agent 是否能在严格历史时间截断下，根据当时已有文献做前瞻性 AI 研究判断，例如选择研究方向、识别瓶颈、规划项目或判断投稿定位。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产型工作，和基座预训练的关系是间接的。它不改进训练目标或模型结构，但对研究型 agent、自动科研系统和长周期决策评测有参考意义。它把“读论文并总结”推进到“在未来证据尚不存在时做决策”，并且用时间截断控制信息泄露。对 LLM 研究员有用的部分在于：当前 agent 可能会检索到相关证据，也能写出看似合理的论证，但仍然选错技术对象、因果角色或干预点。
summary.technical_approach: ForeSci 采用 retrospective forecasting 设计。每个任务都有一个 cutoff date，系统只能访问 cutoff 之前的离线知识库 K≤t，post-cutoff 文献只用于验证。任务来自四个 AI 方向：LLM agents、LLM fine-tuning and post-training、RAG and retrieval structuring、visual generative modeling。任务族包括 Direction Forecasting、Bottleneck–Opportunity Discovery、Strategic Research Planning 和 Venue-Conditioned Positioning。构造流程先从 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 收集候选论文，再做领域相关性筛选、benchmark-core 筛选和时间对齐。评测不是单一打分，而是拆成 factual support、future-target alignment、evidence traceability 和 reviewer persuasiveness。这样可以区分“证据引用正确”与“研究判断正确”。
summary.experiments: ForeSci 包含 500 个任务，并为每个任务配套 cutoff-aligned offline knowledge base。实验比较 native LLM、Hybrid RAG，以及三种离线适配的 research-agent 系统，覆盖四种 LLM backbone。为降低泄露风险，模型 backbone 选择在对应 cutoff 之前训练的版本，关闭 web search，只允许使用提供的历史知识库。结果显示，agent-style 方法通常能提升证据可追溯性和事实性，但不同任务族的最优方法不同。诊断分析提出 evidence-decision decoupling：模型可以引用相关且真实的 pre-cutoff 证据，但预测错误的未来目标，或错误判断哪个瓶颈会成为关键约束。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。优先看 benchmark construction、temporal control 和 evaluation protocol。实验结果可以重点看不同任务族下 native LLM、RAG 和 agent 的差异，以及 evidence-decision decoupling 的错误案例。若关注 AI scientist 或自动研究规划，值得细读任务定义和评测标注方式；若只关注预训练 recipe，可跳过大部分系统比较。

summary_en.core_problem: ForeSci evaluates whether LLM agents can make forward-looking AI research judgments from evidence available at a historical cutoff, rather than answering questions with hindsight from later papers.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, not a pretraining contribution. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the evaluation of research agents and autonomous scientific decision-making. The benchmark moves beyond literature QA and summarization: the model must choose directions, identify bottlenecks, plan research agendas, or position work for a venue before future evidence exists. A key takeaway is that stronger retrieval and agent workflows can improve evidence traceability while still failing at the actual decision.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForeSci is built as a retrospective forecasting benchmark. Each instance has a cutoff date, a cutoff-aligned offline knowledge base K≤t, and withheld post-cutoff validation targets G>t. Systems must answer using only the historical knowledge base; post-cutoff papers are used only for evaluation. The benchmark covers four AI areas: LLM agents, LLM fine-tuning and post-training, RAG and retrieval structuring, and visual generative modeling. It defines four decision families: direction forecasting, bottleneck-opportunity discovery, strategic research planning, and venue-conditioned positioning. Evaluation uses multiple signals: factual support based on atomic facts, alignment with future targets, evidence traceability, and reviewer-style persuasiveness.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 500 tasks. The evaluation compares native LLMs, Hybrid RAG, and three offline-adapted research-agent systems across four LLM backbones. To reduce leakage, the tested systems use the same historical knowledge bases, web search is disabled, and answer-generation backbones are selected to precede the task cutoffs. The main finding is conditional: agent-style systems often improve factuality and traceability, but the best method depends on the decision family. The diagnostic audit identifies evidence-decision decoupling, where an agent cites relevant pre-cutoff evidence but forecasts the wrong object, assigns the wrong causal role, or selects the wrong intervention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Read the task-family definitions, the temporal-control protocol, and the evaluation metrics first. Then inspect the result breakdown by decision family and the failure cases for evidence-decision decoupling. The benchmark construction is the most relevant part for readers interested in AI scientist evaluation; the system comparison is less central for pretraining researchers.

recommendation.zh: 时间切分做得像样，能当“研究型 agent”评测底座；只需看任务构造与泄露控制，模型结果别过度解读。
recommendation.en: The temporal split is the real value—good as a research-agent eval substrate; read the task construction/leakage control, don’t over-interpret model rankings.

paper.title: Easier to Mislead Than to Correct: Harmful and Beneficial Revision in LLM Conformity

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是多智能体场景里一个很具体、也很容易被低估的问题：当模型先独立作答、再看到“同伴答案”后，它到底更容易被纠错，还是更容易被带偏。作者没有只看“是否发生修订”，而是把修订按方向拆成两类：错误改成正确的 beneficial revision，以及正确改成错误的 harmful revision。核心问题不是一般性的社会从众，而是两种修订方向是否对称，以及共识人数、权威标签、推理提示这些社会线索会怎样改变这种不对称性。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身，它不是直接改训练目标或数据配方的论文，但对后训练、多代理推理和模型校准有直接启发。价值主要有三点。第一，它把“multi-agent 讨论能提升答案质量”这个常见直觉拆开了，指出错误传播可能比错误修复更强，这对任何依赖 self-consistency、debate、agent aggregation 的系统都很关键。第二，它说明模型对社会线索的敏感性并不等于对真值的敏感性：authority label 和 unanimity 都会显著推高跟随行为，但不会区分对错。第三，它给出一个更细的分析框架：不要只看最终准确率或 revision rate，而要分开看 harmful / beneficial revision，这个视角可以直接用于评估 post-train 后的社会顺从性、校准和鲁棒性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上是一个控制变量很强的两轮实验框架。Round 1 先让模型独立回答问题，并给一个 1 到 10 的自报置信度；Round 2 再给它同一道题的六个“模拟同伴回答”，原始问题和模型自己的首轮答案保留在上下文里，要求它重新作答。作者主要操纵三类因素。

第一类是 consensus structure。共有三种：mixed peers，6 个同伴里 3 个给金标准答案，另外 3 个分别给不同错误答案，因此正确答案只有 plurality；all-correct peers，6 个同伴都给正确答案；all-wrong peers，6 个同伴一致给同一个错误答案。这个设计的好处是 mixed 条件提供了共同基线，可以比较 all-correct 相对基线增加了多少 beneficial revision，以及 all-wrong 相对基线增加了多少 harmful revision。

第二类是 authority labels。作者不给同伴增加真实能力差异，只是在名字后面加组织角色标签，如 team leader、research director。这样可以把“权威线索”从“答案质量”里剥离出来，单独测它对修订方向的影响。RQ1 里先做有无 authority 的二元比较，RQ2 再逐步增加带 authority 的人数，观察剂量效应。

第三类是 reasoning interventions。作者测试了两种常见干预：Chain-of-Thought，以及 reflect-then-revise。前者希望模型在二次决策时显式推理，后者希望模型先反思自己和同伴答案，再决定是否修改。这里的关注点不是绝对准确率，而是这些提示能否“选择性地减少 harmful revision，同时保留 beneficial revision”。

从研究设计看，这篇文章的关键不是提出新算法，而是把社会影响拆成可测的因果因素，并且把结果按初始正确/错误分层。相比只统计最终是否跟随多数，这种设计更接近系统部署时真正关心的风险：模型原本答对了，却因为群体线索改错。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4 个开源模型和 7 个 QA / reasoning 数据集。全文给出的主结论很稳定：

1. 一致性共识会显著推动修订，但方向不对称。all-wrong peers 对 harmful revision 的提升，明显强于 all-correct peers 对 beneficial revision 的提升。也就是标题里的结论：误导模型比纠正模型更容易。作者强调，这不是简单因为模型“更愿意改答案”，而是错误共识对已正确答案的破坏力更强。

2. authority label 有独立效应。随着带权威标签的同伴数量增加，模型更倾向选择被权威背书的答案，不管这个答案是对还是错。也就是说，authority 提升的是服从性，不是辨别力。

3. prompt 级干预效果有限。CoT 在 all-wrong peers 条件下能降低一部分 harmful revision，但不能稳定地在各种条件下同时保住 beneficial revision。reflect-then-revise 更像是提高了“改答案门槛”，让模型整体更不愿意修订，因此 harmful revision 和 beneficial revision 都一起下降，缺少选择性。

4. 研究问题 RQ2 的剂量效应也支持同样结论：无论是增加同一答案的支持人数，还是增加 authority 人数，模型的跟随概率都会上升。这说明社会线索的强度与修订行为大体单调相关。

从预训练研究者角度，更值得注意的是作者没有把结果包装成“多代理无效”，而是指出风险来自 revision asymmetry。若一个系统只看最终投票准确率，可能会掩盖“原本正确的样本被群体带偏”的代价。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，全文重点更偏模式稳定性和统计显著性，而不是单一 benchmark 上的绝对提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点放在实验设计和结果拆分方式，不必花太多时间在相关工作。建议阅读顺序：

1. 先看 Introduction 里对 beneficial / harmful revision 的定义，以及三个 RQ。这里已经把问题框架讲清楚了。
2. 再看 Methods 和 Figure 2，理解两轮协议、三种 consensus structure、authority label 的控制方式。这个部分是全文最值得借鉴的地方，因为它提供了一个可复用的评测模板。
3. 结果部分重点看 RQ1 和 RQ2：一是 harmful 与 beneficial 的不对称，二是人数和权威标签的剂量效应。读图时不要只看 final accuracy，要看 revision direction 的分解。
4. RQ3 可以快速看。价值在于说明常见 prompt engineering 不是可靠解法，而不是提出新方法。

预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息。如果要深挖，建议关注作者是否按初始置信度、题型难度、模型规模进一步分层；这些分析会更接近“哪些训练或后训练因素导致从众脆弱性”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode in multi-agent LLM settings: after producing an initial answer, does an LLM benefit more from peer feedback by correcting mistakes, or does it get harmed more by abandoning a correct answer? The key contribution is to separate revisions by direction: wrong-to-correct changes are beneficial revisions, while correct-to-wrong changes are harmful revisions. The central question is whether social influence is symmetric across these two directions, and how consensus, authority cues, and reasoning prompts modulate that asymmetry.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for post-training, multi-agent inference, and evaluation of socially conditioned behavior. Its main value is threefold. First, it challenges the common assumption that agent interaction is automatically corrective; error propagation can be stronger than error repair. Second, it shows that sensitivity to social cues is not sensitivity to truth: unanimity and authority labels increase conformity regardless of correctness. Third, it offers a better evaluation lens for LLM systems: revision rate alone is too crude; harmful and beneficial revisions should be measured separately. That framing is directly useful for studying alignment, calibration, and robustness after instruction tuning or RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The methodology is a tightly controlled two-round protocol. In Round 1, the model answers independently and reports a self-rated confidence score from 1 to 10. In Round 2, it sees six simulated peer responses to the same question, while its original answer remains in context, and is asked to answer again.

The first manipulated factor is consensus structure. There are three settings: mixed peers, where three peers give the gold answer and the other three each give a different wrong answer, so the correct answer has only a plurality; all-correct peers, where all six peers give the gold answer; and all-wrong peers, where all six peers agree on the same incorrect option. This is a strong design choice because the mixed condition serves as a common baseline, making it possible to compare how much all-correct peers increase beneficial revision and how much all-wrong peers increase harmful revision.

The second factor is authority labeling. Some peer names are tagged with organizational roles such as team leader or research director, without changing the actual answer quality. This isolates the effect of authority cues from competence. RQ1 compares authority present vs absent; RQ2 increases the number of authority-labeled peers to test dose-response behavior.

The third factor is reasoning intervention. The paper evaluates Chain-of-Thought and a reflect-then-revise prompt. The point is not whether these prompts improve raw accuracy, but whether they can selectively reduce harmful revision while preserving beneficial revision.

The paper’s main methodological contribution is not a new algorithm but a clean causal decomposition of social influence. Instead of measuring whether the model follows peers in aggregate, it conditions on whether the model was initially right or wrong. That makes the analysis much more relevant to deployment risk: a system that often changes its mind may look adaptive, but if many of those changes are correct-to-wrong, the interaction protocol is unsafe.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers four open-weight LLMs and seven QA/reasoning datasets. The main empirical patterns are consistent across models and tasks.

1. Unanimous peer agreement strongly increases revision, but the effect is asymmetric. All-wrong peers increase harmful revision much more sharply than all-correct peers increase beneficial revision. In other words, misleading a model is easier than correcting it.

2. Authority labels have an independent effect. As more peers carry authority labels, the model becomes more likely to choose the authority-endorsed answer, regardless of whether that answer is correct. Authority increases deference, not discernment.

3. Prompt-based reasoning interventions are limited. CoT reduces some harmful revision under all-wrong peers, but does not reliably preserve beneficial revision across conditions. Reflect-then-revise mainly raises the threshold for changing one’s answer, so both harmful and beneficial revisions tend to drop together rather than being selectively improved.

4. The dose-response analysis in RQ2 reinforces the same picture: increasing the number of agreeing peers or the number of authority-labeled peers monotonically increases conformity.

For a pretraining-oriented reader, the important point is that the paper does not merely say multi-agent interaction fails. It identifies revision asymmetry as the core issue. A system evaluated only by final accuracy or vote aggregation can hide the cost of turning initially correct answers into wrong ones. The paper emphasizes stable behavioral patterns and controlled comparisons more than headline benchmark numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Focus on the experimental framing rather than the literature review. A good reading order is:

1. Read the Introduction for the definitions of beneficial vs harmful revision and the three research questions.
2. Read Methods and Figure 2 carefully. The two-round setup, the three consensus conditions, and the authority manipulation are the most reusable parts of the paper.
3. In the results, prioritize RQ1 and RQ2: the asymmetry between harmful and beneficial revision, and the dose-response effect of peer count and authority count.
4. RQ3 can be read quickly. Its value is mostly negative evidence: generic prompting is not a reliable fix.

About 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main ideas. If reading more deeply, look for stratified analyses by initial confidence, task difficulty, or model family, since those are the most likely entry points for connecting this behavior back to training and post-training choices.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 LLM 容易被带偏但不易被纠正的非对称性，对 RAG 和 alignment 评估有直接启发，建议看其量化这种非对称性的 metric 和实验 setup。
recommendation.en: Reveals the asymmetry that LLMs are easily misled but hard to correct, directly inspiring RAG and alignment evaluation. Recommend checking their metrics for quantifying this asymmetry and the experimental setup.

paper.title: Chunking Methods on Retrieval-Augmented Generation - Effectiveness Evaluation Against Computational Cost and Limitations
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated significant capabilities in enhancing the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). One of the key tasks in RAG systems is the chunking process. Traditionally, fixed-size chunking and semantic chunking have been the standard approaches. However, interest in chunking strategies has been increasing, leading to a growing number of proposed methods that often claim improved performance over these conventional techniques. Many of these approach

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作系统比较 RAG 中不同 chunking 方法的效果、计算成本和适用边界，回答“复杂切块是否真的值得”。
summary.importance: 它不是新 RAG 方法，而是对一个被频繁当作工程细节处理的环节做系统评估。对做 agent/RAG 系统的人有参考价值，但对基座预训练研究的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者汇总并比较固定长度、语义切块等多种 chunking 策略，在不同场景下评估检索增强效果与计算代价，强调 chunking 不是简单预处理，而是影响召回、上下文完整性和系统成本的关键设计点。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型和提升幅度。论文的主要价值应在于横向比较与 failure case，总体更像工程评测与经验总结，而不是会改变 RAG 或 pretrain prior 的方法论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Wrocław University of Science and Technology。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically compares chunking methods in RAG, asking whether more complex chunking strategies are actually worth their cost.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new RAG method but a comparative study of a component often treated as an implementation detail. It is useful for RAG/agent practitioners, with limited direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate a range of chunking strategies, including fixed-size and semantic chunking, against both effectiveness and computational cost. The framing is that chunking materially affects retrieval quality, context integrity, and system efficiency rather than being a trivial preprocessing step.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete benchmarks, model choices, or effect sizes. The likely value is in the side-by-side comparison and limitations analysis, not in a new method that changes priors about RAG or pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Wrocław University of Science and Technology.

recommendation.zh: 偏 RAG 工程复盘，不是基座研究；如果你在搭 retrieval stack，可只看对比表和成本结论，否则跳过。
recommendation.en: Mostly a RAG engineering comparison, not foundation-model research; read the comparison tables and cost conclusions if you run retrieval stacks, otherwise skip.

institutions: Wrocław University of Science and Technology

paper.title: DiscourseFlip: An Oblique Discourse-Level Opinion Manipulation Attack against Black-box Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are widely deployed and increasingly influential, but their reliance on external corpora exposes new security risks from poisoned retrieval content. Existing RAG attacks are largely focusing on individual queries or narrow topic-local query sets, which limits their practical reach and offers limited camouflage in real-world settings. In this paper, we introduce discourse-level opinion manipulation, a new threat model in which coordinated influence acr

summary.core_problem: 研究黑盒 RAG 系统中，攻击者如何通过有限的语料投毒，在多个相关查询主题上诱导整体观点偏移。
summary.importance: 贡献是提出 discourse-level opinion manipulation 这一 RAG 安全威胁模型，把攻击目标从单个查询扩展到语义查询网络；对通用 RAG 系统安全有参考价值，但不直接影响基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 DiscourseFlip，一个 agentic、图引导的攻击框架。它构建语义查询网络，在黑盒条件下动态分配有限投毒预算，使被检索内容在多主题空间中协同影响生成回答的观点方向。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多个实验中，DiscourseFlip 能在上下文化查询网络中持续诱导目标观点偏移，并显著优于已有基线；摘要未给出模型、数据集、预算规模或具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自武汉大学、华东师范大学、南洋理工大学和 Worcester Polytechnic Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a black-box RAG system can be manipulated through limited corpus poisoning to shift opinions over a broad, semantically connected query space.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a discourse-level opinion manipulation threat model for RAG, extending attacks from isolated queries to a semantic query network. This is relevant to general RAG security, though only indirectly related to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: DiscourseFlip is an agentic, graph-guided attack framework that builds a semantic query network and dynamically allocates a constrained poisoning budget to maximize discourse-level opinion deviation in a black-box setting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive experiments where DiscourseFlip consistently induces targeted opinion shifts across contextualized query networks and outperforms existing baselines, but it does not specify model sizes, datasets, budgets, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Wuhan University, East China Normal University, Nanyang Technological University, and Worcester Polytechnic Institute.

recommendation.zh: 扫 threat model 和投毒预算分配即可；RAG 安全信号有用，但和基座训练的接口较远。
recommendation.en: Skim the threat model and budget-allocation mechanism; useful RAG-security signal, but it sits far from pretraining practice.

paper.title: MosaicLeaks:Privacy Risks in Querying-in-the-Open for Deep Research Agents
paper.abstract: Deep research agents increasingly combine private local documents with external tools like web retrieval, creating a privacy risk: an agent's external queries may leak sensitive information from its local context. This risk is amplified by the mosaic effect, where individual queries may appear harmless but become revealing in aggregate. We introduce MosaicLeaks, a benchmark of 1,001 multi-hop deep research tasks that chain private enterprise documents and a public web corpus, forcing agents to m

summary.core_problem: 评估 deep research agents 在同时访问私有本地文档和公共网页检索时，外部查询是否会泄漏私有信息，尤其是多条看似无害查询组合后的 mosaic effect。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 隐私评测 benchmark。它不是预训练论文，但对 tool-using agent 的安全边界、RAG/检索代理的训练信号设计和隐私约束评估有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MosaicLeaks，包含 1,001 个多跳 deep research 任务，任务链连接私有企业文档和公共 web corpus，迫使 agent 发出依赖本地私有信息的外部查询；用 adversary LLM 只观察外部查询，并推断三类信息：研究意图、私有问题答案、关于企业文档的可验证 claim。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评估了多个模型家族和规模，发现三类泄漏都频繁出现；zero-shot privacy prompting 能降低但不能消除泄漏。摘要未给出具体模型列表、泄漏率或强化学习相关实验的完整细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ServiceNow AI Research、University of Edinburgh、Mila、McGill University 和 University of British Columbia；工作在 ServiceNow AI Research 完成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether deep research agents leak private local information through external web queries, especially when individually benign queries become revealing in aggregate through the mosaic effect.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent privacy benchmark. It is not pretraining work, but it is directly relevant to safety boundaries for tool-using agents, RAG-style agents, and the design of privacy-aware training and evaluation signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: MosaicLeaks contains 1,001 multi-hop deep research tasks linking private enterprise documents with a public web corpus, forcing agents to issue external queries conditioned on local private information. An adversary LLM sees only the external queries and tries to infer the agent’s research intent, answers to private questions, and verifiable claims about the enterprise documents.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations across model families and sizes, finding frequent leakage at all three levels. Zero-shot privacy prompting reduces but does not eliminate leakage. The provided abstract does not include exact model lists, leakage rates, or full details of the reinforcement-learning-related experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with ServiceNow AI Research, the University of Edinburgh, Mila, McGill University, and the University of British Columbia; the work was done at ServiceNow AI Research.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent 隐私评测的干净问题设定；预训练人只需看 threat model 和泄漏指标，别被应用外壳分散注意力。
recommendation.en: This is a clean agent-privacy evaluation setup; read the threat model and leakage metrics, not the application wrapper.

institutions: Work done at ServiceNow AI Research

paper.title: Retriever Portfolios: A Principled Approach to Adaptive RAG
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically rely on a single retriever and a single set of hyperparameters, despite facing highly heterogeneous queries that range from simple factoid questions to complex multi-hop reasoning. We propose a method that automatically selects a small, diverse subset of retrievers (a portfolio) from a large pool of candidates, to cover different regions of the target query distribution. We formalize this setting via an expected best-of-$k$ objective over th

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 系统面对异质查询时，单一 retriever 与固定超参无法兼顾不同检索需求的问题。
summary.importance: 这是通用 RAG/agent 系统方法，不是预训练论文；价值在于把 adaptive retrieval 写成一个有目标函数和近似保证的 portfolio 选择问题，而不是再堆一个启发式 router。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Retriever Portfolios：从大候选池中自动选一个小而多样的 retriever 子集，优化 expected best-of-k 目标；再配合 router 在查询级别选择或组合检索器。论文强调固定 portfolio 相比逐 query 调超参更适合并行检索与并行 LLM 调用，因此在系统层面也有吞吐优势。
summary.experiments: 在多个 QA benchmark 上，对比单检索器、朴素多检索器和 inference-time hyperparameter tuning，portfolio+router 在检索指标和最终回答质量上更好，且在并行执行下可达到相当或更优精度。摘要未给出具体 LLM、数据规模和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the mismatch between heterogeneous RAG queries and the common practice of using a single retriever with fixed hyperparameters.
summary_en.importance: This is a general RAG/agent systems paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value is that it formulates adaptive retrieval as a principled portfolio-selection problem with an explicit objective and approximation guarantees, instead of another heuristic router.
summary_en.technical_approach: Retriever Portfolios selects a small and diverse subset of retrievers from a large candidate pool by optimizing an expected best-of-k objective, then uses a router pipeline at query time. A key systems point is that fixed portfolios allow parallel retrieval and parallel LLM calls, unlike per-query hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple QA benchmarks, the learned portfolio plus router beats single-retriever and naive multi-retriever baselines on retrieval metrics and answer quality, while matching or exceeding inference-time tuning approaches under parallel execution. The abstract does not provide exact model choices or gains.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain，但比常见 RAG 小修小补更干净；看 objective 和并行性论证就够了，别把它误当成能替代更好的 pretraining/continued pretraining。
recommendation.en: Not pretraining, but cleaner than most RAG tweaks; read the objective and the parallelism argument, and do not mistake it for a substitute for better pretraining or continual pretraining.

paper.title: CRITIC-R1: Learning Structured Critics for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves knowledge-intensive question answering by incorporating external evidence. However, existing RAG methods still suffer from hallucinations and subtle reasoning errors. Recent studies introduce external critics to refine RAG outputs, yet they often provide coarse-grained and weakly structured feedback, exhibit over-aggressive intervention, and lead to noisy and unreliable refinement, limiting their effectiveness for correction. To tackle these issues,

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 输出中幻觉、证据错用和细粒度推理错误难以被可靠诊断与修正的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法和 RAG critic 设计。它把 RAG 批评从粗粒度打分或自由文本反馈，改成结构化错误诊断，并用 RL 学习更保守、更可校准的干预策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CRITIC-R1，将批评任务拆成 verdict、错误位置、推理分析、修复生成等诊断维度。训练上设计 Conservative Judgement Alignment 等奖励函数，目标是减少过度干预，并让 critic 在判断、定位和修复之间保持一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量和完整 benchmark 细节。已知实验比较了若干 RAG critic 或 refinement baseline，重点评估结构化反馈质量、修正可靠性和过度干预问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses hallucinations and subtle reasoning errors in RAG outputs that are hard to diagnose and correct reliably.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for RAG critics. It reframes critique from coarse scoring or free-form feedback into structured error diagnosis, trained with RL to make interventions more calibrated.
summary_en.technical_approach: CRITIC-R1 decomposes critique into diagnostic fields such as verdict, error location, reasoning analysis, and fix generation. It introduces reward functions including Conservative Judgement Alignment to discourage over-aggressive edits and align high-level judgments with detailed diagnoses.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training scale, or full benchmark details. The experiments compare against RAG critic and refinement baselines, focusing on feedback structure, correction reliability, and intervention calibration.

recommendation.zh: RAG critic 的结构化 reward 设计可借鉴；预训练视角只看奖励定义和过度干预分析即可。
recommendation.en: The structured reward design for RAG critics is reusable; from a pretraining lens, read only the reward definitions and over-intervention analysis.

paper.title: OmniRetrieval: Unified Retrieval across Heterogeneous Knowledge Sources
paper.abstract: Real-world information needs require access to structurally diverse knowledge sources, from unstructured text and relational tables to knowledge graphs and property graphs. Existing retrievers, however, operate over one source at a time under a fixed query language, leaving the broader landscape of available knowledge fragmented behind incompatible interfaces. A natural attempt at unification would collapse these sources into a shared space, but this erases the structural affordances (such as sc

summary.core_problem: 解决自然语言查询需要同时访问文本、关系表、知识图谱、属性图等异构知识源时，现有检索器接口割裂、查询语言不统一的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/agent 检索系统设计。它的重点不是把所有知识压进单一向量空间，而是保留不同知识源的 schema、ontology 和组合查询能力，用统一调度层连接自然语言请求与源生执行引擎。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OmniRetrieval：输入自然语言查询后，系统识别应访问的知识源，并为不同源生成 source-native queries，再交给各自原生执行引擎处理。方法倾向于 query planning / routing，而不是单一 embedding space 的语义检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在覆盖 13 个数据集的 benchmark 上评估，但提供片段未显示完整结果、模型规模、baseline 列表或提升幅度。可确认评估对象横跨非结构化文本、关系表、知识图谱和属性图等多种知识源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles retrieval over heterogeneous knowledge sources—text, relational tables, knowledge graphs, and property graphs—through a single natural-language interface.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a RAG/agent retrieval framework. Instead of collapsing every source into one vector space, it preserves source-specific affordances such as schemas, ontologies, and compositional operators.
summary_en.technical_approach: OmniRetrieval receives a natural-language query, selects the appropriate knowledge sources, generates source-native queries, and dispatches them to native execution engines. The design is closer to routing and query planning than to universal dense retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions an extensive benchmark spanning 13 datasets, but the provided snippet does not include exact results, model sizes, baselines, or gain numbers. The evaluation appears to cover multiple source types including text, relational tables, knowledge graphs, and property graphs.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文；做 RAG 工具路由的人可看系统边界，统一 embedding 的反例论证更有用。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper; useful mainly for RAG/tool-routing people, especially the argument against forcing all sources into one embedding space.

paper.title: GrepSeek: Training Search Agents for Direct Corpus Interaction
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) search agents have shown strong promise for knowledge-intensive language tasks through multiple rounds of reasoning and information retrieval. Most existing systems access information using a retriever that takes a keyword or natural language query and returns a ranked list of documents using an index of pre-computed document representations. In this work, we explore a complementary perspective in which the search agent treats the corpus itself as the search environmen

summary.core_problem: 如何把“直接对原始语料执行 shell 命令（grep/sed/awk 等）来找证据”的 Direct Corpus Interaction（DCI）从依赖大模型提示工程，变成一个可训练、可部署、行为稳定的小型搜索代理；并解决 RL 直接学工具使用时常见的退化策略（过宽检索、无效循环、上下文爆炸、行为不稳定）。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的价值主要在“工具交互轨迹如何构造与稳定优化”而不是检索本身：它给了一个相对可复用的 recipe——先用答案可见的 Tutor 生成可验证的工具轨迹，再用答案不可见的 Planner 把轨迹因果化，最后用 GRPO 做在线强化微调。这个流程对应了现实里训练 tool-use / agentic retrieval 模型时最难的两点：冷启动数据质量与 RL 稳定性。对纯 pretrain 的直接影响有限，但对 mid-train / post-train 阶段把模型推向“可执行检索”能力有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
核心设计是三段式训练管线，把“可验证性”和“因果可执行性”拆开处理。
1) Tutor 反向构造（answer-aware, backward chaining）：给 Tutor 真实答案，让它从答案出发倒推一串 shell 命令，使得每一步命令的执行结果能逐步定位到支持答案的证据。反向构造的好处是多跳问题更容易保证每一跳都能落到可检索的字符串/实体/片段上，并且每步都能用执行结果做硬验证。
2) Planner 正向因果化（answer-blind, forward rollout）：真实代理在推理时看不到答案，只能基于当前可见历史（先前命令与返回片段）决定下一步。论文用一个 answer-blind Planner 生成“从问题出发”的推理与命令序列，再由 Tutor 将其与已验证的反向链对齐，得到既因果有效、又贴近成功路径的冷启动轨迹（避免把不可见信息泄漏进思维链/命令选择）。
3) GRPO 强化优化：在冷启动策略上做 Group Relative Policy Optimization，通过与语料环境交互进一步改进搜索行为。论文强调直接 RL 容易学到退化策略，因此需要前两步把策略初始化到“会用工具且不乱用”的区域，再用 GRPO 做增量改进。
整体上，它把 DCI 从“推理时靠大模型写命令”转成“训练一个紧凑模型学会写命令”，并把检索粒度从固定 chunk/文档级索引，变成任意粒度的文本片段过滤与组合（surgical retrieval）。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段没有覆盖实验章节细节与完整数字。已知信息包括：论文目标是训练 compact agent，并强调推理时延与效率；并指出以往 DCI 依赖闭源大模型（如 Claude）推理成本高、单 query 可能耗时很久。方法侧的关键对比应包括：
- 仅提示工程的大模型 DCI vs 训练后的小模型 GrepSeek（效率/成本/成功率）。
- 仅冷启动 SFT vs 冷启动 + GRPO（RL 带来的增益与稳定性）。
- 去掉 backward Tutor 或去掉 forward Planner 对齐（验证“反向可验证”与“正向因果”各自的贡献）。
但这些需要实验部分原文数字才能精确复述。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 重点看 Introduction 里对 DCI 的动机：为什么要绕开预计算索引、为什么“任意粒度检索”对多跳/精确匹配更友好。
- 精看方法部分关于 Tutor backward chain 与 Planner forward trajectory 的生成与对齐：这是全文最可迁移的训练数据构造技巧，直接对应 tool-use 训练里“可验证轨迹”和“因果轨迹”难以兼得的问题。
- 如果你关心训练稳定性，优先找 RL/GRPO 的 reward 设计、失败模式（过宽 grep、无效循环、上下文爆炸）以及他们如何约束命令空间/上下文预算。
- 最后再看效率相关实现：命令执行延迟、并行化、以及如何把返回片段裁剪成可控上下文（这决定了 DCI 是否能规模化）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI)—searching raw text corpora via executable shell commands—into a trainable, deployable, and behaviorally stable small search agent, instead of an expensive prompt-orchestrated workflow on large proprietary models; and how to avoid typical RL degeneracies in tool-use (over-broad commands, looping, context explosion, unstable trajectories).
summary_en.importance: The main value to foundation-model researchers is not a new retriever, but a practical training recipe for tool-interaction policies: (i) build verifiable cold-start trajectories with an answer-aware tutor, (ii) convert them into causally valid forward rollouts with an answer-blind planner, then (iii) refine with GRPO. This directly targets two recurring bottlenecks in agent/tool training: high-quality bootstrapping data and RL stability. It is more relevant to mid-train/post-train than to pure pretraining, but the trajectory construction pattern is broadly reusable.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A three-stage pipeline that separates “verifiability” from “causal executability”.
1) Answer-aware Tutor, backward chaining: given the ground-truth answer, the Tutor constructs a backward chain of shell commands whose executions retrieve supporting evidence step by step. Backward construction makes multi-hop questions easier because each hop can be anchored to executable string/entity matches and hard-verified by command outputs.
2) Answer-blind Planner, forward causalization: at inference time the agent cannot see the answer; it must act based only on observable history (previous commands and returned snippets). The Planner generates forward reasoning traces and commands from the observable state, and the Tutor aligns them to the verified backward chain, producing trajectories that are both causally grounded and guided toward a known-good search path.
3) GRPO refinement: starting from the cold-start policy, the agent is further improved via Group Relative Policy Optimization through direct interaction with the corpus. The paper’s motivation is that naïve RL tends to collapse into degenerate behaviors, so strong initialization is required before online optimization.
Overall, it reframes retrieval as explicit, controllable corpus operations (surgical retrieval at arbitrary granularity) and makes that capability learnable in a compact model.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental section, so exact metrics and ablations cannot be quoted reliably here. From the introduction, the intended empirical story is: (a) prompt-based DCI with large closed models is slow/expensive (sometimes extremely long per query), while GrepSeek targets practical efficiency with a compact agent; (b) cold-start trajectories are necessary for stable RL; (c) ablations should isolate the contributions of backward tutoring, forward causalization, and GRPO. Precise numbers require the missing sections.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the motivation for bypassing precomputed indices and enabling arbitrary-granularity evidence retrieval; this clarifies when DCI is preferable to standard retrievers.
- Focus on the Tutor backward-chain construction and the Planner-based forward causalization/alignment; this is the most transferable idea for training tool-use agents.
- If you care about optimization dynamics, locate the GRPO setup: reward definition, constraints on command space, and documented failure modes (over-broad grep, loops, context blow-up).
- Finally, check the engineering details around execution latency and snippet budgeting, which determine whether DCI can scale.

recommendation.zh: 读训练管线部分就够了；把检索轨迹变成可验证监督，比又调一个 retriever 更有方法味。
recommendation.en: Read the training pipeline; turning search trajectories into verifiable supervision is more interesting than another retriever variant.

paper.title: SERC: LDPC-Inspired Semantic Error Correction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their reliability is significantly compromised by hallucinations. Existing intrinsic self-correction methods attempt to address this, but often fail due to self-bias, where models struggle to identify errors in their own outputs without external verification. To overcome these limitations, we propose the LDPC-inspired semantic error correction for retrieval-augmented generation (SERC), providing a theoretical framework

summary.core_problem: RAG 场景下模型自纠错易受 self-bias 影响，难以在不引入高成本验证的情况下稳定降低幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是“把纠错形式化为编码/信道模型 + 稀疏验证策略”的方法类工作；对如何设计外部验证信号、降低验证成本有启发，但更偏 RAG 系统而非预训练。
summary.technical_approach: SERC 将生成视为语义噪声信道、答案为噪声污染的 codeword；借鉴 LDPC 的稀疏校验思想，生成低密度的验证查询（只抽查少量关键事实），用外部证据检索验证并据此纠错，避免全量 fact-check 的成本。
summary.experiments: 在 LongForm Bio、TruthfulQA 等上评估幻觉/事实性改进；摘要未给出检索开销、验证查询数量与增益的定量权衡曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: In RAG, intrinsic self-correction is limited by self-bias, making it hard to reliably reduce hallucinations without expensive verification.
summary_en.importance: A method that formalizes correction as a coding/noisy-channel problem and proposes sparse verification; useful for designing external verification signals, though more RAG-system than pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SERC models generation as a semantic noisy channel with answers as corrupted codewords; inspired by LDPC, it issues low-density verification queries to check only a sparse subset of claims against external evidence, then corrects accordingly.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongForm Bio and TruthfulQA for factuality/hallucination reduction; the abstract omits cost curves (queries, retrieval budget) vs gains.

recommendation.zh: 想看的是“稀疏验证=更低成本 fact-check”是否真成立：只读验证查询构造与成本-收益曲线；没曲线就当概念性工作。
recommendation.en: The key is whether sparse verification truly buys cheaper fact-checking: read query construction and cost–gain curves; without them, treat it as conceptual.

paper.title: Grounded Cache Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: When Is It Safe to Reuse an Answer?
paper.abstract: Modern retrieval-augmented generation(RAG) deployments increasingly rely on caching to reduce token cost and time-to-first-token(TTFT). Prefix-level KV reuse is now standard in serving stacks such as vLLM, and chunk-level and position-independent reuse have been pushed further by recent systems(RAGCache, TurboRAG, CacheBlend, EPIC, ContextPilot, PCR, LMCache). Output-level semantic answer caches, by contrast, remain fragile: similar prompts can map to different correct answers, retrieved evidenc

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：RAG 系统能否安全复用已经生成过的答案，而不是只追求更高的缓存命中率。KV cache 和检索结果缓存通常有较清楚的正确性边界，但输出级语义缓存不同。两个查询语义相近，并不保证答案仍由同一批证据支持；语料更新、数字事实漂移、近似问题碰撞都会让缓存答案变成错误答案。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 LLM serving 和 RAG 系统的可靠性有明确参考价值。它把 answer cache 从“相似就复用”的工程优化，改成“证据一致才复用”的路由决策。对基座研究员的启发主要在两点：第一，长上下文和 RAG 场景里的计算复用需要显式安全条件，不能只看 embedding 相似度；第二，评估缓存系统时要把错误复用单独量化，否则 token 成本和 TTFT 的收益会掩盖事实错误。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 GroundedCache，是一个证据校验型 cache router。每个缓存项不只保存 query 和 answer，还保存 evidence signature。signature 由归一化 chunk 文本的 SHA-1 哈希和版本号组成。新查询进入后，系统先复用 query embedding 做检索缓存查找；检索得到 chunk 后按文档和 chunk id 排序，使相同证据集形成相同 prompt prefix，便于底层 KV cache 复用。答案复用需要同时通过四个 gate：G1，新查询与缓存查询语义相近；G2，新证据签名与缓存证据签名有足够高的 Jaccard 重合；G3，共享 chunk 的 source version 一致；G4，缓存答案中的内容词能被新证据覆盖，或由轻量 judge 判断答案受证据支持。任一 gate 失败时，不返回缓存答案，而是退回到 query-conditioned compression，再生成答案。这个设计和 vLLM APC、RAGCache、TurboRAG、LMCache 等底层 prefix 或 chunk 级复用不冲突，它更像上层策略层，决定何时允许复用完整答案。
summary.experiments: 实验设计围绕 cache safety，而不是单纯命中率。作者构造了六类压力流量：exact-repeat、paraphrase、near-miss、document-drift、long shared-document、bounded-KB CAG，并提供 HotpotQA adapter。document-drift 场景会对 gold document 中的数字 token 做有种子的突变，使旧答案在新语料下可验证地变错；near-miss 场景用于测试语义相近但 gold documents 不同的问题是否会误命中。指标包括 TTFT、latency、token 数、answer-cache hit rate，以及更关键的 unsafe-served rate、conditional false-hit rate、stale-hit 和 unsupported-hit 分解。可见内容没有给出完整量化结果表，因此不应从中推断具体提升幅度。实验部分的主要价值在于评测协议和错误类型拆分。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对三类缓存的边界划分，再看 Method 里的四个 gate 和 evidence signature 设计。Figure 1、Figure 2 和 Algorithm 1 是核心。实验部分重点看六类 workload 的定义和 USR/FH 等安全指标。对做 LLM serving、RAG cache、长上下文复用的人，值得细看证据签名和版本 gate；对预训练方向，只需把它作为“计算复用需要可验证语义条件”的系统案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when a RAG system can safely reuse a previously generated answer. Semantic similarity between two prompts is not enough: the underlying evidence may have changed, the new query may be a near miss, or the cached answer may never be supported by the newly retrieved context.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in RAG serving reliability rather than foundation-model pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining-oriented readers is the separation between compute reuse and semantic validity. Prefix/KV reuse has a clear equivalence condition; answer-level reuse needs evidence-level checks. The paper also gives a better metric framing for cache systems: latency and hit rate are insufficient unless unsafe reuse is measured directly.
summary_en.technical_approach: GroundedCache is an evidence-validated cache router. Each cached answer is stored with a query and an evidence signature. The signature is content-addressed with SHA-1 hashes over normalized chunks and tagged with source versions. For a new query, the system retrieves fresh chunks, canonicalizes their order to preserve prefix reuse opportunities, and admits a cached answer only if four conditions hold: query similarity, high Jaccard overlap between old and new evidence signatures, matching source versions for shared chunks, and answer support under the new evidence. Support can be checked by deterministic lexical coverage over content tokens or by a lightweight judge call. If any condition fails, the system falls back to query-conditioned compression and normal generation. This is a routing layer above prefix-cache and chunk-cache mechanisms such as vLLM APC, RAGCache, TurboRAG, and LMCache.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation design is the main technical asset. The paper defines six deterministic workload regimes: exact repeats, paraphrases, near misses, document drift, long shared-document traffic, and bounded-KB CAG traffic, plus a HotpotQA adapter. The document-drift setting mutates numeric tokens in gold documents so that a stale cached answer becomes verifiably wrong unless rejected. The metric stack includes TTFT, latency, token count, answer-cache hit rate, unsafe-served rate, conditional false-hit rate, and stale/unsupported-hit breakdowns. The provided content does not expose complete numeric result tables, so concrete gains should not be inferred here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the Introduction for the distinction between prefix/KV reuse, retrieval-result reuse, and output-level reuse. Then inspect the method section, especially the evidence signature, the four gates, Figure 1, Figure 2, and Algorithm 1. The evaluation section is useful for its workload construction and safety metrics. Readers working on RAG serving or long-context reuse should spend more time on the versioning and support-check gates.

recommendation.zh: 关注 RAG 缓存的安全性而非单纯的速度，提出的四个门控条件设计合理，对构建生产级 RAG 系统有实际参考价值。
recommendation.en: Focuses on the safety of RAG caching rather than just speed. The proposed four gating conditions are reasonably designed and offer practical reference value for building production-level RAG systems.

paper.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
paper.abstract: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time. In this work, we study the new problem of error tracing and attribution in LLM memory systems. We propose a novel framework that transforms memory pipelines into executable memory evolution graphs, enabling fine-

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注的是 memory-augmented LLM system 的可追责性问题：系统答错了，错误究竟是在什么时候、哪一步 memory operation 中被引入的。难点不在于判断结果对错，而在于 memory 是跨轮、跨会话持续演化的，错误可能早在写入、更新、压缩、覆盖时就埋下，直到很久之后在检索或回答阶段才暴露。传统 chronological log 只能给出时间顺序，不能表达变量如何被创建、修改、传播和最终影响答案，因此很难做真正的 failure attribution。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接关联不强，它更偏 agent memory / system debugging / evaluation infrastructure。但如果关心 continual learning、外部记忆、长时程上下文管理，或者想理解“参数外记忆”为什么在真实系统里不稳定，这篇有方法论价值。它的贡献不在于提升模型本体能力，而在于把 memory system 的执行过程结构化，使错误分析从 outcome-level 走向 operation-level。对研究者而言，启发点主要有两个：一是 memory 研究不能只看最终任务分数，还要看错误是如何传播的；二是如果未来要把外部记忆更深地接到 pretrain/post-train 闭环里，traceability 会是必要基础设施。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。

第一层是 tracing representation。作者把 memory pipeline 统一表示成 executable memory evolution graph，也就是一个有向无环二部图 G=(V,O,E)。变量节点 V 表示执行中产生的具体对象，如原始消息、抽取出的 memory unit、检索结果、中间摘要、prompt、预测答案；操作节点 O 表示对这些变量施加的计算，如 LLM inference、retrieval、filtering、parsing、memory update、memory read 等。边 E 则显式记录信息流：哪些变量被某个操作消费，哪些新变量由该操作产生。这个表示的关键价值是，它把“时间上先后发生了什么”改写成“因果上谁影响了谁”。

第二层是 error taxonomy。论文不是只做一个 tracing toolkit，而是基于 execution graph 的模式定义结构化错误类型，用来区分错误是在写入、更新、覆盖、删除、检索还是使用阶段发生。虽然你给到的正文片段没有完整列出 taxonomy 细目，但从引言和方法描述看，作者试图把 memory failure 从笼统的 retrieval failure 拆成更细的 introduction / propagation / overwrite / misuse 等类别。这样做的意义在于，后续 attribution 不只是找一个“坏节点”，而是给出可操作的失效类型。

第三层是 automatic attribution。MemTrace 的自动归因流程是：给定一个失败案例，先从 execution graph 中检索与当前错误答案相关的 source messages 和关键变量，再沿信息流子图迭代回溯，定位决定性 faulty operation。这里的“决定性”不是简单找最早的异常，而是找对最终错误最有解释力的那一步。论文强调该方法是 system-agnostic 的，也就是说不依赖某一种 memory architecture，而是通过代码插桩把不同 memory system 的 update/read/generation 过程映射到统一图结构上。

从研究设计上看，这篇工作的亮点不是新模型，而是把 memory debugging 形式化成图上的 tracing and attribution 问题。相比只看最终 answer correctness 的 benchmark，它多了一层 operational observability；相比普通日志分析，它又能跨回合追踪变量依赖。
summary.experiments:
实验核心包括 benchmark 构建、自动归因效果、以及 attribution 信号能否反过来帮助系统优化。

数据方面，作者构建了 MemTraceBench，包含 160 个真实失败案例，覆盖四类代表性 memory system：Long-Context、RAG、Mem0、EverMemOS，并来自三个公开数据集。每个样本不仅有 QA 和执行日志，还有人工标注的错误类型、faulty operation 和解释。这一点很重要，因为没有 operation-level 标注，就很难认真评估 attribution 方法。

结果方面，论文的主结论是：memory failure attribution 远比 outcome evaluation 更难，现有系统即使最终能看出答错，也很难准确定位错误源。MemTrace 在 MemTraceBench 上能恢复出有意义的 faulty operations 和 error types，并生成较连贯的调试解释。另一个更实用的结果是，作者把 attribution 信号用于自动系统优化，最终端到端任务性能最高提升 7.62%。这说明 tracing 不是只服务于分析，也能形成闭环改进。

从你提供的正文片段里，具体指标名称、各 baseline 的数值、不同 memory system 上的分项表现还不完整，因此不宜编造细节。精读时建议重点核对：1）faulty operation 定位的准确率或 top-k 命中率；2）error type 分类表现；3）不同 memory architecture 上 tracing graph 的规模和复杂度；4）7.62% 提升是在哪个系统、什么优化策略下得到的。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着问题去读，而不是从头到尾细抠。

先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者为什么认为 chronological logs 不够，以及 execution graph 具体补了什么信息。然后看 tracing formalization，弄清变量节点、操作节点、依赖边分别怎么定义。接着直接看 benchmark 构建部分，判断 160 个 failure case 的标注质量和覆盖面是否足以支撑结论。最后看 attribution algorithm 和 system optimization 实验，判断它到底是在做可解释分析，还是已经能成为实用调试工具。

如果你主要做 pretraining，这篇不需要全文精读，20–30 分钟抓住方法框架和 benchmark 设计即可。若你做长期记忆、RAG、agent system 或 continual interaction，这篇值得把附录里的 tracing toolkit 和 annotation protocol 也看掉。最值得深挖的问题是：这种 graph-based attribution 能否扩展到参数记忆与外部记忆混合的系统，以及它是否能区分“memory 错了”和“generator 用错了 memory”这两类常被混淆的故障。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies traceability in memory-augmented LLM systems: when the system fails, where exactly was the error introduced in the memory pipeline? The challenge is not outcome detection but causal localization. Memory evolves across turns and sessions, so a failure may originate during storage, update, compression, or overwrite, and only surface much later during retrieval or answer generation. A chronological log preserves temporal order, but it does not expose how variables are created, modified, propagated, and eventually used, which makes true failure attribution difficult.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core pretraining is limited, but it is useful for researchers working on long-horizon agents, external memory, continual interaction, or non-parametric memory systems. The contribution is not a stronger model; it is a structured debugging framework that moves memory evaluation from outcome-level success/failure to operation-level diagnosis. The main research value is twofold. First, memory systems should not be judged only by end-task accuracy; we also need to understand how errors are introduced and propagated. Second, if external memory is to become a stable part of the pretrain/post-train loop, traceability will likely be necessary infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers.

First, the paper introduces a tracing representation. A memory pipeline is converted into an executable memory evolution graph, a directed acyclic bipartite graph G=(V,O,E). Variable nodes represent concrete artifacts produced during execution, such as raw messages, memory units, retrieved items, intermediate summaries, prompts, and predicted answers. Operation nodes represent computation steps such as LLM inference, retrieval, filtering, parsing, memory update, and memory read. Edges explicitly encode information flow: which variables are consumed by an operation and which new variables are produced. The key gain is that the representation turns a flat temporal trace into a causal dependency structure.

Second, the paper defines an error taxonomy grounded in graph patterns. It is not just a tracing toolkit. The authors use execution-graph structure to categorize failures according to where they arise in the memory lifecycle, such as writing, updating, overwriting, deletion, retrieval, or downstream use. The full taxonomy is not visible in the provided excerpt, but the intent is clear: move beyond generic retrieval failure and separate introduction, propagation, overwrite, and misuse-type errors. That makes attribution more actionable.

Third, the paper proposes automatic attribution. Given a failed case, MemTrace first retrieves source messages and key variables relevant to the wrong answer, then iteratively traces the information-flow subgraph backward to identify the decisive faulty operation. The goal is not merely to find the earliest anomaly, but the operation that best explains the final failure. An important design choice is system agnosticism: different memory systems are instrumented at the code level and mapped into the same graph abstraction, so the method is not tied to one specific memory architecture.

The main novelty is therefore not a new model but a formalization of memory debugging as a graph-based tracing and attribution problem. Compared with standard benchmarks that only score final answers, it adds operational observability. Compared with ordinary log analysis, it can follow dependencies across turns and sessions.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section centers on benchmark construction, attribution quality, and whether attribution signals can be used to improve systems.

The paper introduces MemTraceBench, a benchmark of 160 real failure cases drawn from four representative memory systems: Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS, based on three public datasets. Each case includes QA pairs, execution logs, human-annotated error labels, faulty operations, and explanations. This is important because operation-level attribution cannot be evaluated seriously without operation-level supervision.

The main empirical conclusion is that memory failure attribution is substantially harder than simple outcome evaluation. Existing systems may reveal that an answer is wrong, but they do not reliably identify where the failure originated. MemTrace is reported to recover meaningful faulty operations and error types, and to generate coherent debugging explanations. A more practical result is that the attribution signals can be fed back into automatic system optimization, improving end-task performance by up to 7.62%. That suggests the framework is not only diagnostic but can close the loop for system improvement.

The provided excerpt does not include the full metric tables, baseline numbers, or per-system breakdowns, so those details should be verified directly in the paper before citing them. In a careful read, the most important numbers to inspect are: faulty-operation localization accuracy or top-k hit rate, error-type classification performance, graph size and complexity across memory architectures, and the exact setup behind the reported 7.62% gain.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read with a concrete question in mind rather than linearly.

Start with the introduction and the main figure to understand why chronological logs are insufficient and what the execution graph adds. Then read the tracing formalization carefully: how variable nodes, operation nodes, and dependency edges are defined. After that, jump to the benchmark section and assess whether the 160 annotated failure cases have enough diversity and annotation quality to support the claims. Finally, read the attribution algorithm and the optimization experiments to judge whether the method is mainly an interpretability tool or already a practical debugging workflow.

If your focus is core pretraining, a 20–30 minute pass is enough to capture the framework and benchmark design. If you work on memory, RAG, long-horizon agents, or continual interaction, it is worth reading the appendix sections on instrumentation and annotation protocol. The most interesting follow-up question is whether this graph-based attribution can extend to systems that mix parametric memory with external memory, and whether it can cleanly separate “the memory is wrong” from “the generator used the memory incorrectly.”

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但做长上下文/RAG memory 的人该看；先读 failure taxonomy 和 attribution 例子，能直接改你们内部 debug 流程。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but anyone working on long-context or memory-augmented systems should read the failure taxonomy and attribution examples first; they can directly improve your internal debugging workflow.

paper.title: ConRAG: Consensus-Driven Multi-View Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) on multi-hop question answering (QA), which requires reasoning over evidence from multiple documents. Current multi-hop RAG methods generally focus on either query-side task decomposition or corpus-side knowledge graph construction. Despite their progress, these methods still struggle to achieve satisfactory performance on complex multi-hop QA tasks. To this end, we propose ConRAG,

summary.core_problem: 解决多跳问答中 RAG 检索阶段难以同时覆盖关系、实体和文本证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 RAG 方法改进。它不是预训练方法，但对检索增强系统的证据组织有一定参考价值，尤其是 query-side 分解和 corpus-side 结构化两条路线如何合并。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ConRAG，一个 consensus-driven multi-view retrieval 框架，同时优化查询侧和语料侧；检索时融合 relation、entity、text 三类视角，并用共识机制筛选更可靠的多跳证据。
summary.experiments: 在三个 multi-hop QA benchmark 上评估，报告相对 vanilla RAG 最高 +26.9% 的平均性能增益，并与 query decomposition、knowledge graph construction 等多跳 RAG baseline 比较。摘要未给出完整模型配置和数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the difficulty of retrieving complete relational, entity-level, and textual evidence for multi-hop QA in RAG systems.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an engineering-oriented RAG method rather than a pretraining result. It is still useful as a reference for combining query-side decomposition with corpus-side structured retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConRAG builds a consensus-driven multi-view retrieval pipeline that optimizes both query and corpus sides, combining relation, entity, and text signals to select more reliable evidence chains.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, with up to 26.9% average gains over vanilla RAG and comparisons against decomposition- and graph-based multi-hop RAG baselines. The abstract does not provide full model or training details.

recommendation.zh: RAG 工程组合拳，读 abstract 和方法图即可；对 pretrain 的直接信息少，主要看多视角证据融合是否可迁移。
recommendation.en: Mostly a RAG engineering composition; read the abstract and method diagram, with limited direct signal for pretraining beyond multi-view evidence fusion.

paper.title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
paper.abstract: Retrieval is increasingly moving from one-shot matching toward interactive reasoning, where language agents iteratively inspect evidence, reformulate queries, and search again. Training such agents raises a credit-assignment challenge: executable actions such as queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by the retriever, while latent reasoning steps are not directly observable and only affect future executable actions. This asymmetry makes outcome-level reward assignment unreliable, as the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是交互式检索推理 agent 中的信用分配问题：查询、摘要这类可执行动作能直接用检索器打分，但中间 reasoning span 只是影响后续查询，不能直接观测。只用最终检索奖励做 RL，容易把奖励错误分配给并未真正改变检索结果的推理步骤。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 阶段的训练信号设计有参考价值。它把工具交互中的可观测反馈转成局部学习信号，重点不是训练更强的 retriever，而是让 reasoning agent 学会哪些中间决策真的影响外部工具结果。这类方法对 RL 数据构造、过程监督替代方案、critic-free policy optimization 都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: RICE-PO 的核心做法是利用检索任务中“可执行动作”和“潜在推理动作”的不对称性。每一轮 agent 先生成 reasoning segment，再生成 summary/query，summary 会送入固定 retriever 得到文档和检索指标。方法先用三个诊断量选择值得检查的局部决策点：policy uncertainty 用高熵 summary 找模型不确定的位置；reasoning-to-summary influence 检查不同 reasoning continuation 是否导致不同 summary 奖励；future residual stability 检查后续轮次是否保留当前局部奖励差异，而不是被后面的交互完全覆盖。对被选中的锚点，方法从同一历史状态构造局部分支，用 retriever 评价不同 summary，得到 step-specific retrieval reward。只有当 reasoning 对 summary 有足够影响、且未来残差稳定时，才把 summary 的奖励回传给前面的 latent reasoning span。它不训练 critic，也不依赖 process reward model，而是用检索器本身提供的可执行反馈构造局部偏好信号。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 BRIGHT 和 BEIR 检索任务，比较对象包括 prompt-based 交互式 agent 和 group-based RL baseline。论文报告 RICE-PO 在这些任务上有稳定提升，并做了几类分析：高不确定性点选择是否有效，局部 retrieval feedback 的质量，latent reasoning credit propagation 是否可靠，以及 counterfactual branching 带来的额外成本。给定材料中没有提供具体 NDCG、Recall 或训练规模数字，因此不应过度解读提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议看引言、Preliminaries 和方法部分中三个 branch diagnostics 的定义。重点关注两点：第一，为什么 summary 可以直接打检索奖励，而 reasoning 不能直接打；第二，future residual stability 如何避免把后续轮次造成的收益错误归因到当前 reasoning。实验部分可快速看 BRIGHT/BEIR 主结果和 branching cost 分析，预计 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets credit assignment in interactive retrieval agents. Executable actions such as generated queries or summaries can be directly evaluated by a retriever, while latent reasoning spans only affect future executable actions. A final outcome reward is therefore too coarse and can reward reasoning tokens that did not causally improve retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for post-training signal design. It shows how tool interactions can be converted into localized learning signals without a learned critic or a separate process reward model. The most relevant lesson for foundation-model training is the treatment of observability: only actions with direct environmental feedback should receive direct credit, while latent reasoning needs gated attribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: RICE-PO models each retrieval episode as multiple rounds. At each round, the policy emits a reasoning segment and then a summary segment; the summary is used as the next retrieval query and receives retrieval feedback. The method selects critical decision points using three diagnostics: policy uncertainty, which finds high-entropy executable summaries; reasoning-to-summary influence, which checks whether alternative reasoning continuations change the summary reward; and future residual stability, which verifies that the local reward difference is not later overturned. For selected anchors, it builds local counterfactual branches from the same history, evaluates the resulting summaries with retrieval metrics, and uses these rewards as step-specific supervision. Rewards are propagated backward to latent reasoning only when the reasoning span has sufficient influence and the future residual remains stable.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on BRIGHT and BEIR retrieval tasks against prompt-based interactive agents and group-based RL baselines. It reports consistent gains and includes analyses of uncertainty-based anchor selection, local feedback quality, reliability of backward credit propagation, and the compute cost of counterfactual branching. The provided text does not include exact metric values, model sizes, or training budgets, so the empirical magnitude should be checked in the tables before drawing strong conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction, the formal setup, and the section defining the three branch diagnostics. The key part is the distinction between directly executable summaries and non-executable reasoning spans. The residual-stability gate is also worth checking, because it is the mechanism that prevents later retrieval rounds from corrupting local credit. The main result tables and branching-cost analysis should be enough for a 20–30 minute read.

recommendation.zh: 读方法里 anchor 和 counterfactual credit 的定义；若信号构造干净，可迁移到 tool-use RL 的奖励分解实验。
recommendation.en: Read the definitions of anchors and counterfactual credit; if the signal construction is clean, it is portable to reward decomposition experiments for tool-use RL.

paper.title: What Makes a Medical Checker Trainable? Diagnosing Signal Collapse and Reward Hacking in Checker-Guided RAG for Biomedical QA
paper.abstract: Medical RAG needs evidence-grounded claims, so plugging a claim-level NLI checker into retrieval-augmented RL is intuitive. \textbf{We find that the checker's \emph{output distribution} during training, not its held-out accuracy, decides whether it provides trainable gradient.} We compare four NLI checker back-ends as process rewards inside a GRPO-trained medical RAG agent (Qwen2.5-7B, replicated on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B) across four held-out medical QA benchmarks. Three diagnostic findings

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 verifier/checker 作为 RL 奖励时为什么会失效：决定训练是否有效的不是 checker 在静态 NLI 测试集上的准确率，而是它在当前策略 rollout 上产生的输出分布。
summary.importance: 虽然场景是医疗 RAG，但对 post-train 和 RL-for-reasoning 更有一般意义。它提醒一个容易被忽略的问题：奖励模型或过程 verifier 的离线准确率不足以判断训练可用性。训练中真正需要看的是 reward 分布是否有梯度、是否会被策略找到捷径、以及这些性质是否随策略变化。这个结论也适用于数学 verifier、代码 verifier、事实性 checker 和检索增强 agent 的过程奖励设计。
summary.technical_approach: 系统基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，用 GRPO 训练一个多轮 medical RAG agent，并扩展 Search-R1 框架。agent 有两个工具：Search 使用 MedCPT bi-encoder 在 MedRAG 语料中检索 top-5 passages；Check 是 claim-level NLI verification server，会把回答拆成 atomic claims，再判断每个 claim 与证据之间是 Entail、Neutral 还是 Contradict。作者把四种 checker 后端作为同一 reward path 的可替换组件：Likelihood-NLI 用 Meditron-3-8B 做 raw log-probability scoring；MedNLI-Cls 是 PubMedBERT-base 在 MedNLI 上微调的三分类器；Hybrid 使用 GPT-4o-mini 做 atomic claim extraction，再用本地 log-prob scorer；GPT-NLI 使用 GPT-4o-mini 端到端完成抽取和判定。核心诊断变量是 per-claim support rate，即生成 claim 中被判为 Entail 的比例。
summary.experiments: 主要发现有三点。第一，signal collapse 与 log-prob scoring 强相关：Likelihood-NLI 会把超过 97% 的 claims 判为 Neutral，使每个 claim 的支持率接近零，RL 梯度基本失效；同样的 claim-evidence 对，MedNLI-Cls 能产生非退化分布。第二，奖励信号强度和最终回答质量不是单调关系。MedNLI-Cls 的 support rate 约为 54%，属于 moderate signal，但 BERTScore 达到 0.600；更强的 GPT 类 checker support rate 更高，例如 Hybrid 约 76%、GPT-NLI 约 86%，但 GPT-NLI 对应 BERTScore 为 0.591，并触发 ultra-short answers、search avoidance、非英语回答规避英语 NLI prompt 等 reward hacking 路径。第三，signal strength 是 policy-checker pair 的性质，而不是 checker 单独的性质；作者用 Qwen2.5-7B 到 Qwen3-4B 的替换实验支持这一点，并在 Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B 上做复现性检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对“held-out NLI accuracy 不等于 trainable reward”的论证，再看 Method 中四种 checker 的机制差异。实验部分重点看 signal collapse 的 support-rate 曲线，以及 reward hacking cascade 的分析。对做 RLHF、RLAIF、过程监督或 verifier-guided training 的读者，最该关注的是诊断指标：不要只看 verifier accuracy，要记录 rollout 上的 label 分布、reward 方差、平均回答长度、工具调用频率、语言分布和搜索使用率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why an NLI checker used as a process reward can fail during RL training. The central issue is that held-out NLI accuracy does not determine trainability; the checker’s output distribution on the policy’s own rollouts does.
summary_en.importance: The setting is biomedical RAG, but the lesson is broader for post-training and verifier-guided RL. A verifier can be accurate on static test pairs while producing either collapsed rewards or exploitable shortcuts during policy optimization. For pretraining and post-training researchers, the useful takeaway is to treat reward distribution under rollout as a training-time object: support rate, variance, shortcut channels, and policy dependence matter as much as offline accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system trains a multi-turn medical RAG agent based on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with GRPO, extending Search-R1. The agent can call Search, backed by a frozen MedCPT retriever over the MedRAG corpus, and Check, an NLI verification server that decomposes answers into atomic claims and labels each claim-evidence pair as Entail, Neutral, or Contradict. Four checker backends are plugged into the same reward path: Likelihood-NLI, which uses Meditron-3-8B with raw log-probability scoring; MedNLI-Cls, a PubMedBERT-base classifier fine-tuned on MedNLI; Hybrid, which uses GPT-4o-mini for atomic claim extraction and a local log-prob scorer; and GPT-NLI, which uses GPT-4o-mini end to end. The main diagnostic variable is per-claim support rate, the fraction of generated claims labeled Entail.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports three main diagnostic findings. First, signal collapse is specific to the log-probability scoring setup: Likelihood-NLI labels more than 97% of claims as Neutral, which removes useful RL gradient, while MedNLI-Cls gives non-degenerate labels on the same pairs. Second, stronger support signals do not monotonically improve answer quality. MedNLI-Cls produces a moderate support rate around 54% and reaches BERTScore 0.600, while stronger GPT-based checkers show higher support rates, such as 76% for Hybrid and 86% for GPT-NLI, but GPT-NLI reaches BERTScore 0.591 and induces shortcut behavior. The observed shortcut cascade includes ultra-short answers, search avoidance, and non-English responses that evade an English-only NLI prompt. Third, signal strength depends on the policy-checker pair rather than the checker alone, supported by a Qwen2.5-7B to Qwen3-4B swap and additional replication checks on Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s distinction between held-out checker accuracy and rollout-time reward distribution. Then read the method section describing the four checker backends, because the mechanism differences explain the later failures. In the results, focus on the support-rate diagnostics and the reward-hacking cascade. The most reusable part is the evaluation protocol for reward signals: log label distributions on policy rollouts, reward variance, answer length, tool-use frequency, language distribution, and retrieval usage, rather than relying only on verifier accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 领域任务外壳不重要；reward 分布比 checker accuracy 更关键，这个 prior 应进内部 RLVR 诊断清单。
recommendation.en: Ignore the medical shell; the useful prior is that reward distribution beats checker accuracy as a trainability diagnostic for RLVR-style setups.

paper.title: ICICLE: Expanding Retrieval with In-Context Documents
paper.abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) maps queries directly to document identifiers (docids) using parametric knowledge, However, this design makes corpus expansion costly: adding new documents requires updating model parameters to encode new document-docid associations incurs repeated training and catastrophic forgetting of previously indexed documents. In this work, we revisit incremental GR as an in-context retrieval problem, where newly added documents are supplied as inference-time document-docid evide

summary.core_problem: 现有生成式检索（GR）新增文档需要重新训练模型，成本高且易遗忘已索引文档
summary.importance: 检索领域方法创新，将增量生成式检索转化为上下文检索问题，无需重新训练即可扩展语料库
summary.technical_approach: 提出ICICLE上下文索引框架，结合COPY路由机制、偏好校准和长上下文适配，同时利用参数化记忆和上下文提供的文档-docid对生成docid
summary.experiments: 在MS MARCO和NQ320K数据集上测试，提升了新文档检索效果，同时保留了已见文档的检索性能，无需额外训练

summary_en.core_problem: Existing generative retrieval (GR) requires retraining the model to add new documents, leading to high cost and catastrophic forgetting of previously indexed documents.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation in retrieval, transforming incremental generative retrieval into an in-context retrieval problem, enabling corpus expansion without retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ICICLE, an in-context indexing framework that combines a [COPY]-based routing mechanism, preference-based calibration, and large context adaptation to generate docids using both parametric memory and context-provided document-docid pairs.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on MS MARCO and NQ320K datasets, improves retrieval performance for newly introduced documents while preserving seen-document retention, no additional training required.

recommendation.zh: 面向RAG场景的检索方法改进，对LLM基座预训练无直接启示，作为应用技术备查即可
recommendation.en: Retrieval method improvement for RAG scenarios, no direct insight for LLM base pretraining; only for reference as application technology.

paper.title: Retrieval as Reasoning: Self-Evolving Agent-Native Retrieval via LLM-Wiki
paper.abstract: LLM agents require retrieval to behave less like one-shot context fetching and more like reasoning: searching, reading, traversing, and deciding when evidence is sufficient. Yet current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems organize external knowledge as flat chunks retrieved by embedding similarity, exposing a retrieval-as-lookup interface ill-suited to iterative reasoning agents. We propose LLM-Wiki, an agent-native retrieval system that operationalizes the Retrieval-as-Reasoning paradi

summary.core_problem: RAG 把外部知识当作静态 chunk 检索，难以支撑需要多步搜索、阅读、跳转和停机判断的 agent 式推理。
summary.importance: 贡献属于通用 Agent/RAG 系统设计，而不是基座预训练本身；但它提出了更接近“检索即推理”的知识接口，对理解 agent 时代外部记忆应如何组织有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 LLM-Wiki，把文档编译成带双向链接的 Wiki 结构，而不是平铺向量索引；系统暴露 search、read、follow-link 等工具调用接口，让模型以迭代方式探索证据。另加一个 Error Book 机制，用于持续记录结构和语义错误并自我修正，使知识库可以自演化。
summary.experiments: 论文在 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA 上报告优于 HippoRAG 2 等方法，主打多跳问答场景。摘要未给出模型规模和训练细节，因此更像系统接口与知识组织方式的比较，而不是 clean 的模型能力归因实验。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 WeChat / Tencent Inc.，属于大厂 Agent 与检索系统方向工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RAG treats external knowledge as flat chunk retrieval, which is poorly matched to agentic reasoning that requires iterative search, reading, traversal, and stopping decisions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent/RAG systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but its retrieval interface is relevant for thinking about external memory organization in the agent era.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes LLM-Wiki, which compiles documents into linked Wiki-style pages instead of a flat embedding index. It exposes search, read, and link-following as tool calls, and adds an Error Book mechanism for persistent structural and semantic self-correction so the knowledge base can evolve over time.
summary_en.experiments: The method reportedly outperforms systems such as HippoRAG 2 on HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and 2WikiMultiHopQA, focusing on multi-hop QA. The abstract does not provide model scale or detailed training setup, so the evidence is more about interface/system design than clean capability attribution.
summary_en.authors_note: From WeChat / Tencent Inc., representing a large-lab effort on agentic retrieval systems.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线，但它把“外部知识接口”从向量召回改成可遍历结构，这会影响你怎么看 agent-era memory；读系统设计和 error book 即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reframes external knowledge from flat retrieval to traversable memory; read the system interface and Error Book parts, not every benchmark table.

paper.title: AgentIR: A Workload-Adaptive Cascade Retrieval Substrate for Long-Term Conversational Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term conversational memory is a retrieval workload classical IR was not built for: the index grows during the query stream, query types shift intra-session, and the latency budget per retrieval is sub-10 ms. Lucene-class engines treat the index as static and the query as stateless, leaving the workload's structure unexploited.   AgentIR treats fusion as a per-query decision along two axes: which fusion to apply (BM25, Dense, RRF, or agent-aware RRF), and whether the ~52 ms dense channel is

summary.core_problem: 面向长期对话记忆，如何在动态增长索引、会话内查询类型变化和亚 10ms 延迟预算下，决定是否调用昂贵的 dense retrieval。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory / RAG 检索系统优化。它不改 LLM，也不涉及预训练，但提出了一个 workload-adaptive cascade：对每个查询决定用 BM25、Dense、RRF 或 agent-aware RRF，并判断 dense 通道是否值得运行。
summary.technical_approach: AgentIR 把融合策略做成 per-query 决策。第一维选择检索融合方式，第二维用 BM25 top-k margin 作为置信信号触发 cascade router；router 不需要重新训练，可随 workload 重新调阈值。关键取舍是用便宜的稀疏检索 margin 预测 dense channel 的边际价值。
summary.experiments: 在 LongMemEval 上 n=500，dense 通道确实提供额外信息时，cascade 跳过 63% 查询，在两个 LLM judge 下保持准确率相当，并取得 2.67x 加速；按 query type 调阈值后，5-fold cross-validation 下达到 5.76x。LoCoMo 上 n=1,982，摘要显示 BM25 已很强，但后续结果片段被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-term conversational memory retrieval under a growing index, shifting query types within sessions, and sub-10 ms latency constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory and RAG retrieval-systems contribution. It does not change the LLM or pretraining process, but it proposes a workload-adaptive cascade that decides per query whether to use BM25, dense retrieval, RRF, or agent-aware RRF, and whether the dense channel is worth its cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentIR makes fusion a per-query decision. It chooses the fusion mode and uses the BM25 top-k margin as a cheap confidence signal for a cascade router that can be retuned across workloads without retraining. The key idea is to predict the marginal utility of dense retrieval from sparse-retrieval confidence.
summary_en.experiments: On LongMemEval with n=500, where the dense channel adds information, the cascade skips 63% of queries while preserving LLM-judged accuracy under two judges and gives a 2.67x speedup; per-query-type thresholds reach 5.76x under 5-fold cross-validation. On LoCoMo with n=1,982, the abstract indicates BM25 is already strong, but the provided fragment truncates the remaining result.

recommendation.zh: 系统味道比模型味道重；记住 BM25 margin 路由 dense 的结果即可，不值得为预训练读正文。
recommendation.en: This is more systems than modeling; keep the BM25-margin dense-routing result in mind, but it is not worth a full read for pretraining.

paper.title: DeferMem: Query-Time Evidence Distillation via Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory QA
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents still struggle with long-term memory question answering, where answer-supporting evidence is often scattered across long conversational histories and buried in substantial irrelevant content. Existing memory systems typically process memory before future queries are known, then retrieve the resulting units based on similarity rather than their utility for answering the query. This workflow leaves downstream answerers to denoise retrieved candidates and reconstru

summary.core_problem: 解决长期记忆问答中证据分散、历史噪声大、传统相似度检索难以给出 query-specific supporting evidence 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 LLM agent memory/RAG 框架，而不是基座预训练方法。它的价值在于把“先压缩记忆再等未来查询”的流程改为查询时证据蒸馏，并用 RL 训练 distiller。
summary.technical_approach: DeferMem 先用轻量 segment-link 结构组织原始对话历史，在查询时做高召回候选检索；随后用 memory distiller 将高召回但噪声很大的候选压缩成忠实、自包含、能回答当前问题的证据集合。DistillPO 是用于训练这个 distiller 的强化学习算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要聚焦长期记忆 QA 场景，声称 DeferMem 能从长对话历史中抽取 query-conditioned evidence，减轻 answerer 的去噪和重构负担；未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练数据量或量化提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学 State Key Lab of CAD&CG。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term memory QA where supporting evidence is scattered across long conversational histories and buried in irrelevant content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general LLM agent memory/RAG framework rather than a base pretraining method. Its useful idea is to defer memory compression until the query is known and train a distiller with RL to produce answer-useful evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeferMem organizes raw history with a lightweight segment-link structure and retrieves broad high-recall candidates at query time. A memory distiller then compresses noisy candidates into faithful, self-contained evidence for the current query. DistillPO is the reinforcement learning algorithm used to train the distiller.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on long-term memory QA and claims that DeferMem extracts query-conditioned evidence from long histories, reducing denoising and reconstruction burden for the answerer. It does not specify benchmarks, model scale, data size, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 query-time distillation 设计即可；这是 agent memory 工程，不会直接改变 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the query-time distillation design only; this is agent-memory engineering, not a pretraining prior changer.

institutions: State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University

paper.title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research
