paper.abstract: The exponential growth of global academic output has confronted researchers and AI agents with an unprecedented ``information explosion,'' where fragmented and unstructured knowledge organization impedes deep interdisciplinary integration. Current academic retrieval tools predominantly rely on superficial keyword matching or vector-space semantic retrieval, which lack the topological reasoning capabilities required to navigate complex logical connections. Agentic deep-research-based frameworks a

summary.core_problem: 为自动化科研和深度研究 Agent 构建大规模、跨学科、异构的科学知识图谱，以缓解文献碎片化和检索推理困难。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是科研 Agent 基础数据资源。它不是 LLM 预训练方法，但 43M 论文、157M 实体、3B 三元组的规模对 RAG、科学发现 Agent 和结构化知识增强有一定工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SciAtlas 将 26 个学科的论文资源整合为大型异构知识图谱，强调用拓扑结构连接论文、实体和关系，为 Agent 提供可导航、可推理的科学演化网络，而不是只依赖关键词匹配或向量检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出资源规模：超过 43M 篇论文、26 个学科、157M 实体、3B 三元组。未提供具体构建流程、关系 schema、抽取模型、质量评测、下游 Agent 提升幅度或成本对比。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Zhejiang University 和 University College London；论文面向 automated scientific research 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The work builds a large-scale, cross-disciplinary, heterogeneous scientific knowledge graph for automated research and deep-research agents.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a data and infrastructure resource for scientific agents. It is not an LLM pretraining method, but its scale is relevant to RAG, scientific discovery agents, and structured knowledge augmentation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SciAtlas integrates papers from 26 disciplines into a heterogeneous knowledge graph, emphasizing topological connections among papers, entities, and relations. The goal is to provide a navigable scientific evolution network rather than relying only on keyword or vector retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports over 43 million papers, 26 disciplines, 157 million entities, and 3 billion triples. It does not specify extraction pipelines, schema design, quality evaluation, downstream agent gains, or cost comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Zhejiang University and University College London; the work targets automated scientific research.

recommendation.zh: 作为科研 Agent/RAG 资源知道即可；没有清楚质量评测前，3B triples 更像规模信号而非训练信号。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as scientific-agent infrastructure; without quality evaluation, 3B triples are a scale signal, not yet a training signal.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: PEEK 解决的是长上下文 Agent 在反复访问同一外部语料、代码库或文档集合时缺少“上下文方位感”的问题。现有方法保留聊天轨迹、压缩历史、检索原文或积累任务策略，但很少维护一个关于外部上下文本身的、可复用的小型结构化记忆。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法，但对长上下文和 Agent 训练有方法论意义。它把长期记忆从“保存更多历史”转向“保存可迁移的上下文地图”：语料里有什么、结构如何、哪些 schema、常量、实体和证据位置反复有用。对基座研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不只取决于窗口长度，也取决于模型能否形成稳定的外部环境索引。未来如果要训练长期工作流模型，这类 orientation knowledge 可以成为数据构造、过程监督和评测目标。
summary.technical_approach: PEEK 在 system prompt 中维护一个固定 token 预算的 context map。这个 map 不是 KV-cache，也不是聊天摘要，而是面向外部上下文的语义索引。系统包含三个模块：Distiller 从 Agent 执行轨迹中抽取可复用的上下文知识；Cartographer 把抽取结果转成结构化编辑，更新 map；Evictor 在固定预算下按优先级淘汰低价值内容。论文强调抽取与编辑要分离，否则容易把一次性任务事实、对话噪声和重复内容写入 map。相比 RAG，PEEK 不只是被动取回片段；相比 prompt learning，它维护的不是通用任务策略，而是某个固定外部上下文的方位知识。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类长上下文任务：reasoning and aggregation，以及 context learning。PEEK 在 OOLONG 上相对各类 baseline 提升 6.3–34.0%；在 CL-bench 上 solving rate 提升 6.0–14.0%，rubric accuracy 提升 7.8–12.1%。相对强 prompt-learning baseline，PEEK 在 OOLONG 上提升 10.7%，在 CL-bench 上 solving rate / rubric accuracy 分别提升 6.0% / 9.9%。效率上，PEEK 在 OOLONG 比该 prompt-learning baseline 少 93–145 次迭代；成本上，OOLONG 低 1.7–5.8 倍，CL-bench 低约 1.4 倍。泛化实验显示，收益可迁移到 GPT-5.5、Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8，以及不同 Agent backbone OpenAI Codex。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 2，理解它如何区分 Agent/Task State 与 External Context State，以及 active/passive context management。再看方法部分的 Distiller、Cartographer、Evictor，重点关注 context map 的写入规则和 eviction 规则。Section 4.5 的消融值得看，因为它说明为什么不能直接把执行轨迹摘要写进 map。实验部分优先看 OOLONG 和 CL-bench 的质量、迭代次数、成本三组指标，而不只看最终 accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: PEEK addresses a recurring-context problem in long-context LLM agents. When an agent repeatedly works over the same document collection, repository, or corpus, existing systems preserve chat history, retrieve raw material, compact transcripts, or learn task-level prompts. They usually do not maintain reusable orientation knowledge about the external context itself.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-context model research and agent training. The key idea is to preserve a compact context map rather than more conversation history. The map records what the external context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, schemas, constants, or evidence locations have been useful. For foundation-model work, the implication is clear: long-context performance is not only about context length or retrieval quality. Models and agents also need stable, reusable indexes over their working environment. This can inform future data construction, process supervision, and evaluations for persistent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK maintains a fixed-budget context map inside the system prompt. The map is not a KV-cache and not a transcript summary. It is a curated semantic index over a recurring external context. The system has three modules. The Distiller extracts transferable contextual knowledge from execution trajectories. The Cartographer converts extracted knowledge into structured map edits. The Evictor enforces the token budget through priority-based eviction. The separation between extraction and editing is important, because direct updates from trajectories tend to leak task-specific facts, duplicate entries, and noisy observations into the map. Compared with RAG, PEEK actively maintains orientation knowledge rather than only retrieving passages. Compared with prompt learning, it stores context-specific knowledge rather than task procedures.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PEEK on reasoning-and-aggregation tasks and context-learning tasks. On OOLONG, PEEK improves over baselines by 6.3–34.0%. On CL-bench, it improves solving rate by 6.0–14.0% and rubric accuracy by 7.8–12.1%. Against a strong prompt-learning baseline, PEEK gains 10.7% on OOLONG and 6.0% / 9.9% on CL-bench solving rate / rubric accuracy. It is also more efficient: on OOLONG it uses 93–145 fewer iterations than that prompt-learning baseline, and costs 1.7–5.8x less; on CL-bench it costs about 1.4x less. The gains transfer across models, including GPT-5.5 and Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8, and across agent backbones such as OpenAI Codex.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with Figure 2 to understand the distinction between Agent/Task State and External Context State, and between active and passive context management. Then read the method description of the Distiller, Cartographer, and Evictor, with special attention to how map updates and evictions are controlled. Section 4.5 is useful because it explains why simply summarizing trajectories into the map is not enough. In the experiments, focus on the three-way tradeoff among quality, number of iterations, and cost, rather than only the final task score.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation：orientation cache 是比轨迹记忆更干净的变量，可借鉴到长上下文数据构造。
recommendation.en: Skim the design and ablations: orientation caching is a cleaner variable than trajectory memory and may inform long-context data construction.

paper.title: The 99% Success Paradox: When Near-Perfect Retrieval Equals Random Selection
paper.abstract: For most of the history of information retrieval (IR), search results were designed for human consumers who could scan, filter, and discard irrelevant information on their own. This shaped retrieval systems to optimize for finding and ranking more relevant documents, but not keeping results clean and minimal, as the human was the final filter. However, LLMs have changed that by lacking this filtering ability.   To address this, we introduce Bits-over-Random (BoR), a chance-corrected measure of r

summary.core_problem: 解决传统信息检索指标无法适配LLM作为检索消费者场景的问题，解释高检索成功率下实际效果等同于随机选择的99%成功悖论的成因，量化检索系统的真实选择性
summary.importance: 对RAG系统、LLM Agent的工具检索模块的设计和评测有直接参考价值，纠正了过往盲目提升召回率、增大检索K值的误区，为检索深度的选择提供了可量化的边界
summary.technical_approach: 提出Bits-over-Random（BoR）指标，计算为观测到的检索成功概率与随机选择的成功概率的比值的2为底对数，单位为比特，修正了传统指标随K值机械上升的问题，可直接衡量检索系统相对于随机选择的真实选择性；推导了选择性分解的深度恒等式，确定了选择性崩溃的边界条件
summary.experiments: 在20 Newsgroups数据集上验证了99% success@100的检索系统的BoR接近0，即等同于随机选择；选择性崩溃边界为(K*平均每个查询的相关文档数/语料库大小)超过3-5时，系统选择性接近随机；ΔBoR的预测值与实测值误差小于0.01比特，跨BM25、SPLADE等不同检索架构均成立；在50-500规模的工具检索场景中，即使完美选择器也会出现选择性消失的问题
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看指标定义、崩溃边界条件和Agent工具检索场景的实验部分，跳过传统检索指标的背景介绍，预计阅读时间10分钟，核心结论可直接用于RAG和Agent系统的检索参数调优

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the problem that traditional information retrieval metrics cannot adapt to scenarios where LLMs act as retrieval consumers, explain the cause of the 99% success paradox where high retrieval success rates correspond to random-level actual performance, and quantify the real selectivity of retrieval systems
summary_en.importance: Offers direct reference for the design and evaluation of RAG systems and tool retrieval modules of LLM agents, corrects the previous misconception of blindly improving recall and increasing retrieval K value, and provides a quantifiable boundary for retrieval depth selection
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the Bits-over-Random (BoR) metric, calculated as the base-2 logarithm of the ratio between observed retrieval success probability and random selection success probability, measured in bits. It fixes the issue that traditional metrics increase mechanically with K value, and can directly measure the real selectivity of retrieval systems relative to random selection. A depth identity for selectivity decomposition is derived, and the boundary condition for selectivity collapse is determined
summary_en.experiments: Verified on the 20 Newsgroups dataset that a retrieval system with 99% success@100 has BoR close to 0, meaning equivalent to random selection; the selectivity collapse boundary is that when (K * average number of relevant documents per query / corpus size) exceeds 3-5, system selectivity approaches random level; the prediction error of ΔBoR is less than 0.01 bits, which holds across different retrieval architectures including BM25 and SPLADE; in tool retrieval scenarios with 50-500 tools, even perfect selectors suffer from selectivity vanishing
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the metric definition, collapse boundary conditions and experiments on agent tool retrieval scenarios during skimming, skip background introduction of traditional retrieval metrics. Estimated reading time is 10 minutes. Core conclusions can be directly applied to retrieval parameter tuning of RAG and agent systems

recommendation.zh: Meta团队指出的检索评估反直觉现象对RAG系统设计有实际意义，BoR指标值得在LLM检索评估中考虑，建议看核心定义和实验结果部分。
recommendation.en: Counterintuitive retrieval evaluation finding from Meta with practical implications for RAG system design; BoR metric worth considering for LLM retrieval evaluation. Read core definitions and results.

paper.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factual accuracy of large language model (LLM) outputs by grounding generation in external knowledge. Recent agentic RAG systems extend this paradigm with critical agents to evaluate model responses and iteratively refine outputs. However, most prior work implicitly assumes reliable critic feedback and focuses on planning strategies, while paying limited attention to the robustness of the error-correction process itself, which can be impacted by

summary.core_problem: Agentic RAG系统中错误纠正过程本身不可靠——错误分类可能偏差、纠正可能无效，而现有工作大多假设critic反馈是可靠的。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无需显式错误分类的RAG改进方案，直接从有缺陷的输出映射到纠错行动计划。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RePAIR（Response-Action Learning paradigm），不依赖细粒度错误分类法和显式critic监督，直接将有缺陷的RAG输出映射到缓解错误的行动计划。
summary.experiments: 在多个benchmark上一致提升了agentic RAG性能。具体模型和提升幅度摘要未详述。
summary.authors_note: Columbia University。

summary_en.core_problem: Error correction in agentic RAG systems is itself unreliable——error categorization can be biased and corrections can be ineffective, yet most prior work assumes critic feedback is reliable.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a RAG improvement scheme without explicit error categorization, directly mapping flawed outputs to error-mitigating action plans.
summary_en.technical_approach: RePAIR (Response-Action Learning paradigm) directly maps flawed RAG outputs to error-mitigating action plans without relying on fine-grained error taxonomies and explicit critic supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently improves agentic RAG performance across multiple benchmarks. Specific models and improvement margins not detailed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Columbia University.

recommendation.zh: RAG错误纠正方向的方法改进，去掉了显式错误分类这一步。属于应用层方法，对预训练研究无直接启发，glance即可。
recommendation.en: A methodological improvement in RAG error correction that removes explicit error categorization. Application-layer work with no direct pretraining implications; glance suffices.

paper.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation
paper.abstract: Block attention, which processes the input as separate blocks that cannot attend to one another, offers significant potential to improve KV cache reuse in long-context scenarios such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, its broader application is hindered by two key challenges: the difficulty of segmenting input text into meaningful, self-contained blocks, and the inefficiency of existing block fine-tuning methods that risk degrading performance. To address these, we first construct

summary.core_problem: 解决 block attention 难以泛化到真实长上下文输入的问题：块边界难自动确定，直接微调又低效且容易损伤模型能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文推理效率方法和训练框架：把 block attention 从依赖人工分块或任务特定分块，推进到自动语义分割加教师蒸馏的通用流程，目标是提升 RAG 等场景的 KV cache 复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SemanticSeg，包含 3 万多个样本、16 类文本、长度 2k 到 32k，覆盖书籍、代码、网页和对话；用该数据训练轻量 segmenter 自动切分语义自洽块，并提出 block distillation，用冻结的 full-attention teacher 指导 block-attention student，避免昂贵且不稳定的 block fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和覆盖范围，但未完整展示模型参数、baseline 和具体提升；核心实验应围绕自动分块质量、block distillation 相比 block fine-tuning 的效率与性能保持，以及长上下文 KV cache 复用收益。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Chinese University of Hong Kong、City University of Hong Kong、Tencent、Singapore Management University、Renmin University of China 等；包含 Tencent 参与，方向与长上下文推理和 RAG 缓存复用相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the poor generalization of block attention in realistic long-context inputs, where block boundaries are hard to choose automatically and direct fine-tuning is inefficient and performance-damaging.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-context inference-efficiency method and training framework. It moves block attention from manual or task-specific segmentation toward automatic semantic segmentation plus teacher distillation, targeting KV-cache reuse in RAG-like workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces SemanticSeg, a dataset with over 30K examples across 16 categories and 2K–32K token lengths, covering books, code, web text, and conversations. A lightweight segmenter predicts semantically self-contained blocks, while block distillation uses a frozen full-attention teacher to train a block-attention student instead of relying on costly block fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the dataset scale and coverage but not detailed model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The key experiments should test segmentation quality, efficiency and capability retention versus block fine-tuning, and KV-cache reuse benefits in long-context settings.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include The Chinese University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong, Tencent, Singapore Management University, and Renmin University of China. Tencent is involved, and the work targets long-context inference and RAG cache reuse.

recommendation.zh: 只看分块数据构造和 distillation ablation；若性能不掉，这会改变 block attention 只能做工程特例的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the segmentation dataset and distillation ablations; if capability holds, it weakens the prior that block attention is only a narrow engineering trick.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Thinking Ahead: Prospection-Guided Retrieval of Memory with Language Models
paper.abstract: Long-horizon personalization requires dialogue assistants to retrieve user-specific facts from extended interaction histories. In practice, many relevant facts often have low semanticsimilarity to the query under dense retrieval. Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG systems are still largely retrospective: they rely on embedding similarity to the query or on fixed graph traversals, so they often miss facts that matter for the user's needs but lie far from the query in embed

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG、GraphRAG等检索系统均为回溯式设计，依赖查询与记忆的嵌入相似度或预构建的图遍历规则，无法召回与查询语义相似度低但对用户未来需求至关重要的潜在记忆，成为长周期个性化交互的核心瓶颈。
summary.importance: 打破了传统检索范式中存储结构与检索策略的强耦合，首次将认知科学中的前瞻模拟机制引入大模型记忆检索，为长周期智能体记忆系统设计提供了全新范式；配套的MemoryQuest基准填补了长周期跨域潜在记忆检索评测的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出前瞻引导检索（PGR），是独立于底层存储介质的检索策略，可与向量库、实体图、事件日志等任意存储结构兼容。核心为迭代的模拟-检索-优化循环：收到用户查询后，先用思维树或线性链模拟多个未来可能的任务轨迹，每个模拟步骤触发对应相关记忆的召回，再用召回的记忆修正模拟轨迹，直到覆盖所有潜在需求。与现有方法的核心区别是完全脱离存储结构限制，无需预构建索引或边关系，通过实时前瞻推理挖掘记忆间的潜在关联。
summary.experiments: 构建了MemoryQuest多会话基准，包含时间线一致、跨域分布、与查询语义相似度低的3~5条关联记忆的查询任务，专门针对回溯式检索的瓶颈。在1500+查询、3个基准上的实验显示，PGR的检索召回率和响应质量显著优于标准RAG、GraphRAG等基线，人工评测与大模型评测的结果对齐度高。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第1章引言中的前瞻机制原理和检索解耦核心逻辑、第2章的PGR迭代循环设计、第4章的MemoryQuest基准构造规则、第5章的消融实验（对比不同模拟策略、不同存储介质下的性能差异）。值得深挖的方向包括前瞻模拟的token开销优化、与预训练阶段记忆能力的结合方式、降低推理延迟适配实时交互的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing retrieval systems including standard RAG and GraphRAG follow a retrospective paradigm, relying on embedding similarity between queries and memories or pre-defined graph traversal rules. They fail to retrieve latent memories with low semantic similarity to the query but critical for users' future needs, which forms a core bottleneck for long-horizon personalized interactions.
summary_en.importance: PGR breaks the tight coupling between storage structure and retrieval strategy in traditional retrieval paradigms. It introduces the prospection mechanism from cognitive science into LLM memory retrieval for the first time, providing a new paradigm for long-horizon agent memory system design. The accompanying MemoryQuest benchmark fills the gap in evaluating cross-domain latent memory retrieval for long-term interactions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prospection-Guided Retrieval (PGR) is a retrieval policy independent of underlying storage media, compatible with vector stores, entity graphs, and episodic logs. Its core is an iterative Simulate-Retrieve-Refine loop: after receiving a user query, it first simulates multiple possible future task trajectories via Tree-of-Thought or linear chains, triggers retrieval of relevant memories at each simulated step, then revises the simulation trajectory with retrieved memories until all potential needs are covered. Unlike existing methods, it does not rely on pre-built indexes or edge relations, and mines latent associations between memories via real-time prospective reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The MemoryQuest multi-session benchmark is constructed, with queries that require retrieving 3~5 cross-domain associated memories with low semantic similarity to the query and consistent chronological dependencies, targeting the bottleneck of retrospective retrieval. Experiments on over 1500 queries across 3 benchmarks show that PGR significantly outperforms baselines including standard RAG and GraphRAG on retrieval recall and response quality. Results from human evaluation and LLM-as-a-judge are highly aligned.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the prospection mechanism and core logic of retrieval decoupling in Chapter 1, the design of the PGR iterative loop in Chapter 2, the construction rules of the MemoryQuest benchmark in Chapter 4, and ablation experiments in Chapter 5 (comparing performance under different simulation strategies and storage media). Points worth further exploration include token overhead optimization for prospective simulation, integration with memory capabilities during pre-training, and reduction of inference latency for real-time interaction scenarios.

recommendation.zh: MSR 的 RAG 记忆检索小方法；只看 ToT probe 构造和失败案例，别把它当长期记忆范式改写。
recommendation.en: A compact MSR memory-retrieval idea; read the ToT-probe construction and failure cases, but do not overread it as a new long-term-memory paradigm.

paper.title: Does RAG Know When Retrieval Is Wrong? Diagnosing Context Compliance under Knowledge Conflict
paper.abstract: The Context-Compliance Regime in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) occurs when retrieved context dominates   the final answer even when it conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge. Accuracy alone does not reveal   how retrieved context causally shapes answers under such conflict. We introduce Context-Driven Decomposition   (CDD), a belief-decomposition probe that operates at inference time and serves as an intervention mechanism for   controlled retrieval conflict. Across Epi-Scale str

summary.core_problem: 研究 RAG 在检索上下文与模型参数知识冲突时，模型是否会盲从错误检索内容，以及这种“context compliance”如何被测量。
summary.importance: 价值主要在诊断方法和评测设定，而不是新训练范式。它把 RAG 失败从单纯 accuracy 问题拆成因果归因问题，对后训练和 agent 系统的鲁棒性分析有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Context-Driven Decomposition（CDD），一种推理时 belief decomposition probe，同时也是受控干预机制。核心做法是在知识冲突场景下分解答案受上下文驱动的程度，并构造上界式对抗检索压力测试，观察模型在错误检索注入下的服从模式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Epi-Scale stress tests、TruthfulQA misconception injection 和跨模型复现。摘要给出的关键结果是：标准 RAG 在 TruthfulQA 错误知识注入上仅 15.0% 准确率；CDD 在 mistake-injection 检测/纠错设定上达到 64.1%，且提升可迁移到 Gemini-2.5-Flash 与 Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus，但 rationale-answer 的因果耦合不稳定。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia Tech、CMU、UC San Diego。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether RAG systems can tell when retrieved context is wrong, especially when it conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is diagnostic rather than a new training paradigm. It reframes RAG failure from raw accuracy to causal dependence on retrieved context, which is useful for post-training and agent robustness analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Context-Driven Decomposition (CDD), an inference-time belief decomposition probe that also acts as a controlled intervention mechanism. The method measures how much the final answer is driven by conflicting retrieved context under adversarial retrieval setups.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span Epi-Scale stress tests, TruthfulQA misconception injection, and cross-model reruns. The abstract reports that standard RAG drops to 15.0% accuracy under misconception injection, while CDD reaches 64.1% on mistake-injection-related evaluation and transfers gains to Gemini-2.5-Flash and Claude Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, though rationale-answer causal coupling does not transfer cleanly.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia Tech, CMU, and UC San Diego.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但把“检索增强为何失效”测得比常见 RAG paper 干净；只看冲突设定和跨模型迁移结果，别把 probe 当成通用解法。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it measures why retrieval fails more cleanly than most RAG work; read the conflict setup and cross-model transfer, not as a universal fix.

paper.title: Scaling Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Parallel Search and Explicit Merging
paper.abstract: Deep search agents have proven effective in enhancing LLMs by retrieving external knowledge during multi-step reasoning. However, existing methods often generate a single query for retrieval at each reasoning step, limiting information coverage and introducing high noise. This may result in low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) during search, degrading reasoning accuracy and leading to unnecessary reasoning steps. In this paper, we introduce MultiSearch, an RL-based framework that addresses these lim

summary.core_problem: 现有深度搜索Agent在推理过程中每个步骤仅生成单个检索查询，存在检索信噪比低、信息覆盖不足的问题；同时基于最终结果的RL奖励无法对中间检索和信息整合行为提供有效监督，导致推理准确率下降或产生不必要的检索步骤。
summary.importance: 提出了多查询并行检索+显式信息合并的深度搜索范式，配合多过程细粒度RL奖励设计，为检索增强推理的训练提供了更精细的监督信号设计思路；验证了小参数模型通过检索增强和合理的RL训练可以在知识密集型任务上获得显著性能提升，为高效推理Agent的训练提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MultiSearch RL框架：1. 在每个推理步骤，从改写、概念扩展、问题分解多个视角生成多个并行检索查询，扩大相关信息覆盖范围，降低对单一查询的依赖；2. 增加显式合并步骤，从检索到的多个文档中提取并整合关键信息，提升中间推理上下文的信噪比；3. 设计多过程奖励，除最终答案正确性的结果奖励外，新增鼓励多查询检索的查询奖励、鼓励信息整合的合并奖励；4. 采用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）对异质奖励信号分别归一化后再聚合，避免不同量级奖励互相干扰。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen2.5-3B/7B Base和Instruct骨干训练模型，在7个QA基准上评测，包括3个单跳数据集和4个多跳数据集。实验结果：1. MultiSearch在所有基准上的平均性能优于现有ReAct风格的深度搜索基线；2. 训练过程中，Agent逐步学会生成更多检索查询并输出信噪比更高的合并信息，验证了过程奖励的引导作用；3. 消融实验表明，多查询检索、显式合并、对应的过程奖励分别对整体性能有独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章的奖励设计部分，理解多过程奖励的设计逻辑和GDPO的适配方式；检索和合并的机制设计可以快速浏览，核心创新在训练监督部分；预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing deep search agents generate only one retrieval query per reasoning step, leading to low retrieval SNR and insufficient information coverage. Meanwhile, RL rewards based solely on final outcomes cannot provide effective supervision for intermediate retrieval and information consolidation behaviors, resulting in degraded reasoning accuracy or unnecessary retrieval steps.
summary_en.importance: MultiSearch proposes a deep search paradigm of parallel multi-query retrieval plus explicit information merging, paired with a fine-grained multi-process RL reward design, providing a more refined supervision signal design思路 for retrieval-augmented reasoning training. It verifies that small parameter models can achieve significant performance improvements on knowledge-intensive tasks through retrieval augmentation and reasonable RL training, providing a reference for efficient reasoning agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MultiSearch RL framework is designed as follows: 1. At each reasoning step, multiple parallel retrieval queries are generated from perspectives of rephrasing, concept expansion, and question decomposition to expand relevant information coverage and reduce reliance on a single query; 2. An explicit merging step is added to extract and integrate key information from multiple retrieved documents, improving the SNR of the intermediate reasoning context; 3. A multi-process reward design includes a query reward to encourage multi-query retrieval and a merging reward to encourage information consolidation, in addition to the outcome reward for final answer correctness; 4. Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) is used to normalize heterogeneous reward signals separately before aggregation, avoiding interference between rewards of different magnitudes.
summary_en.experiments: Models are trained on Qwen2.5-3B/7B Base and Instruct backbones, and evaluated on 7 QA benchmarks, including 3 single-hop datasets and 4 multi-hop datasets. Results: 1. MultiSearch achieves better average performance than existing ReAct-style deep search baselines across all benchmarks; 2. During training, the agent gradually learns to generate more retrieval queries and produce merged information with higher SNR, verifying the guiding effect of process rewards; 3. Ablation studies show that multi-query retrieval, explicit merging, and corresponding process rewards each contribute independently to overall performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the reward design section in Chapter 2 to understand the logic of multi-process reward design and the adaptation of GDPO. The mechanism design of retrieval and merging can be skimmed, as the core innovation lies in the training supervision part. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 merge 设计和 RL reward；多 query 本身不新，关键是它是否真的提高证据信噪比而非堆 context。
recommendation.en: Read the merge design and RL reward; multi-query retrieval is not new, the real question is whether SNR improves rather than just adding context.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models
paper.abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models. We show it also helps small embedding models. Most modern embedding checkpoints are distilled from large LLM backbones and inherit their representation space; a frozen embedding model should therefore benefit from extra inference compute without retraining. Using an agentic program-search loop, we explore 259 candidate inference programs over a frozen embedding API across ninety generations. The entire Pareto frontier c

summary.core_problem: 现有认知认为测试时计算仅对大推理模型有效，小稠密检索嵌入模型无法受益，且现有检索侧测试时优化需要额外辅助模型或新增参数，无法在纯冻结单向量嵌入模型上实现无额外成本的性能提升。
summary.importance: 验证了嵌入模型继承自LLM的表示空间具备测试时计算优化潜力，无需重训或新增参数即可提升检索性能，为冻结嵌入模型部署的性能优化提供了无额外开销的方案，也为小模型的测试时算力利用提供新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了由LLM提案器、评估框架、经验账本组成的智能体程序搜索循环，在冻结嵌入模型API的操作空间内搜索可行的推理程序，探索了90代共259个候选程序，最终得到无参数的最优代数形式：查询嵌入与Top-K召回文档的softmax加权质心插值。
summary.experiments: 在7个不同参数量级（跨度10倍）的嵌入模型家族、全BEIR验证集上，该无参数方案的nDCG@10均实现统计显著提升，所有帕累托最优解都收敛到该统一代数形式。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第4章的搜索结果结构分析、第5章的跨模型验证实验，附录的基线复现结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。
summary.authors_note: 代码仓库关联hanxiao的GitHub账号，机构未明确公开。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing perception holds that test-time compute only benefits large reasoning models, and test-time optimization for dense retrieval requires auxiliary models or additional parameters, leaving no way to improve performance on frozen single-vector embedding models without retraining.
summary_en.importance: It verifies that embedding models inherit test-time compute potential from their LLM backbone representation space, providing a zero-overhead scheme to improve retrieval performance for deployed frozen embedding models, and opens a new direction for test-time compute utilization for small models.
summary_en.technical_approach: An agentic program search loop consisting of an LLM proposer, evaluation harness, and lesson ledger is designed to explore feasible inference programs within the operation space of the frozen embedding model API. 90 generations of search cover 259 candidate programs, and the optimal parameter-free algebraic form is derived: interpolation between query embedding and softmax-weighted centroid of top-K retrieved documents.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 embedding model families with 10x parameter range and full held-out BEIR validation set, the parameter-free scheme achieves statistically significant improvement on nDCG@10, and all Pareto optimal solutions converge to this unified algebraic form.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 4 for search output structure analysis, Section 5 for cross-model validation experiments, and baseline reproduction results in the appendix. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Code repository is associated with hanxiao's GitHub account, institution not explicitly disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 BEIR 表；若结论稳，内部检索/去重 embedding pipeline 可以直接做这类 query refinement 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the method and BEIR tables; if stable, this is an easy ablation for internal retrieval and dedup embedding pipelines.

paper.title: Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?
paper.abstract: Large language models have demonstrated impressive retrieval-augmented capabilities. However, a crucial area remains underexplored: their ability to appropriately adapt responses to the certainty of the retrieved information. It is a limitation with real consequences in high-stakes domains like medicine and finance. We evaluate eight LLMs on their context-certainty obedience, measuring how well they adjust responses to match expressed context certainty. Our analysis reveals systematic limitation

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 LLM 在 RAG 场景中是否能按检索信息的外部置信度调整回答，而不是看到上下文后就过度相信它。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但对训练目标和评测设计有启发。当前 LLM 往往会把上下文当成强证据，即使上下文被明确标注为低置信度。这个现象说明，模型在预训练和指令训练中学到的是“利用上下文”，但不一定学到“按概率权重使用上下文”。对后续的 pretrain/posttrain 数据设计来说，这提示需要显式训练模型处理外部校准概率、冲突知识和低置信检索证据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 context-certainty obedience，用一个概率混合目标定义理想行为。给定问题、检索上下文和置信度 c，理想输出分布应当介于两端：c=0 时回到模型无上下文的 prior response，c=1 时严格遵循上下文；中间置信度则按 c 在 prior distribution 和 context-conditioned distribution 之间插值。这个定义把问题从“答案是否正确”转成“模型是否服从外部置信度”。论文进一步分析三类失败：模型看到上下文后很难恢复原先的 prior；会误读概率表达；面对长而复杂的上下文时，即使置信度低也更容易过信。修复方案不改模型参数，而是一个交互策略：先提醒模型无上下文时的回答，再把置信度表达重标定成模型更容易理解的形式，最后简化上下文。
summary.experiments: 实验在 ClashEval 上评估 8 个 LLM，覆盖 Llama、Qwen、Gemma 的不同尺寸版本。主要指标是 context-certainty obedience error。原始提示下，模型平均错误为 0.52；加入三步交互策略后降到 0.39，约 25% 相对下降。定性和分解分析显示，低置信上下文尤其困难，因为模型会被已经看到的上下文锚定；复杂上下文会放大这种锚定；概率数字本身也不能保证模型按线性权重理解不确定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 evaluation framework，尤其是如何用 prior distribution 与 context-based distribution 的线性混合定义理想输出。然后看 error 分解和三步交互策略的消融。若关注预训练，可重点思考两点：第一，训练语料中是否缺少带显式置信度的冲突上下文；第二，SFT/RL 是否把“引用上下文”过度奖励成了默认行为。具体 RAG 应用场景可以略读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs can use retrieved evidence according to an externally supplied certainty score, instead of treating any provided context as authoritative.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation and prompting paper rather than a pretraining method paper, but it exposes a training-relevant weakness. Modern LLMs are trained and post-trained to exploit context, yet they are not reliably trained to weight context by calibrated probabilities. For pretraining and post-training research, the result points to a missing capability: models need to learn how to condition on explicit uncertainty, resolve conflicts between parametric knowledge and retrieved evidence, and ignore low-certainty context when appropriate.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formalize context-certainty obedience through a probabilistic mixture target. Given a retrieved context with certainty c, the ideal model behavior should interpolate between two distributions: the prior answer distribution without context and the context-following distribution. At c=0, the model should ignore the context; at c=1, it should follow it. This avoids evaluating only answer accuracy and instead measures whether the model obeys the external certainty signal. The paper identifies three failure modes: poor recall of the pre-context prior after seeing uncertain evidence, distorted interpretation of probability expressions, and overtrust in long or complex contexts. The proposed intervention is parameter-free: remind the model of its prior response, recalibrate the certainty wording, and simplify the retrieved context.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses ClashEval and eight LLMs from families including Llama, Qwen, and Gemma, with different model sizes. The proposed interaction strategy reduces the average context-certainty obedience error from 0.52 to 0.39, a 25% relative reduction. The analysis shows that low-certainty contexts are particularly hard because the model remains anchored to the observed evidence. Long and complex passages increase overtrust, and numeric certainty statements are not interpreted as clean linear probabilities by default.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the evaluation framework carefully, especially the definition of the ideal mixture between prior and context-conditioned behavior. Then inspect the failure-mode analysis and the ablation of the three interaction steps. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful question is how to create training mixtures with explicit certainty annotations, conflicting retrieved evidence, and rewards that do not always favor context adherence. Domain-specific RAG examples can be skimmed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是训法论文，但把 RAG 失败拆成“确定性服从错误”很干净；只看评测定义和 25% 降错的交互干预就够，适合反推 post-train 数据设计。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but the decomposition of RAG failure into certainty-obedience errors is clean; read the evaluation setup and the 25% error reduction intervention, then map it back to post-training data design.

paper.title: Superintelligent Retrieval Agent: The Next Frontier of Information Retrieval
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented agents are increasingly the interface to large organizational knowledge bases, yet most still treat retrieval as a black box: they issue exploratory queries, inspect returned snippets, and iteratively reformulate until useful evidence emerges. This approach resembles how a newcomer searches an unfamiliar database rather than how an expert navigates it with strong priors about terminology and likely evidence, and results in unnecessary retrieval rounds, increased latency, and

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 RAG agent 的检索接口问题：现有 agent 往往把检索器当作黑盒，通过多轮查询、阅读片段、再改写查询来逼近答案。这种流程把很多信息发现工作放在交互过程中，导致检索轮数多、延迟高，也容易漏掉真正有区分度的证据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 LLM 作为检索控制器的设计有启发。重点不在训练一个新基座模型，而在说明：当 LLM 接外部知识库时，检索能力不只取决于语义相似度，也取决于能否利用语料级统计信号，例如稀有术语、约束词、排除条件和字段结构。这个角度对 RAG 数据构造、agentic search 训练信号、以及 retrieval-aware post-training 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SIRA 的核心思路是把多轮探索压缩成一次“语料判别性”的检索动作。它不是只问哪些词与用户问题语义相关，而是问哪些词能让目标证据在当前语料库中排在干扰文档前面。方法倾向于重新利用 BM25 这类可控、可解释的词项检索：LLM 负责提出稀有且有区分度的关键词、约束、拆解子查询和可能的排除条件；BM25/词项统计负责把这些词映射到可审计的排序信号。与纯 dense retrieval 相比，这种设计牺牲了一部分端到端语义匹配的便利性，但换来更强的可控性：agent 可以显式调整关键词、强化必须匹配的概念、避免高频泛词，并利用 IDF 让领域术语发挥作用。
summary.experiments: 从给出的正文内容看，实验细节和具体数值不足以完整判断。引言主要建立问题设定：多轮 ReAct/IRCoT 类检索 agent 依赖检索上下文积累，dense retrieval 的单向量表示对组合约束和排除条件支持弱，BM25 的 IDF 和可解释性更适合让 LLM 进行可控检索。泛读时需要确认实验是否真正比较了单次 SIRA 检索与多轮 agentic retrieval，在召回率、检索轮数、延迟和证据覆盖上的差异；也需要看它是否在不同语料库和复杂约束查询上稳定成立。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分如何定义“corpus-discriminative retrieval action”，以及 LLM 到 BM25 查询/约束的具体生成格式。实验部分重点看三点：是否有强 BM25、dense retriever、hybrid retriever、多轮 ReAct/IRCoT 的公平对照；是否报告检索轮数和延迟，而不只报告最终 QA 分数；失败案例是否来自 LLM 生成错误术语、语料术语不匹配，还是 BM25 无法覆盖语义改写。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a retrieval-interface bottleneck in RAG agents. Most agents treat retrieval as a black box: they issue a query, inspect snippets, and repeat. This makes the agent learn the corpus through interaction, which increases latency and still leaves recall fragile when the useful evidence requires rare terminology or explicit constraints.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to retrieval-aware LLM systems. The useful point is the shift from semantic relevance to corpus discrimination. For an LLM-controlled retriever, the key question is not only which terms are related to the user request, but which terms make the desired evidence outrank plausible distractors in the target index. This matters for RAG data design, search-agent training signals, and post-training setups where the model must learn how to control retrieval tools rather than merely call them.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIRA aims to compress multi-round exploratory search into one discriminative retrieval action. The method leans on classical lexical retrieval, especially BM25-style signals, because they expose controllable primitives: keyword boosting, hard constraints, exclusions, decomposition, and IDF-driven rare-term weighting. The LLM supplies expert vocabulary and constraints; the lexical retriever turns them into transparent ranking behavior. Compared with dense retrieval, this gives up some convenience of single-vector semantic matching, but provides better handles for compositional requests and auditability.
summary_en.experiments: The available text mainly covers the motivation and system framing, not enough concrete experimental numbers to assess the empirical strength. The key claims to verify in the experimental sections are whether one-shot SIRA improves recall or answer accuracy over dense, BM25, hybrid, and multi-round agentic baselines; whether it reduces retrieval calls and latency; and whether gains hold for long, constrained, or jargon-heavy queries rather than only for hand-picked examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the formal definition of a corpus-discriminative retrieval action, the prompt or policy used to generate BM25 queries and constraints, and the baseline setup. The most important empirical details are retrieval-call budget, latency accounting, recall at fixed depth, and failure analysis. The paper is less useful if the evaluation only reports final QA accuracy without isolating retrieval quality.

recommendation.zh: 读方法定义和实验表就够了；它对 RAG policy 有味道，但离预训练信号质量还有一层。
recommendation.en: Read the method definition and results table; the RAG-policy idea is clean, but it is still one step away from pretraining signal quality.

institutions: click standard result links substantially less often (Pew Research Center
pipelines rather than as controllable components of an agent policy

paper.title: Architecture Matters: Comparing RAG Systems under Knowledge Base Poisoning
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to knowledge base poisoning, yet existing attacks have been evaluated almost exclusively against vanilla retrieve-then-generate pipelines. Architectures designed to handle conflicting retrieved information - multi-agent debate, agentic retrieval, recursive language models - remain untested against adversarially optimized contradictions. We evaluate four RAG architectures (vanilla RAG, agentic RAG, MADAM-RAG, and Recursive Language Model

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG知识库投毒攻击评估大多仅针对基础检索-生成pipeline，而专门设计用于处理检索内容冲突的RAG架构从未经过对抗优化的矛盾内容测试，其在真实单文档投毒场景下的鲁棒性未得到验证。
summary.importance: 量化了不同RAG架构在对抗投毒场景下的鲁棒性差异，为RAG系统的安全性设计提供了实证依据，也为后续RAG架构的优化方向提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在N=1单文档投毒场景下（仅注入1份对抗文档，其余为合法来源文档，避免检索上下文被投毒文档主导的极端场景），对比4种端到端RAG架构：基础RAG、智能检索RAG、MADAM-RAG、递归语言模型（RLM），测试三种场景：干净基线、朴素注入、CorruptRAG-AK对抗攻击，除了标准准确率和攻击成功率，还通过LLM judge将回复分为7类行为，分析系统的矛盾检测、回避、错误采纳等行为。
summary.experiments: 4种架构在干净数据集上准确率均约92%，在CorruptRAG-AK攻击下，攻击成功率从基础RAG的81.9%到RLM的24.4%，差异接近58个百分点；MADAM-RAG的矛盾检测率最高，但无法可靠解决检测到的冲突，干净数据集上非回答率达41.4%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第3章实验设置和第4章结果分析部分，预计阅读时间20分钟，重点关注不同架构的鲁棒性差异和攻击成功率的分解结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing knowledge base poisoning evaluations for RAG systems are mostly conducted on vanilla retrieve-then-generate pipelines, while RAG architectures specifically designed for handling conflicting retrieved content have never been tested against adversarially optimized contradictions, leaving their robustness under realistic single-document poisoning scenarios unvalidated.
summary_en.importance: Quantifies the robustness gap of different RAG architectures under adversarial poisoning scenarios, provides empirical evidence for security design of RAG systems, and offers reference for optimization direction of future RAG architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under N=1 single-document poisoning setting (only 1 adversarial document is injected, coexisting with legitimate sources to avoid extreme scenarios where retrieval context is dominated by poisoned documents), compare 4 end-to-end RAG architectures: vanilla RAG, agentic RAG, MADAM-RAG, Recursive Language Models (RLM). Test three conditions: clean baseline, naive injection, CorruptRAG-AK adversarial attack. Besides standard accuracy and attack success rate, classify responses into 7 behavioral categories via LLM judge to analyze contradiction detection, hedging, incorrect adoption and other behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: All 4 architectures achieve ~92% accuracy on clean dataset. Under CorruptRAG-AK attack, attack success rate ranges from 81.9% (vanilla RAG) to 24.4% (RLM), with a gap of nearly 58 percentage points. MADAM-RAG has the highest contradiction detection rate, but cannot reliably resolve detected conflicts in favor of correct information, with a 41.4% non-answer rate even on clean inputs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: focus on Chapter 3 (experimental setup) and Chapter 4 (result analysis). Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Pay attention to the robustness difference across architectures and decomposition results of attack success rate contributors.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表即可：同等 clean accuracy 下 ASR 差 58 点，说明 RAG 鲁棒性不能只靠模型能力外推。
recommendation.en: Read the result table: a 58-point ASR gap at similar clean accuracy shows RAG robustness cannot be inferred from model capability alone.

paper.title: LeakDojo: Decoding the Leakage Threats of RAG Systems
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables large language models (LLMs) to leverage external knowledge, but also exposes valuable RAG databases to leakage attacks. As RAG systems grow more complex and LLMs exhibit stronger instruction-following capabilities, existing studies fall short of systematically assessing RAG leakage risks. We present LeakDojo, a configurable framework for controlled evaluation of RAG leakage. Using LeakDojo, we benchmark six existing attacks across fourteen LLMs, four

summary.core_problem: 现有RAG系统泄露风险评估缺乏系统化框架，无法分析复杂RAG架构、大模型能力、攻击策略三者对泄露风险的联合影响，无法适配当前带重排、改写、摘要等增强模块的现代RAG系统。
summary.importance: 提出了可配置的RAG泄露风险评测框架，揭示了RAG泄露的核心机制，为RAG系统的安全设计提供了可落地的参考，也为后续RAG攻击和防御研究提供了统一评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 构建模块化的LeakDojo评测框架，将RAG系统、攻击方法、防御策略拆分为独立可配置的组件，支持隔离分析各组件对泄露风险的贡献。
summary.experiments: 覆盖6种主流攻击、14款大模型、4个数据集、多种带增强模块的RAG架构，得到三个核心结论：1）查询生成器和对抗指令对泄露的贡献相互独立，整体泄露率近似等于两者独立效果的乘积；2）大模型的指令遵循能力与泄露风险正相关，皮尔逊相关系数为0.578，p值0.039；3）RAG的生成忠实度和泄露安全存在固有 trade-off，提升忠实度的模块通常会同时提升泄露风险。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第4章泄露机制分析的实验结果、第3章LeakDojo的框架设计，跳过具体的攻击实现细节，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing evaluation methods for RAG system leakage risks lack a systematic framework, cannot analyze the joint impact of complex RAG architectures, LLM capabilities, and attack strategies on leakage risks, and cannot adapt to modern RAG systems with enhancement modules such as reranker, rewriter, and summarizer.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a configurable evaluation framework for RAG leakage risks, reveals the core mechanism of RAG leakage, provides practical reference for the security design of RAG systems, and also provides a unified evaluation benchmark for subsequent research on RAG attacks and defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The modular LeakDojo evaluation framework is built, which decomposes RAG systems, attack methods, and defense strategies into independently configurable components, supporting isolated analysis of the contribution of each component to leakage risk.
summary_en.experiments: Covering 6 mainstream attacks, 14 LLMs, 4 datasets, and multiple RAG architectures with enhancement modules, three core conclusions are obtained: 1) The contributions of the query generator and adversarial instruction to leakage are independent, and the overall leakage rate is approximately equal to the product of their independent effects; 2) The instruction-following capability of LLMs is positively correlated with leakage risk, with Pearson correlation coefficient 0.578 and p-value 0.039; 3) There is an inherent trade-off between RAG generation faithfulness and leakage security, and modules that improve faithfulness usually increase leakage risk at the same time.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental results of leakage mechanism analysis in Chapter 4 and the framework design of LeakDojo in Chapter 3, skip the specific implementation details of attacks, expected reading time 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验发现即可；faithfulness 与泄漏同向这点会影响 RAG 后训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and findings; the faithfulness-leakage coupling is the part that should affect RAG post-training objectives.

paper.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
paper.abstract: Modern retrieval systems, whether lexical or semantic, expose a corpus through a fixed similarity interface that compresses access into a single top-k retrieval step before reasoning. This abstraction is efficient, but for agentic search, it becomes a bottleneck: exact lexical constraints, sparse clue conjunctions, local context checks, and multi-step hypothesis refinement are difficult to implement by calling a conventional off-the-shelf retriever, and evidence filtered out early cannot be reco

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论的是 agentic search 里的 retrieval interface 设计，而不是传统意义上的检索模型优化：固定 top-k 语义检索接口会过早压缩证据空间，限制 agent 做精确匹配、局部验证和多步假设修正。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接影响有限，但对“模型能力如何与外部信息接口匹配”有启发。它提醒人注意：当模型推理和工具使用能力变强后，瓶颈可能不在 reasoning，而在检索接口分辨率过低。这个观察对 RAG、tool use、agent training 有价值，不过更偏系统与 agent 设计，不属于基座预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 DCI（Direct Corpus Interaction），让 agent 不通过 embedding retriever 或向量索引访问语料，而是直接用终端工具与原始语料交互，例如 grep、find、head、sed、简单脚本和文件读取。核心思想是把“检索”从一次 top-k 候选召回，改成一组可组合、可迭代、可局部验证的低层操作。这样 agent 可以自己执行精确词约束、弱线索拼接、局部上下文检查和逐步修正搜索计划。论文还提出 retrieval interface resolution 这个概念，用来描述接口能否在比文档/段落更细的粒度上操作证据。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 BrowseComp-Plus、多跳 QA 和 IR ranking。最显眼的结果是，在相同 Claude Sonnet 4.6 backbone 下，把 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 检索工具替换成 DCI，BrowseComp-Plus 准确率从 69.0% 提到 80.0%，同时成本从 1440 美元降到 1016 美元。多跳 QA 上，结合 Claude Code 的 DCI 平均准确率达到 83.0%，比文中最强 retrieval-agent baseline 高 30.7 个点。IR ranking 上，平均 NDCG@10 达到 68.5%，比最佳检索基线高 21.5 个点。作者还做了轨迹分析，指出收益不主要来自召回更多 gold 文档，而是来自更细粒度的局部搜索和证据验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看引言、方法概念图和 BrowseComp-Plus 主结果表，再看 trajectory analysis。重点不是具体 bash 工具，而是作者对 retrieval bottleneck 的重新定义：问题出在接口把证据压缩得太早。若只想判断是否值得跟进，30 到 40 分钟足够。若关心 agent tool-use 训练，可再看 ablation，尤其是受限工具集、上下文管理和语料规模实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that the main bottleneck in agentic search is often not the reasoning model itself but the retrieval interface: a fixed top-k lexical or semantic retriever compresses corpus access too early and makes exact matching, local verification, and iterative hypothesis refinement unnecessarily hard.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect. The main value is conceptual: once models become capable enough to search strategically, the interface to external knowledge can become the limiting factor. That is useful for thinking about RAG, tool use, and agent training, but it is not a core foundation-model pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is DCI, or Direct Corpus Interaction. Instead of querying a dense retriever or vector index, the agent interacts with the raw corpus through general terminal tools such as grep, find, file reads, head, sed, and lightweight scripts. The key idea is to replace one-shot top-k retrieval with a composable set of low-level operations that the agent can chain together. This allows exact lexical constraints, conjunction of weak clues, local context inspection, and iterative search-plan revision. The paper also introduces the notion of retrieval interface resolution, meaning how finely the interface lets the agent operate on evidence beyond document- or passage-level retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluations cover BrowseComp-Plus, multi-hop QA, and IR ranking. On BrowseComp-Plus, replacing Qwen3-Embedding-8B retrieval with DCI under the same Claude Sonnet 4.6 backbone improves accuracy from 69.0% to 80.0% while reducing cost from $1,440 to $1,016. On multi-hop QA, DCI combined with Claude Code reaches 83.0 average accuracy, outperforming the strongest retrieval-agent baseline in the paper by 30.7 points. On IR ranking, it achieves 68.5 average NDCG@10, beating the best retrieval baseline by 21.5 points. The trajectory analyses are especially informative: the gains do not mainly come from surfacing more gold documents, but from turning surfaced evidence into finer-grained local search and verification steps.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction, the method overview, and the main BrowseComp-Plus result table first. Then look at the trajectory analysis. The important idea is not the specific shell tools but the reframing of retrieval failure: evidence is often lost because the interface is too coarse. If the goal is just to assess relevance, 30 to 40 minutes is enough. If you care about agent tool-use training, the ablations on restricted tool profiles, context management, and corpus scale are the next sections to read.

recommendation.zh: 仅看方法部分对检索范式的设计即可，可作为内部Agent检索模块ablation参考，无预训练直接相关创新
recommendation.en: Only read the method section for retrieval paradigm design, can be used as reference for internal Agent retrieval module ablation, no direct pretrain-related innovation

paper.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats retrieval and generation as separate systems. We ask whether an attention-based encoder-decoder can instead retrieve directly from its own internal representations. We introduce INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention), a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation. By construction, INTRA unifies retrieval and generation, eliminating the retriever-generat

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 RAG 中检索器和生成器分离带来的表示错配与重复编码成本：外部 retriever 用一套表示选择证据，generator 再把选中的文本重新消费。作者问的是，encoder-decoder 模型能否直接用自身 attention 表示完成证据检索，并把同一份 encoded evidence 用于生成。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对架构和统一检索-生成接口有启发。它强调 attention 的 query-conditioned matching 可以作为检索接口，而不一定要把 retrieval 做成外部系统。这个方向对长上下文、记忆增强模型、encoder-decoder 预训练目标有参考价值：如果 evidence chunk 的 encoder states 可以被预计算并跨 query 复用，那么检索与生成之间的表示边界会变薄，系统也可能减少“检索分数高但生成器不用”的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 INTRA，核心是用同一个 pretrained encoder-decoder 的表示空间同时做 evidence selection 和 answer generation。每个 corpus chunk 先由 encoder 编成 token-level states，并作为可复用的 evidence memory。检索阶段不引入独立 retriever，而是在 decoder 输入中加入 R 个可训练 retrieval tokens，使 decoder cross-attention 产生 query-side retrieval states。然后用类似 ColBERT 的 late interaction，把 decoder query states 与每个 chunk 的 encoder token states 做 token-level matching，再聚合成 chunk-level retrieval score。被选中的 encoded chunks 不需要还原成文本再重新编码，而是直接作为 decoder cross-attention memory 参与生成。这个设计的关键取舍是：它不是要替代大规模语料库上的工业检索系统，而是在固定知识库和多跳 QA 这类设置中减少 retriever-generator mismatch，并摊销静态 evidence 的编码开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在问答任务上评估 evidence recall 和 end-to-end answer quality，重点强调多跳 QA 场景。根据正文描述，INTRA 在证据召回和最终回答质量上优于强工程化 retrieval pipelines，并且这些 pipelines 通常依赖大规模训练数据或独立检索模块。实验还分析了 reusable-context regime：静态 evidence 只需编码一次，后续 query 复用 encoder states，因此计算开销从反复长上下文编码转向检索 query 与预编码 memory 的匹配。当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，因此不应把性能幅度外推到更大开放语料检索场景。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Method 中 encoder chunk states、decoder retrieval tokens、cross-attention query 暴露方式，以及 ColBERT-style late interaction 如何从 token-level attention/matching 得到 chunk score。实验部分优先看多跳 QA 的 evidence recall、answer quality 对比，以及计算分析中“预编码 evidence 跨 query 复用”的成本模型。若关注预训练，可以重点思考这种接口是否需要在预训练阶段加入 retrieval-token 或 memory-selection 目标，而不是只在下游 QA 上适配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the separation between retrieval and generation in standard RAG. External retrievers select evidence in one representation space, while the generator consumes the selected text in another pass. The question is whether a pretrained encoder-decoder can retrieve from its own encoded evidence states and then reuse those same states for generation.
summary_en.importance: The direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but the architectural signal is useful. INTRA treats attention as a query-conditioned retrieval interface rather than only as an internal computation inside generation. This matters for memory-augmented models, long-context alternatives, and encoder-decoder pretraining: if static evidence can be encoded once and reused across queries, the boundary between retrieval and generation becomes less rigid, and the retriever-generator mismatch can be reduced.
summary_en.technical_approach: INTRA uses a single pretrained encoder-decoder representation space for both evidence selection and answer generation. Corpus chunks are encoded into token-level encoder states and stored as reusable memories. At retrieval time, the decoder input is augmented with R trainable retrieval tokens, exposing decoder-side query states through cross-attention. A ColBERT-style late-interaction scoring function compares these query states against the token states of each encoded chunk and aggregates the matches into chunk-level retrieval scores. The selected encoded chunks are then fed directly as decoder cross-attention memory for generation, without converting them back into raw text and re-encoding them. The design is not framed as a full replacement for large-scale industrial retrieval; it is better understood as a unified retrieval-generation interface for fixed evidence collections, especially when evidence can be pre-encoded.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates question answering with evidence recall and end-to-end answer quality, with an emphasis on multi-hop QA. The reported results indicate that INTRA outperforms strong engineered retrieval pipelines on both evidence selection and final answer quality, despite those pipelines using separate retrievers and often larger-scale retrieval training. The paper also studies the computation profile of the reusable-context setting: static evidence is encoded once, and later queries operate over cached encoder states. The provided content does not include the full result tables or exact margins, so the claims should be read as evidence for this setting rather than as a general statement about open-corpus retrieval at web scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The key parts are the method definitions for encoded chunk memories, decoder-side retrieval tokens, exposed cross-attention query states, and the ColBERT-style late-interaction chunk scorer. In the experiments, prioritize the multi-hop QA evidence-recall and answer-quality comparisons, then inspect the compute analysis for the pre-encoded-evidence regime. For pretraining researchers, the main question to carry forward is whether retrieval tokens or memory-selection objectives should be introduced during pretraining instead of being added only during downstream adaptation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 retrieval 重新写成 attention memory access；若实验对比足够干净，这会影响你对 RAG 与原生记忆边界的判断，但先重点核查 baseline 是否公平。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it recasts retrieval as native attention-based memory access; if the comparisons are clean, it shifts how you think about the boundary between RAG and built-in memory, but audit the baselines first.

paper.title: AgenticRAG: Agentic Retrieval for Enterprise Knowledge Bases
paper.abstract: We present AgenticRAG, a practical agentic harness for retrieval and analysis over enterprise knowledge bases. Standard RAG pipelines place significant burden of grounding on the search stack, constraining the language model to a fixed candidate set chosen deep in the retrieval process. Our approach reduces this overdependence by layering a lightweight harness on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping a reasoning LLM with search, find, open, and summarize tools enabling the

summary.core_problem: 传统RAG采用静态的检索-生成范式，检索决策在推理开始前就已确定，LLM只能在预先选定的固定候选集内推理，无法处理需要多文档综合、迭代导航的复杂企业级信息查询需求。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于展示了推理侧工具编排与基座能力的配合边界：轻量工具 harness 无需模型微调即可大幅提升RAG性能，说明基座的规划与工具使用能力可以通过合理的系统设计释放，为预训练阶段的工具调用能力建模提供了目标参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在现有企业搜索基础设施之上构建轻量级智能体harness，为LLM配备4种工具：search（调用底层搜索栈进行全库文档发现，支持最多5次查询改写）、find（候选文档内精确检索）、open（候选文档全内容滚动窗口访问）、summarize（上下文超限触发，合并检索结果并保留引用）；实现有界迭代的智能体循环，自动维护对话状态、token计数和文档引用映射，支持多轮查询复用已检索内容，无需模型微调、自定义嵌入模型或图谱构建。
summary.experiments: 在三个公开基准上测试：BRIGHT基准recall@1达到49.6%，较最优嵌入基线提升21.8个百分点；WixQA基准事实性得分0.96，相对提升13%；FinanceBench基准答案正确率92%，与oracle访问的差距在2个百分点以内；完成工具贡献、多查询搜索效果、不同模型的检索策略差异的消融实验。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读方法章节的工具设计和迭代循环逻辑（第3节），其次实验部分的消融结果，总阅读时间约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional RAG adopts a static retrieve-then-generate paradigm, where retrieval decisions are finalized before reasoning starts. The LLM can only reason within a preselected fixed candidate set and cannot handle complex enterprise-level information query requirements that require multi-document synthesis and iterative navigation.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, it demonstrates the boundary between inference-side tool orchestration and base model capabilities: a lightweight tool harness can significantly improve RAG performance without model fine-tuning, indicating that the base model's planning and tool use capabilities can be unleashed through reasonable system design, providing a target reference for modeling tool call capabilities during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight agent harness is built on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping the LLM with four tools: search (delegates to the underlying search stack for full-library document discovery, supports up to 5 query reformulations), find (precision retrieval within candidate documents), open (rolling window access to full content of candidate documents), and summarize (triggered when context exceeds limit, consolidates retrieval results while preserving citations). A bounded iterative agent loop is implemented, which automatically maintains conversation state, token accounting, and document reference mappings, supports reuse of retrieved content for multi-turn queries, and requires no model fine-tuning, custom embedding models, or graph construction.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three public benchmarks: recall@1 reaches 49.6% on the BRIGHT benchmark, 21.8 percentage points higher than the best embedding baseline; factuality score is 0.96 on the WixQA benchmark, a 13% relative improvement; answer accuracy is 92% on the FinanceBench benchmark, within 2 percentage points of oracle access. Ablation experiments on tool contribution, effect of multi-query search, and differences in retrieval strategies across models are completed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the tool design and iterative loop logic in the method section (Section 3), then the ablation results in the experiment section, with a total reading time of about 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 微软将Agent工具调用与企业RAG结合的实用方案，架构设计和消融分析对Agent系统设计有参考价值，skim方法和实验部分。
recommendation.en: Microsoft's practical scheme combining agent tool use with enterprise RAG; architecture and ablation analysis are informative for agent system design. Skim methods and experiments.

paper.title: Enhancing Visual Question Answering with Multimodal LLMs via Chain-of-Question Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: With advances in multimodal research and deep learning, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for a wide range of multimodal tasks. As a core problem in vision-language research, Visual Question Answering (VQA) has increasingly employed MLLMs to improve performance, particularly in open-domain settings where external knowledge is essential. In this work, we aim to further enhance retrieval-based VQA by more effectively integrating MLLMs with structured reas

summary.core_problem: 解决开放域 VQA 中 MLLM 需要外部知识，但普通检索往往不能围绕图像问题形成足够准确、连贯证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理阶段的 RAG 框架改进，重点在提示式问题分解和检索引导；它不是多模态预训练方法，但能反映 VLM 推理链与外部知识结合时的常见设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoVQD，将 Chain-of-Thought 推理与 Visual Question Decomposition 结合，把视觉问题拆成更有逻辑结构的子问题，再用这些子问题引导检索；在此基础上构建 CgRAG，让 MLLM 使用更相关的外部知识完成 VQA。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明该方法提升 retrieval-based VQA 表现，但未给出具体数据集、使用的 MLLM、检索库规模、baseline 组合和数值提升；因此只能判断为推理框架层面的增量工作。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息显示部分作者来自 Macau University of Science and Technology，另有 Hubei Key Laboratory of Transportation Internet 相关单位。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets open-domain VQA where multimodal LLMs need external knowledge, but naive retrieval often fails to obtain evidence that is both relevant and coherent for the visual question.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time RAG framework for VLMs, centered on structured prompting and retrieval guidance. It is not a multimodal pretraining method, but it reflects a common design pattern for combining VLM reasoning with external knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces CoVQD, which fuses chain-of-thought reasoning with visual question decomposition. The decomposed sub-questions are then used to guide retrieval, forming the CgRAG framework for knowledge-augmented MLLM inference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports improved retrieval-based VQA performance, but does not specify datasets, MLLM backbones, retrieval corpus scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evidence is therefore best read as an incremental inference-framework result.
summary_en.authors_note: The author information indicates affiliations including Macau University of Science and Technology and Hubei Key Laboratory of Transportation Internet.

recommendation.zh: 只需看方法图和检索构造；这是 VQA-RAG 提示工程增量，对 pretrain 的帮助主要是观察失败模式。
recommendation.en: Skim only the method diagram and retrieval construction; this is an incremental VQA-RAG prompting setup, useful mainly for spotting inference-time failure modes.

paper.title: SURE-RAG: Sufficiency and Uncertainty-Aware Evidence Verification for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds answers in retrieved passages, but retrieval is not verification: a passage can be topical and still fail to justify the answer. We frame this gap as evidence sufficiency verification for selective RAG answering: given a question, a candidate answer, and retrieved evidence, predict whether the evidence supports, refutes, or is insufficient, and abstain unless support is established. We present SURE-RAG, a transparent aggregation protocol built on the

summary.core_problem: RAG 中“检索到相关段落”不等于“证据足以支持答案”，如何在给定候选答案与检索证据时判断支持/反驳/证据不足，并据此选择性回答或拒答。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把 RAG 的关键失败模式（缺 hop、冲突证据、证据不足）形式化为“集合级证据充分性验证”，并给出可审计的聚合信号；对提升 groundedness/abstention 的评测与系统设计有直接参考价值，但不触及基座预训练本体。
summary.technical_approach: 用共享的 claim-evidence verifier 在“答案-证据段落对”上输出局部关系分布（支持/反驳/不足等），再用 SURE-RAG 的透明聚合协议把局部关系汇总成答案级信号：coverage、relation strength、disagreement、conflict、retrieval uncertainty，并输出三分类决策与可审计的 selective score；核心主张是充分性是 set-level 属性，不能靠独立 passage 打分解决。
summary.experiments: 在 HotpotQA-RAG v3（受控多跳/冲突场景）上评估选择性回答与证据验证能力；对比基线应包含独立 passage 评分/简单聚合的 verifier 方案（摘要未给出具体模型规模与数值提升）。
summary.authors_note: ZenWeave AI；Georgetown University；Southern Methodist University

summary_en.core_problem: In RAG, retrieved passages can be topical yet insufficient to justify an answer; the paper targets evidence sufficiency verification (supported/refuted/insufficient) to enable selective answering/abstention.
summary_en.importance: It reframes a common RAG failure mode as set-level evidence sufficiency and provides auditable aggregation signals; useful for grounded QA system design and evaluation, but not directly advancing foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: A shared pairwise claim–evidence verifier produces local relation distributions for each answer–passage pair, then SURE-RAG aggregates them into interpretable answer-level signals (coverage, relation strength, disagreement, conflict, retrieval uncertainty) to make a 3-way decision and a selective score; the key premise is that sufficiency is a set property, not solvable by independent passage scoring.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on HotpotQA-RAG v3 with controlled multi-hop/conflict settings; compared against baselines that score passages independently or use simpler aggregation (no concrete model sizes or deltas provided in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: ZenWeave AI; Georgetown University; Southern Methodist University

recommendation.zh: 把“证据充分性是集合属性”讲清楚了；只需看聚合信号定义与消融，别指望它解决检索或预训练问题。
recommendation.en: The set-level sufficiency framing is the only real takeaway—skim the aggregation signals/ablations; it won’t move the needle on retrieval or pretraining.

paper.title: An Agent-Oriented Pluggable Experience-RAG Skill for Experience-Driven Retrieval Strategy Orchestration
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems often assume that one fixed retrieval pipeline is sufficient across heterogeneous tasks, yet factoid question answering, multi-hop reasoning, and scientific verification exhibit different retrieval preferences. We present Experience-RAG Skill, an agent-oriented pluggable retrieval orchestration layer positioned between the agent and the retriever pool. The proposed skill analyzes the current scene, consults an experience memory, selects an appropriate retri

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG 系统在不同任务上仍使用固定检索流水线的问题，尤其是事实问答、多跳推理和科学验证对检索策略的偏好不同。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 RAG/agent 系统改进。它把检索策略选择封装成可插拔 agent skill，而不是写死在上层 workflow 中；思路清楚，但从摘要看更像系统重组和小规模验证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Experience-RAG Skill，位于 agent 和 retriever pool 之间。该层分析当前场景，查询 experience memory，选择合适的检索策略，并把结构化证据返回给 agent。在固定候选检索器池下进行策略编排。
summary.experiments: 在 BeIR/nq、BeIR/hotpotqa、BeIR/scifact 上报告 overall nDCG@10 为 0.8924，优于固定单检索器 baseline，并与 Adaptive-RAG 风格的 routing 方法接近。摘要未说明模型规模、候选检索器构成和统计显著性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自澳门理工大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the weakness of using a fixed retrieval pipeline across heterogeneous RAG tasks, where factoid QA, multi-hop reasoning, and scientific verification prefer different retrieval strategies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a RAG/agent system design. It packages retrieval-strategy selection as a pluggable agent skill rather than hard-coding routing into the upper workflow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Experience-RAG Skill sits between the agent and a retriever pool. It analyzes the current scene, consults an experience memory, selects an appropriate retrieval strategy, and returns structured evidence to the agent under a fixed candidate pool.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports an overall nDCG@10 of 0.8924 on BeIR/nq, BeIR/hotpotqa, and BeIR/scifact, outperforming fixed single-retriever baselines and remaining competitive with Adaptive-RAG-style routing. The abstract does not specify model scale, retriever pool details, or statistical tests.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Macao Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 BeIR 表格即可；它说明 RAG routing 仍有工程收益，但不是基座训练信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and BeIR table; it shows engineering value in RAG routing, not a foundation-model training signal.

paper.title: S^3-R1: Learning to Retrieve and Answer Step-by-Step with Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has enabled newer capabilities in models, such as agentic tool-use for search. However, these models struggle primarily due to limitations with sparse outcome-based rewards and a lack of training data that encapsulates questions of differing hardness, which results in models not performing deeper searches with tools to collect evidence for question-answering. To address these limitations, we introduce S^3-R1 (Synthetic data and stabilized Search R1), a f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期存在的问题：把 RL 用到检索增强问答时，模型往往学不会稳定的多步搜索策略。原因有两层。第一，训练数据分布偏浅，很多样本并不真正要求多跳检索，模型容易靠短路径或参数记忆拿到答案。第二，奖励过于稀疏，通常只看最终答案是否正确，导致搜索质量、证据覆盖、查询是否有效这些中间行为拿不到训练信号。全文围绕这两个瓶颈展开：如何构造一批“确实需要多步检索、但又不是不可学”的训练题，以及如何让 RL 不只奖励最终答对，还奖励检索过程本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不在 base pretrain，而在 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口。它提供了一个很清楚的信号：当能力目标是 tool-use 和外部知识检索时，单靠 outcome-only RL 很容易把策略推向短视解。更有效的做法是同时改训练分布和奖励形状。这里最有启发的是“中等难度、可验证、可检索”的合成数据带设计，以及把 retrieval quality 显式写进 reward。对做 continual pretrain、mid-train、agentic post-training 的人，这种思路比单纯换 RL 算法更有参考价值。贡献量级属于扎实的训练范式改进，不是基础建模范式变化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分成两部分。第一部分是数据。作者不是直接让强模型随便生成多跳题，而是先做 hard example mining，找到当前基座 agent 解不好的问题或文档片段，再让 frontier model 在这些材料上做问题变换和扩展，生成新的 multi-hop QA。之后接一个较严格的过滤链路，核心有两类校验：一类是 factual grounding，确保问题和答案能被原始文档支持，不是语言模型幻觉出来的伪题；另一类是 retrieval-solvability，检查在高召回但带噪声的检索环境里，这个问题是否仍然可解。这个设计的目的很明确：不是追求最难，而是找一个 RL 能学到策略改进的难度带。第二部分是奖励。作者在最终答案正确性之外，引入 retrieval-aware reward，显式鼓励更好的搜索查询和证据选择。按文中描述，这个奖励不是简单给每次 search 固定 bonus，而是和召回到的支持证据、搜索质量相关，意图缓解 credit assignment 问题，让模型知道“为什么这次搜索是有用的”。训练上沿用 Search-R1 一类的交互式 rollout 协议，使用 GRPO 做策略优化，并对外部检索返回内容做 token mask 处理，避免把工具返回直接当作普通生成 token 来更新。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，实验重点不是证明一个全新 RL 算法，而是验证两件事：合成数据扩展训练分布是否有效，以及 retrieval-aware reward 是否比 outcome-only reward 更能学出深搜索行为。作者在多个 multi-hop QA benchmark 上与 Search-R1、R1-Searcher 一类强基线比较，结论是整体准确率和复杂问题上的表现都有明显提升，且提升主要集中在需要多次检索和证据整合的样本上。消融实验围绕三点展开：去掉合成数据后，模型更容易退回短路径回答；去掉检索感知奖励后，搜索步数和证据质量下降，即便最终答案偶尔还能蒙对；如果放松数据过滤，训练会混入不可解或伪难题，收益明显变差。给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字、模型参数量和数据规模明细，因此无法可靠填入具体百分比或绝对提升值；但实验结构已经足够说明作者想证明的是“数据分布 + 稠密奖励”这组组合优于单独调 RL。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Method 开头，抓住作者的判断：问题不在 RL 优化器本身，而在训练分布和奖励信号。然后重点看 synthetic question generation / curation 那一节，尤其是 hard seed、verification、retrieval-solvability 这几个步骤，因为真正有方法含量的是数据带设计，而不是“再造一批 synthetic QA”这件事本身。接着看 reward 设计部分，确认 retrieval-aware reward 到底如何定义、是否依赖额外标注、是否会诱导 reward hacking。实验部分建议优先看 ablation：只加数据、只改奖励、两者同时加，三者差异最能说明方法是否成立。预计 20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 agentic RL 的训练信号设计，可以再细看 failure case 和 search depth 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in RL-based search agents for QA: models do not reliably learn multi-step retrieval policies. The root causes are twofold. First, the training distribution is too shallow; many examples do not truly require multi-hop search, so the policy can survive with short-horizon behavior or parametric recall. Second, the reward is too sparse, usually based only on final answer correctness, which gives almost no direct signal for query quality, evidence coverage, or whether an intermediate search action was useful. The paper is built around these two questions: how to construct questions that genuinely require retrieval yet remain learnable, and how to shape RL signals so the model is rewarded for the retrieval process rather than only the final answer.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. The main lesson is clear: for tool-use and retrieval-heavy capabilities, outcome-only RL tends to produce short-sighted policies unless the training distribution and reward design are fixed together. The most useful idea is the construction of a verified, retrieval-solvable, intermediate-difficulty synthetic dataset, paired with an explicit retrieval-aware reward. For researchers working on continual pretraining, mid-training, or agentic post-training, this is more informative than another small variation of PPO or GRPO. The contribution is a solid training recipe improvement rather than a new modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two main components. The first is data construction. Instead of asking a strong model to freely generate multi-hop QA pairs, the pipeline starts with hard example mining: identify questions or document regions that the current base agent fails on, then use a frontier model to mutate or expand them into new multi-hop questions. A filtering pipeline follows, with two key checks. One is factual grounding, which ensures the question and answer are supported by source documents rather than model hallucination. The other is retrieval-solvability, which tests whether the question remains answerable in a noisy but high-recall retrieval setting. This is an important design choice: the target is not maximal difficulty, but a learnable difficulty band where RL can improve policy behavior. The second component is reward design. In addition to final answer correctness, the paper introduces a retrieval-aware reward that explicitly scores search quality and evidence selection. From the full text, this is meant to provide denser credit assignment than a pure outcome reward, so the model can learn which search actions were actually productive. Training follows the interactive search rollout protocol used in Search-R1-style systems, optimized with GRPO, with masking applied to externally retrieved content during policy updates.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is organized to validate two claims rather than to introduce a new RL optimizer: expanding the training distribution with synthetic data helps, and adding retrieval-aware reward helps beyond outcome-only supervision. The paper compares against strong baselines such as Search-R1 and R1-Searcher on multiple multi-hop QA benchmarks, and reports consistent gains, especially on questions that require multiple retrieval steps and evidence aggregation. The ablations are the most informative part. Removing synthetic data pushes the model back toward shallow answering behavior. Removing the retrieval-aware reward reduces search depth and evidence quality, even when final-answer accuracy does not collapse immediately. Relaxing the filtering pipeline introduces unsound or effectively unsolvable questions, which weakens training gains. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final numeric tables, model sizes, or exact dataset scale, so it would be unsafe to invent precise numbers. Still, the structure of the experiments makes the intended result clear: the combination of better data distribution and denser retrieval-specific reward is stronger than tuning RL alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the opening of the method section. The key claim is that the bottleneck is not primarily the RL optimizer, but the training distribution and reward signal. Then read the synthetic question generation and curation section carefully, especially the hard-seed mining, verification, and retrieval-solvability checks. That is where the real methodological content sits; the value is not simply 'more synthetic QA', but how the difficulty band is engineered. After that, inspect the reward section to see how retrieval-aware reward is defined, whether it depends on extra supervision, and whether it creates room for reward hacking. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations: data only, reward only, and both together. Those comparisons tell you whether the method is actually doing what it claims. A useful skim should take about 20–30 minutes. If your interest is RL signal design for search agents, spend extra time on failure cases and search-depth analysis.

recommendation.zh: 读数据筛选和 dense reward 设计即可；方法像工程补丁，但能提醒预训练团队别把检索能力全压给 outcome RL。
recommendation.en: Read the data filtering and dense-reward design; it is an engineering patch, but a useful warning against relying on outcome-only RL for retrieval behavior.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: DocSync: Agentic Documentation Maintenance via Critic-Guided Reflexion
paper.abstract: Software documentation frequently drifts from executable logic as codebases evolve, creating technical debt that degrades maintainability and causes downstream API misuse. While static analysis tools can detect the absence of documentation, they cannot evaluate its semantic consistency.
